apply.title: ServiceNow Senior Technical Consultant
apply.description:
ServiceNow Sr. Technical Consultant

About The Role

As a ServiceNow Sr. Technical Consultant, you will make an impact by translating business requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions that improve workflows, integrations and user experiences. You will work collaboratively with business stakeholders, project leaders and technical teams to design, deliver and support high-quality platform capabilities.

In This Role, You Will

  • Analyze business and system requirements, identify dependencies and translate needs into effective ServiceNow solution designs.
  • Design, develop, test, implement, maintain and support ServiceNow applications, modules and custom-scoped solutions.
  • Build and enhance integrations using REST APIs, LDAP, Active Directory, JDBC, Orchestration and IntegrationHub.
  • Create and review technical specifications, workflows, test results and documentation; identify and complete corrective actions.
  • Resolve complex technical issues independently, recommend reusable solutions and help coordinate assigned project activities to support on-time, high-quality delivery.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in Canada. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What you need to have to be considered

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business or a related field and 3–5 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Hands-on JavaScript development experience on the ServiceNow platform, including custom-scoped applications.
  • Experience building ServiceNow integrations using REST APIs, LDAP, Active Directory, JDBC, Orchestration or IntegrationHub.
  • Experience with Service Portal, UI Builder, Configurable Workspace, Now Experience Framework, Flow Designer and Automated Test Framework.
  • Strong consulting, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams, deliver quality work on schedule and support occasional non-standard shifts or on-call coverage.

These will help you stand out

  • Knowledge of ServiceNow Governance, Risk and Compliance or Integrated Risk Management, with related certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow IT Service Management, IT Operations Management or Security Operations.
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification.
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Experience leading assigned workstreams, coordinating tasks and monitoring delivery performance.

We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Salary And Other Compensation

Applicants will be accepted till 11/20/2026

The annual salary for this position will be in the range of $92,000 - $102,000 CAD depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

apply.description:
Job Type: PermanentWork Model: RemoteReference code: 135342Primary Location: Toronto, ONAll Available Locations: Toronto, ON; Ottawa, ON

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

  • Have many careers in one Firm.
  • Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
  • Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

What will your typical day look like?

The Global ServiceNow Center of Excellence is seeking a highly skilled and experienced ServiceNow CMDB Solutions Architect to lead the architecture of enterprise Configuration Management Database solutions, with particular emphasis on the Common Service Data Model (CSDM), configuration data quality, discovery, service mapping and governance. The ideal candidate will combine deep ServiceNow platform expertise with practical knowledge of configuration management, IT operations, service management and enterprise data governance. This role requires strong architecture leadership, excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with platform, infrastructure, application, service management, security, technology and business stakeholders. The successful candidate will translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical designs, guide implementations through architectural governance, and ensure solutions make effective use of out-of-the-box CMDB capabilities, integrations, automation, health monitoring and reporting.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, design and implementation of enterprise ServiceNow CMDB solutions aligned to CSDM and configuration management objectives.
  • Partner with platform, infrastructure, application, service management, security, operations and business stakeholders to define configuration data requirements, ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Define architectures covering CI class models, service and application models, relationships, lifecycle states, ownership, data sources and supporting governance workflows.
  • Design traceable and reusable relationships between business applications, application services, technical services, infrastructure components, locations, users and support groups.
  • Develop and maintain architectural views, CSDM-aligned data models, integration designs, decision records, configuration standards and detailed technical specifications.
  • Promote configuration-first, upgrade-safe use of out-of-the-box ServiceNow CMDB capabilities and challenge unnecessary customization.
  • Provide technical leadership to delivery teams and review configurations, extensions and code for security, quality, performance and maintainability.
  • Architect integrations and ingestion patterns using Discovery, Service Mapping, Service Graph Connectors, IntegrationHub ETL, APIs and other appropriate technologies.
  • Define Identification and Reconciliation Engine rules, source precedence, reconciliation controls and multi-source data patterns to prevent duplicates and protect authoritative data.
  • Establish CMDB health, certification, attestation, remediation and lifecycle-management practices that improve completeness, correctness, compliance and currency.
  • Ensure security, privacy, data ownership, access controls, auditability and segregation of duties are embedded within solution designs.
  • Support projects through architecture review, design assurance, testing, deployment and mandatory governance processes.
  • Troubleshoot complex CMDB, discovery, service mapping and integration issues and guide teams towards sustainable resolutions.
  • Shape the ServiceNow CMDB and CSDM roadmap, standards and reusable patterns, remaining current with product releases and recognized configuration management practices.
  • Mentor architects, CMDB administrators, data owners and delivery colleagues and contribute to continuous improvement across the ServiceNow architecture practice.

Important: This is an architecture role specializing in ServiceNow CMDB and CSDM; it is not a lead developer role. A deep technical understanding of the platform, Configuration Management Database data model, Identification and Reconciliation Engine and configuration data lifecycle is required, but the candidate should expect to spend most of their time working with project teams, data owners and business stakeholders, shaping CMDB solutions, producing design documentation, making architectural decisions and supporting projects through mandatory governance processes. Hands-on development will normally be limited to occasional proof-of-concept, configuration validation or technical analysis work.

About The Team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Qualifications

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

Required:

  • Certified ServiceNow Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Implementation Specialist – Data Foundations (CMDB and CSDM) (CIS-DF), or the current equivalent ServiceNow certification.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex CMDB, CSDM, data governance and technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • 5+ years of ServiceNow experience in solution or technical architecture roles, including substantial hands-on architecture experience with enterprise CMDB implementations.
  • A proven track record of leading end-to-end ServiceNow CMDB solution designs and delivering complex, enterprise-scale implementations.
  • Deep knowledge of the ServiceNow CMDB and CSDM, including CI class hierarchy, service and application modelling, relationships, lifecycle states, ownership and CSDM domains.
  • Experience designing CMDB governance frameworks, operating models, data ownership, certification, attestation, remediation and continuous improvement processes.
  • Strong knowledge of CMDB Health, Data Manager, CI Class Manager, duplicate management, stale CI handling and the completeness, correctness and compliance health measures.
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, data model, security model, workspaces, reporting, workflow automation and upgrade-safe design practices.
  • Experience populating and maintaining the CMDB through Discovery, Service Mapping, Service Graph Connectors, IntegrationHub ETL, APIs, import sets and other appropriate ingestion technologies.
  • Deep understanding of Identification and Reconciliation Engine configuration, identification rules, reconciliation rules, data source rules, source precedence and multi-source CMDB patterns.
  • Experience integrating CMDB data with ITSM, ITOM, Security Operations, Asset Management and other platform capabilities to support impact, change, incident and service-management outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow scripting, including JavaScript and GlideRecord, sufficient to assess technical feasibility and assure solution quality.
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall delivery approaches and participating across the full software development lifecycle.
  • Solid understanding of ITIL configuration management, architecture governance, data security and privacy, change and release management, testing and audit requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams, with strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Excellent Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint skills.

Beneficial:

  • ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, ITOM or Asset Management implementation experience and relevant certifications.
  • Certification in non-ServiceNow enterprise platform technologies such as Azure, AWS or Microsoft 365.
  • ServiceNow Developer experience is beneficial but not required. This is not a developer role.
  • Certified Master Architect (CMA), Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or other relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $156,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

apply.title: Sr. Specialist, Salesforce Data Cloud & Loyalty
apply.description:
Senior Specialist, Salesforce Data Cloud & Loyalty


About the role

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Data Cloud & Loyalty Specialist to join a client-facing solutioning pod supporting customer engagement, loyalty, personalization, and marketing activation initiatives.


This is a hands-on platform role focused on Salesforce Data Cloud, Salesforce Loyalty Management, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Engagement. The role is execution-heavy and suited for someone who is comfortable configuring platforms, building segments, supporting campaigns, validating data, and troubleshooting issues.


You will work closely with architects, developers, QA, campaign teams, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions and ensure delivery quality across the platform.


What you will do

  • Perform hands-on configuration and delivery support across Salesforce Data Cloud, Salesforce Loyalty Management, and SFMC / Salesforce Engagement.
  • Build, validate, and troubleshoot audiences, segments, calculated insights, activation logic, and campaign eligibility rules.
  • Support loyalty program capabilities such as member journeys, tiers, benefits, promotions, offers, and accrual/redemption logic.
  • Translate business and marketing requirements into user stories, platform configurations, test scenarios, data mappings, and technical documentation.
  • Use SQL where needed for audience validation, segmentation checks, campaign QA, count validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Support campaign readiness activities, including data validation, count checks, platform QA, and segmentation accuracy reviews.
  • Partner with developers, QA resources, campaign teams, analysts, product owners, architects, and client stakeholders to support delivery.
  • Troubleshoot platform and data issues, document root causes, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate delivery or specialist teams.
  • Identify risks related to data quality, consent, privacy, segmentation logic, campaign rules, platform limitations, and implementation complexity.
  • Participate in client working sessions, including onsite sessions in Toronto 1-2 days per week.


Required qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Salesforce, MarTech, CRM, loyalty, marketing automation, customer engagement platforms, or related technical consulting.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: Salesforce Data Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Engagement, or Salesforce Loyalty Management.
  • Practical understanding of customer data, segmentation, personalization, campaign activation, consent, and platform configuration.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for querying, validating, troubleshooting, or analysing customer and campaign data.
  • Familiarity with relational data concepts such as tables, fields, joins, keys, audience logic, segmentation rules, and source-to-target mapping.
  • Ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, solution notes, test scenarios, data mappings, and technical documentation.
  • Experience working with developers, QA, analysts, product owners, architects, campaign teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort operating in client-facing environments.
  • Ability to work onsite at client offices in Toronto 1-2 days per week.


Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Loyalty Management or another loyalty platform.
  • Experience with SFMC / Salesforce Engagement, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Braze, or similar customer engagement platforms.
  • Experience writing SQL for campaign QA, segmentation validation, audience validation, count reconciliation, or data quality checks.
  • Exposure to Snowflake, Databricks, or other enterprise data platforms. This is nice-to-have only and not required for the role.
  • Exposure to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). This is nice-to-have only and not required for the role.
  • Experience supporting email, SMS, push, web, mobile app, authenticated digital, loyalty, or other customer engagement channels.
  • Salesforce, Adobe, Braze, or related MarTech certifications are an asset.


What success looks like

  • Requirements are translated into clear, delivery-ready platform configurations and documentation.
  • Segments, audiences, loyalty logic, and activation rules are validated before campaign or journey deployment.
  • Platform issues are identified early, documented clearly, and resolved with the right teams.
  • The broader pod has confidence in the quality of data, campaign logic, QA outputs, and handoff materials.


About us:

Enverta Digital is a marketing technology and customer engagement consultancy, now part of Havas CX Canada. We specialize in CRM strategy, marketing operations, and MarTech enablement, helping brands design and deliver personalized, data-driven customer experiences across channels. Backed by Havas’ global network, Enverta combines deep platform expertise with creative and strategic capabilities to drive measurable business impact.


Additional Information

This role represents an active vacancy at Havas. You will be joining a collaborative, growth-oriented environment where ideas are encouraged and career development is supported. The base salary range for this position is CAD $100,000 to $140,000, with final compensation determined based on factors such as work location, skills, experience, and background.

apply.title: ServiceNow Engagement Manager
apply.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

The ServiceNow Engagement Manager is a key member of the ServiceNow practice, focused on delivering high-quality client engagements, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the growth and development of the ServiceNow practice. This role partners closely with sales, delivery, alliance, and practice leadership to support go-to-market activities, successful project delivery, and the development of high-performing ServiceNow talent. The Manager is responsible for the successful execution of client engagements, team leadership, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships and drive continued growth of the ServiceNow practice.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of ServiceNow consulting engagements, from initial discovery and solution planning through implementation and delivery.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, developing strong relationships with senior stakeholders and effectively managing expectations, priorities, risks, and outcomes.
  • Partner with clients to define strategic objectives, identify business and technology challenges, and translate those objectives into actionable ServiceNow roadmaps and implementation strategies.
  • Provide strategic and operational leadership across ServiceNow programs, ensuring solutions align with client business objectives, enterprise technology strategies, and ServiceNow best practices.
  • Lead and mentor cross-functional ServiceNow delivery teams, including distributed and remote resources, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage competing client priorities across multiple engagements and proactively balance scope, resources, timelines, and business value.
  • Identify opportunities to expand client relationships by connecting successful delivery outcomes to broader business and technology needs.
  • Lead and contribute to proposals, statements of work, solution development, presentations, and other business development activities.
  • Develop and maintain a strong network of internal and external relationships to support client success, practice growth, and broader firm strategic objectives.
  • Collaborate with ServiceNow practitioners, technical teams, and firm leadership to develop innovative solutions and strengthen the firm's ServiceNow consulting capabilities.
  • Demonstrate strong business acumen and the ability to connect ServiceNow capabilities to broader organizational challenges, helping clients realize measurable business value from their investments.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience working with the ServiceNow platform, including experience leading implementations or transformation initiatives.
  • 5+ years of experience in people management, client management, engagement management, or consulting delivery leadership.
  • Proven experience leading distributed or remote teams and managing relationships with clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to help clients define strategic vision, business objectives, and technology roadmaps, with the ability to translate those objectives into actionable ServiceNow solutions.
  • Previous experience serving as an Engagement Manager, Project Manager, Program Manager, or similar delivery leadership role on ServiceNow implementations.
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow capabilities, implementation methodologies, and platform best practices.
  • Experience identifying business problems, developing business strategies, and/or identifying opportunities to drive client value and business growth.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification or willingness to obtain.
  • Strong communication, presentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a management or leadership role within a consulting environment.
  • Experience leading large-scale or complex ServiceNow transformation programs.
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist certification(s).
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, or other relevant ServiceNow products.
  • Experience contributing to business development, account growth, proposals, and client pursuits.
  • Experience working with C-suite and senior business/technology stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmcanada.com/careers/life-at-rsm/rewards-and-benefits.html.

We believe flexibility and in-person connection both play an important role in how we work and grow. Most roles at RSM follow a hybrid workstyle, which means team members are aligned to an RSM office and come together in person when it best supports clients, teams, development or relationship-building. Some roles may be virtual or primarily on-site based on role requirements, team priorities and client needs.

Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process and/or employment/partnership. RSM is committed to providing equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or otherwise participate in the recruiting process, please call us at 800-274-3978 or send us an email at careers@rsmus.com.

The salary range (or starting rate for interns and associates) for this role represents numerous factors considered in the hiring decisions including, but not limited to, education, skills, work experience, certifications, location, etc. As such, pay for the successful candidate(s) could fall anywhere within the stated range.

apply.title: ServiceNow Developer
apply.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We are looking for a hands-on ServiceNow Developer to join our IT Platform team. This person will own the day-to-day configuration, development, and support of our ServiceNow instance, working across ITSM & HRSD while helping extend the platform through custom development and third-party integrations. This is a highly technical, delivery-focused role for someone who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and continuously improving a mission-critical enterprise platform.

You'll work across our development, staging, and production instances, partner closely with IT and business stakeholders, and help drive our upgrade and enhancement roadmap forward.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop and configure ServiceNow: Build and maintain applications, catalog items, record producers, workflows, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, UI Actions, and other platform components.
  • Build integrations: Design, develop, and troubleshoot integrations between ServiceNow and third-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, webhooks, Integration Hub, MCP, and iPaaS platforms such as Workato.
  • Maintain and optimize the platform: Monitor platform health, troubleshoot performance issues, optimize scripts and flows, and ensure solutions remain scalable and maintainable.
  • Support ServiceNow applications like ITSM & HRSD: Help deliver and improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and HR-related workflows and automations.
  • Manage access and security: Administer roles, ACLs, permissions, and other platform access controls in line with security and audit requirements.
  • Resolve complex issues: Act as an escalation point for platform-level incidents, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate with infrastructure, security, vendors, and other technical teams when issues span multiple systems.
  • Deliver enhancements and projects: Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, prioritize the backlog, design solutions, and take work through development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.
  • Drive platform consistency: Establish reusable development patterns and standards for workflows, notifications, approvals, documentation, and user experiences.
  • Support upgrades and releases: Evaluate new ServiceNow releases, test upgrades, remediate breaking changes, and adopt relevant new platform capabilities.
  • Document and enable: Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, integration documentation, and user procedures, and provide support or training when needed.

What You Need To Bring

  • Hands-on experience developing and administering ServiceNow, ideally across ITSM and/or HRSD.
  • Strong JavaScript skills, including ServiceNow scripting APIs such as GlideRecord and GlideAjax.
  • Experience with Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Service Catalog development.
  • Experience designing and troubleshooting REST/SOAP integrations, OAuth, webhooks, and enterprise integrations.
  • Strong understanding of ITSM processes and how they translate into ServiceNow solutions.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues across ServiceNow and connected systems.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience working with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have's

  • Experience with HRSD, ITOM, Workday, or identity/HR platforms.
  • Experience with ServiceNow AI/GenAI capabilities, including Now Assist.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and MCP-enabled tools or workflows.
  • Experience with Service Portal, custom widgets, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience with Workato or other iPaaS platforms.
  • ServiceNow CSA or CAD, or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

Be a changemaker

You’ll Enjoy

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
  • A culture that celebrates performance
  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies
  • Equity options, because this is your company too
  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters
  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career
  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best
  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams
  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook
  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who We Are

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

Faites partie de notre équipe Expérience client, où vous aurez un rôle déterminant dans l’élaboration des expériences client. Vous vous appuierez sur l’impératif stratégique de Bell qui s’intitule « Promouvoir l’expérience client » et renforcerez notre engagement à donner la priorité au client dans tout ce que nous faisons. Vous concevrez des processus, des politiques, des produits et des services novateurs axés sur le client, tout en respectant nos engagements envers le client afin qu'il soit plus facile pour eux de faire affaire avec Bell.

En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous serez au cœur de l’expérience client.

Résumé

Bell est à la recherche d'un(e) Administrateur(trice) ServiceNow expérimenté(e) pour assurer l'administration, le soutien, la stabilité et l'évolution continue de la plateforme ServiceNow.

La personne retenue travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de plateforme, les architectes, les développeurs et les responsables de processus afin de garantir la performance, la sécurité et la conformité de la plateforme tout en soutenant les initiatives de transformation numérique de Bell.

Principales responsabilités

Administration de la plateforme

  • Administrer et maintenir les instances ServiceNow de production et hors production.
  • Gérer les configurations, les propriétés système, les plugins, les mises à niveau et les correctifs.
  • Surveiller la performance, la disponibilité et la santé globale de la plateforme.
  • Planifier et exécuter les activités de clonage d’instances et de gestion des environnements.

Gestion des accès et de la sécurité

  • Administrer les utilisateurs, groupes et rôles.
  • Assurer le respect des normes de sécurité et de gouvernance de Bell.
  • Soutenir l’authentification, le SSO et les revues périodiques d’accès.

Soutien opérationnel

  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents et problèmes liés à la plateforme.
  • Participer aux activités de mise à niveau et de gestion des versions.
  • Exécuter les activités de maintenance préventive et corrective.
  • Collaborer avec les fournisseurs et équipes de soutien internes.

Gouvernance de la plateforme

  • Assurer l’application des meilleures pratiques ServiceNow.
  • Participer aux revues d’architecture, aux processus de changement et aux contrôles de gouvernance.
  • Contribuer aux initiatives de qualité de données CMDB et CSDM.

Amélioration continue et automatisation

  • Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d’automatisation.
  • Soutenir le déploiement de nouvelles capacités ServiceNow (ITSM, ITOM, SPM, SecOps, CSM, IA, etc.).
  • Contribuer aux tableaux de bord opérationnels et aux indicateurs de performance de la plateforme.

Qualifications Essentielles

Exigences

  • Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience en administration ServiceNow.
  • Bonne compréhension de l’architecture de la plateforme ServiceNow.
  • Expérience avec :
  • ITSM
  • CMDB
  • Concepts CSDM
  • Gestion des utilisateurs et des rôles
  • Clonage d’instances et mises à niveau
  • Rapports et tableaux de bord
  • Intégration de systèmes
  • Connaissance des pratiques ITIL.
  • Expérience dans un environnement d’entreprise de grande envergure.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes.

Atouts

  • Certification ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
  • Expérience avec ITOM, SPM, IRM, SecOps, HAM ou SAM.
  • Connaissances en JavaScript et en développement ServiceNow.
  • Expérience avec les méthodologies Agile.
  • Expérience en environnements multi-instances.

Qualifications Souhaitées

  • Orientation client et résultats.
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication.
  • Rigueur et souci du détail.
  • Forte capacité de collaboration.
  • Esprit d’amélioration continue et d’innovation.

apply.description:

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

The Adventure Ahead 🚀

Our Salesforce team is at the center of how Docebo sells, renews, and serves customers. We're investing in how it operates, and this is a net-new role we're adding to lead that change. We have strong senior technical talent on the team — what we're adding is a product owner who can set direction, manage stakeholders, and give that talent well-scoped work to build.

You'll own the backlog and the priorities. You'll define the intake and process the team runs on. And you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our senior architects and admins as an advisor and partner — not to out-engineer them, but to make sure the team is solving the right problems in the right order, with the business bought in.

The Day-to-Day 🛠️

  • The product backlog and priorities. Turn business needs into clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Prioritize with stakeholders so the team always knows what's next and why.
  • Stakeholder management. Be the connective tissue between the Salesforce team and the business — Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Finance. Manage expectations, negotiate trade-offs, and bring the team into solution design early instead of receiving pre-baked requests.
  • Process and ways of working. Define and stand up how the team intakes, prioritizes, and delivers work. Set the standard for a good request and make it stick, so work enters the team ready to build.
  • Partnership with senior technical leads. Work with the team's architects and admins as an advisor and thought partner. You bring the product and process lens; they own the technical design. Together you keep the org healthy and the roadmap realistic.
  • AI-driven innovation. Champion how the team uses AI to work smarter — from AI-assisted ticket triage and intake scoring to identifying where automation and AI can improve how Docebo runs on Salesforce.
  • A seat at the table. Represent the Salesforce team when the business evaluates new tools, so decisions that affect the platform are made deliberately, not discovered later.

Your Superpowers ⚡

  • Platform Depth: Proven experience as a Salesforce Architect, Senior Admin, or Business Analyst with the hands-on expertise needed to speak fluent platform and earn instant respect with technical leads.
  • Product Ownership Mastery: Strong track record of running backlogs, scoping airtight requirements, prioritizing high-value features, and confidently saying "no" with strategic reasoning.
  • Stakeholder Diplomacy: Exceptional ability to align competing business priorities across departments, negotiate trade-offs with senior leadership, and keep everyone bought into the plan.
  • Process Architecture: Demonstrated success building lightweight, effective operating frameworks that bring structure and clarity to team workflows without adding bureaucratic bloat.
  • Impactful Communication: Talent for translating technical complexities into business-friendly language for executives while keeping developers clear on the mission and priorities.
  • AI-Forward Mindset: Natural curiosity and drive to leverage emerging AI solutions to optimize team operations and CRM efficiency.
  • Governance Savvy: Deep comfort navigating regulated environments, including SOX controls, structured deployment schedules, and strict UAT standards.

Bonus Points 🌟

  • Certified Expertise: Holding active Salesforce certifications (e.g., Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Architect track credentials).
  • RevOps Synergy: Direct experience acting as the designated product owner partnering with a fast-paced Revenue Operations organization.
  • Revenue Cloud Knowledge: Hands-on familiarity with Salesforce Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing) or leading complex billing system migrations.
  • Applied AI Experience: Practical background implementing AI-driven workflows or tools within CRM or delivery environments.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

  • Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.
  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You 😍

  • Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.
  • Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.
  • Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!
  • Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!
  • Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law.

apply.title: Salesforce Platform Developer
apply.description:
Compensation Range

CAD $105,000 - $115,000

Compensation Disclaimer

The salary range listed reflects the base pay for this role at Altus Group and is provided where required by local regulations. Actual offers may differ based on experience, market conditions, and other relevant factors. The range does not include additional compensation such as bonuses, equity, benefits, or other incentives.

Who We Are

Unlock your Altus Experience!

If you’re looking to advance your career in an industry that is transitioning for greatness, there’s no better place than Altus Group.

Our high trust, high performance culture prioritizes progressive programs that empower you to deliver your greatest performance while promoting collective success where everyone is recognized and connected.

We offer boundless opportunities in a rapidly growing global business: mentorship from the best and brightest in CRE, access to our Altus Intelligence Academy, and the chance to work with the best data sets, tools and technology in the industry.

Who We Need

Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Applications, we are hiring a Salesforce Platform Developer to design, develop, and improve scalable solutions across Altus Group’s Salesforce platform. You will translate business and technical requirements into secure, maintainable solutions, working closely with Salesforce architecture, product, delivery, and business teams. Your work will span hands-on development, platform integrations, automation, release quality, and ongoing improvements to platform performance and stability. You will also contribute to development standards, technical reviews, and knowledge sharing across the team.

This is a remote role, with a preference for someone based in Toronto. Occasional office visits may be required.

What’s In It For You

You’ll have the opportunity to work across a broad range of Salesforce development activities, contributing to solutions that support business needs across the organization. From building and improving platform capabilities to strengthening integrations, release practices, and platform performance, your work will have a direct role in how Altus Group uses and evolves its Salesforce environment.

You’ll also work closely with Salesforce architects, product and delivery teams, business analysts, and other developers. This collaboration will give you the opportunity to contribute your technical perspective, share knowledge, and help shape solutions that are secure, scalable, and built to last.

As our new Salesforce Platform Developer, you will

  • Build and improve Salesforce solutions. You will design, develop, test, and maintain solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and other Salesforce technologies. You will translate business and technical requirements into solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable.
  • Contribute to technical standards and quality. You will follow established development practices and contribute to reusable solution patterns, code reviews, and technical design reviews. You will help identify opportunities to improve solution quality, consistency, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Strengthen integrations and platform performance. You will develop and support integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise applications using APIs and appropriate integration technologies. You will also troubleshoot platform issues, address technical debt, and contribute to the stability, security, and performance of the environment.
  • Support releases and production changes. You will contribute to source control, CI/CD pipelines, testing, release management, and production deployments. You will follow established change management and SOX control requirements, ensuring changes have the appropriate approvals, peer reviews, test evidence, and audit traceability.
  • Work across teams to deliver solutions. You will partner with Salesforce architects, product and delivery teams, business analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and contribute to solution design. You will communicate technical considerations, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs clearly, while sharing knowledge with other developers.
  • Contribute to emerging platform capabilities. You will support the design, development, and maintenance of AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities, such as Agentforce and Einstein, in line with security, data, and governance requirements.

You bring

  • The Salesforce development experience. You have hands-on experience developing solutions across the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, and SOQL. You understand how to build solutions that meet business needs while remaining secure, scalable, and maintainable.
  • The integration and platform knowledge. You bring experience developing and supporting integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems using APIs and integration patterns. You understand platform performance, governor limits, security considerations, and how to identify opportunities to improve existing solutions.
  • The software development practices. You are familiar with source control, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and structured software development practices. You can participate in code and technical design reviews, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to consistent development standards.
  • The problem-solving approach. You can assess technical requirements and recommend an appropriate solution, balancing declarative Salesforce configuration with custom development. You are comfortable investigating issues, identifying root causes, and considering the longer-term impact of technical decisions.
  • The communication and collaboration skills. You can explain technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You work effectively with architects, developers, business analysts, and business teams to move solutions from requirements through delivery.

It Would Be An Asset If You Also Have

  • Experience working within SOX-regulated environments or controlled change management processes.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce and Einstein.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I (PD1) and/or Platform Developer II (PD2) certification.

What You Can Expect From Our Interview Process

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining Altus Group and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A one-hour virtual interview with the Interim Director of Enterprise Applications and a senior member of the team. The conversation will focus on your Salesforce development experience, technical capabilities, approach to solution design, and experience working with business and technical stakeholders.

Unlock your Altus Experience!

If you’re looking to advance your career in in an industry that is transitioning for greatness, there’s no better place than Altus Group.

Our high trust, high performance culture prioritizes progressive programs that empower you to deliver your greatest performance while promoting collective success where everyone is recognized and connected.

We offer boundless opportunities in a rapidly growing global business: mentorship from the best and brightest in CRE, access to our Altus Intelligence Academy, and the chance to work with the best data sets, tools and technology in the industry.

What Altus Group Offers

  • Rewarding performance: competitive compensation, incentive and bonus plans, and a total rewards package prioritizing mental, physical, and financial well-being.
  • Growth and development: we invest in your professional learning. Our Altus Intelligence Academy offers over 150,000 hours of learning content.
  • Flexible work model: our Activity-Based Work model provides flexibility to align your work location to the needs of the work — use the office for collaboration and remote work for focused tasks.

Inclusivity & Accessibility

Altus Group is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where all clients and employees feel welcomed, accepted and valued. We provide an atmosphere free from barriers to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion, and encourage equal opportunities for all employees. We’re seeking candidates with diverse experiences and provide accessible candidate experiences throughout the selection process. If you need accommodation, please contact us at accessibility@altusgroup.com or +1 888 692 7487.

Use of Artificial Intelligence

AI tools may be used to support the initial stages of screening for this role; however, all assessments and final hiring decisions are reviewed and made by an Altus Group hiring professional.

apply.title: Senior Lead, ServiceNow ITOM
apply.description:
Who We Are

Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our products are designed for console gaming systems, PC, and mobile, including smartphones and tablets. We deliver our products through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at http://www.take2games.com.

While our offices (physical and virtual) are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

As a seasoned ServiceNow IT Operations Implementation Specialist, you will execute our evolving Configuration Management Database (CMDB) strategy, governance, and infrastructure roadmap. You will build a foundational system from the ground up, engaging with CMDB product and data owners to navigate diverse viewpoints, establish clear standards, and foster a culture of data integrity. Your work will empower the organization with accurate, actionable insights into technology assets within a fast-paced, creative environment.

  • Architect & Execute: Lead the implementation of CMDB and CSDM strategies, including the definition of CI classes, attributes, dependencies, and service mapping approaches.
  • Configure & Customize: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of ServiceNow Discovery and Service Mapping, including MID servers, network/security settings, probes, patterns, and schedules.
  • Integrate & Automate: Build and maintain integrations via IntegrationHub, Service Graph Connectors, and scripted REST/SOAP APIs.
  • AI Innovation: Identify and implement high-impact opportunities for embedding GenAI and Agentic Workflows into IT Operations for alert analysis, remediation, and data anomaly detection.
  • Governance & Health: Oversee CMDB health maintenance, data normalization, and reconciliation processes to ensure a "self-healing" IT environment.
  • Collaborate: Act as a bridge between technical infrastructure and business stakeholders to translate complex operational challenges into scalable, AI-driven solutions.

What You Bring

  • ServiceNow Expertise: Deep technical proficiency in the ServiceNow platform, including base system data structures and ITOM Visibility solutions.
  • Technical Skillset: Advanced JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAjax, PowerShell, Business Rules, and Flow Designer.
    • Discovery: Expert-level knowledge of Discovery patterns, credentials, and error handling.
    • Frameworks: Strong understanding of ITSM, ITAM, VR, and ITIL (specifically CI and asset lifecycle management).
  • Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization (hypervisors, containerization), and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Data Mastery: Proven experience in data analysis, reporting, and complex data quality governance.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills with a track record of driving consensus across diverse teams.
  • Emerging Tech: Demonstrated experience integrating AI/ML-assisted features and Agentic Workflows to enhance team productivity.
What We Offer You

  • Great Company Culture. Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
  • Growth. As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.

  • Benefits. Medical, dental, vision, pension plan, employee stock purchase plan, commuter benefits, in-house wellness program, broad learning & development opportunities, a charitable giving platform with company match and more!
  • Perks. Fitness allowance, employee discount programs, free games & events, stocked pantries and the ability to earn up to $500+ per year for taking care of yourself and more.

However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

apply.title: ServiceNow Architect
apply.description:
Inclusion without Exception


Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an equal opportunity employer, and embraces diversity in race, nationality, ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability, neurodiversity, and sexual orientation, to create a workforce that reflects the societies we operate in. Our continued commitment to Culture and Diversity is reflected in our people stories across our workforce and implemented through equitable workplace policies and processes.


Tata Consultancy Services (BSE: 532540, NSE: TCS) is the technology partner of choice for industry-leading organizations worldwide. Since its inception in 1968, TCS has upheld the highest standards of innovation, engineering excellence and customer service.

It has set an aspiration to become the world's largest AI-led technology services company and is enabling its clients to transform themselves across the full AI stack, from infrastructure to intelligence.


Rooted in the heritage of the Tata Group, TCS is focused on creating long term value for its clients, its investors, its employees, and the community at large. With a highly skilled workforce spread across 56 countries and 194 service delivery centers across the world, the company has been recognized as a top employer in six continents. With the ability to rapidly apply and scale new technologies, the company has built long term partnerships with its clients. Many of these relationships have endured into decades and navigated every technology cycle, from mainframes in the 1970s to artificial intelligence today.


Key Responsibilities


  1. Lead end-to-end solution architecture for ServiceNow AIOps and IT operations transformation initiatives.
  2. Design AIOps architecture for event ingestion, correlation, alert prioritization, anomaly detection, service health, and operational intelligence.
  3. Architect integrations between ServiceNow and monitoring, observability, cloud, network, infrastructure, application, and third-party operational platforms.
  4. Define CMDB and service topology dependencies required to enable accurate event correlation, impact analysis, and service-aware operations.
  5. Design automated incident creation, enrichment, assignment, remediation, escalation, and closure workflows using ServiceNow capabilities.
  6. Translate business and operational requirements into high-level solution designs, data flows, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
  7. Define architectural standards for scalability, availability, performance, security, maintainability, monitoring, and platform governance.
  8. Review solution designs and technical implementations to ensure alignment with ServiceNow best practices and approved architecture.
  9. Collaborate with operations teams, SRE teams, infrastructure teams, application teams, security teams, developers, and enterprise architects to deliver integrated solutions.
  10. Identify technology risks, dependencies, integration constraints, data-quality issues, and operational impacts and define appropriate mitigation approaches.
  11. Develop and maintain architecture documents, integration specifications, architecture decision records, operational models, and reusable design patterns.
  12. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and architecture governance throughout implementation, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.


Additional Information for Competencies


  1. Demonstrated hands-on experience in ServiceNow architecture with deep expertise in AIOps, IT Operations Management, and enterprise service operations.
  2. Demonstrated understanding of ServiceNow ITOM capabilities including Event Management, Health Log Analytics, Discovery, Service Mapping, and operational intelligence.
  3. Experience designing AIOps solutions for event correlation, noise reduction, anomaly detection, service health monitoring, and proactive incident prevention.
  4. Demonstrated knowledge of CMDB, Common Service Data Model, service topology, Configuration Items, relationships, and service-aware monitoring.
  5. Experience integrating ServiceNow with enterprise monitoring, observability, cloud, network, infrastructure, application performance, and security platforms.
  6. Demonstrated understanding of REST and SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, web services, event ingestion, and enterprise integration patterns.

  8. Demonstrated knowledge of ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Major Incident, and operational workflows that interact with AIOps capabilities.

  • Collaborate with business leaders to create business capability models that align technology capabilities with business needs

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience as a senior domain architect or senior enterprise architect.

apply.title: Salesforce Architect
apply.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

We're looking for a Salesforce Architect to own the architecture of Lyft's commercial platform as it grows through acquisition. Reporting to the Manager, Sales Technology, you will define the target-state architecture across our Salesforce orgs, lead the consolidation of acquired-company CRM environments into Lyft's platform, and decide where data is unified versus federated. You'll work directly with Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Finance, Data, Privacy, and Legal partners to turn a reactive delivery function into a business enabler.

If you are a candidate who has the vision of what could be, who has the ability to cultivate relationships, and a belief in developing the skills and talents of others, then you may be the ideal person for this position.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive enterprise wide programs articulating program/project strategies on enabling technologies leveraging the Salesforce Platform.
  • Identify and drive the Lyft’s organizational needs for Salesforce foundations, define the business or technology architecture, plan how large projects will be delivered, oversee the solution design and implementation.
  • Effectively drive user experience and design strategies across Enterprise for platform adoption.
  • Advise and mentor diverse teams and product groups on resources in technical and functional delivery aspects at a program level, using influence and adaptive communication strategies.
  • Lead large cross-team system design discussions, offering alternate choices, trade-offs, and impact analysis with a focus on long-term solutions.
  • Provide guidance on application and integration development best practices, Enterprise Architecture standards, and functional/technical solution architecture, including environment management, testing of the Salesforce Platform.
  • Provide evidence-based design patterns for development of solutions on the Salesforce platform such as managed vs unmanaged packages, config vs low-code vs code, custom build vs native/appExchange offerrings.
  • Drive the adoption of best engineering development practices across multiple Salesforce Orgs and promote the creation of application and technical design documents that align with Salesforce best practices and seamless integration into Lyft's infrastructure.
  • Possess deep understanding of native Salesforce features and functionality, as well as the ability to model a role hierarchy, data model, and appropriate sharing mechanisms.
  • Identify and lead internal strategic initiatives to grow the salesforce adoption and return on investment and serve as an active contributor to engineering.
  • Identification and proactive management of risk areas across enterprise and commitment to seeing an issue through to complete resolution.
  • Lead assessment of architecture environment and requirements and design sound, scalable, and high-performing solutions on the Salesforce Platform that meet the Single Sign-on (SSO) requirements.
  • Lead the technical integration of acquired companies' CRM and GTM systems, including org strategy (consolidate vs. federate), data migration, deduplication and identity resolution, object and picklist harmonization, and decommissioning of legacy orgs.
  • Define and maintain the multi-org architecture and data model, including cross-org reporting, shared reference data, and territory/hierarchy design that survives each acquisition.
  • Own the integration architecture connecting Salesforce to middleware (Boomi, Workato) and the wider GTM stack, and re-platform acquired companies' equivalents onto Lyft standards.
  • Partner with Privacy, Legal, and Security on data residency, retention, and subject-rights requirements as newly acquired entities bring additional countries into scope.

Experience:

  • 8+ years building enterprise solutions on Salesforce, including hands-on work with the SOAP/REST, Bulk, Pub/Sub, Tooling, and Metadata APIs
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect and System Architect
  • Experience owning architecture across multiple Salesforce orgs, including at least one org consolidation, migration, or merge
  • Strong integration experience with Boomi, Workato, MuleSoft, or comparable middleware
  • Data management depth: SQL/RDBMS, structured and unstructured stores, large-scale data migration and matching/dedupe
  • CI/CD on the Salesforce platform (Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, or similar)
  • Experience transitioning Salesforce processes into agentic AI solutions
  • Preferred:
    • Experience with Salesforce Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud) for unifying or federating customer data across multiple orgs or acquired entities — zero-copy federation, harmonization to a canonical model, and identity resolution
    • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect
    • M&A carve-out or post-merger integration experience in a GTM/commercial systems context
    • Experience leading implementations across multiple countries with differing data-protection requirements
    • Familiarity with Tableau, Agentforce, or GenAI/agentic tooling on the platform

  • Mental health benefits
  • Family building benefits
  • Child care and pet benefits

The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service

This job is for a current vacancy.

The Role:

Are you a talented Salesforce Developer looking to join a growing development team within a quickly growing and transforming organization? At Medcan, we are building new digital experiences for our clients to help them live happier, healthier lives. You’ll be joining an award-winning team that’s passionate about health, well-being, and service. The Salesforce team strives to create sleek, innovative experiences leveraging the Salesforce platform and beyond. We are a hard-working, problem-solving group of supportive and inclusive teammates who can’t wait to meet you!

This role sits within the Technology Services Team – a multi-talented group of individuals supporting clients and employees end-to-end on leading healthcare and business management technology as well as cybersecurity and infrastructure. You’ll have an opportunity to engage with downstream systems including Workday, our EMR, and more. Of course, you’ll be hands-on across multiple Salesforce Clouds including Sales, Service, Health, and Experience Clouds.

As a Salesforce Developer on this team, you’ll get the chance to build multiple enterprise-level, custom Salesforce applications and hold a role as a key contributor to enabling our organizational transformation. You’ll have direct impacts on employee satisfaction and client happiness. If you’re as obsessed with creating great experiences as we are, you’ll fit right in.

We are growing, changing, and building rapidly, so you must be interested in driving organizational efficiencies and developing client-friendly, market-transforming digital experiences rooted in 1:1 CRM on the Salesforce Platform.

What You'll Do:

The Salesforce Developer (that’s you!) will be responsible for designing and implementing complex Salesforce solutions – including functional requirements, coding, support and agile team principles and leadership. This opportunity requires deep application development skills, writing and collaboration, and strong communication skills. The focus will be on creating and improving Salesforce products that enable our customers and enterprise users to be successful on the platform. This position will require working in a small team of individuals focused on core development tasks and collaborating with product owners. You’ll also have an opportunity to work with third-party developer teams when acceleration is required.

As the successful candidate you will…

  • Progressively learn the Medcan operations and the healthcare field more broadly.

  • Participate in storyboard and solution design sessions – recommend alternative approaches and best practices, define technical impact, and provide sizing estimates.

  • Design and build Interfaces between Salesforce Platform and other applications.
  • Provide support and administrative assistance to existing Salesforce Applications.
  • Participate in the estimation and timeline process.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Salesforce developers through code reviews, design guidance, troubleshooting support, and the promotion of development best practices, ensuring high-quality and maintainable solutions

  • SFDC Platform Developer I certification (minimum)
  • 7+ years of experience as a SF Developer with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Health Cloud, and Experience Cloud. Marketing Cloud experience a bonus.
  • Excellent overall development skills throughout the SDLC with a preference for Agile methodology.
  • Knowledge of Web Services, REST, XML and outbound messaging.
  • Development experience with Apex, Visualforce, webservices, Lightning components, Azure/.Net/Javascript competencies
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver well-structured and documented code.
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps tools (e.g. Salesforce DX, Git, Bitbucket, VsCode).
  • Experience working on and deploying complex enterprise level solutions.
  • Highly organized, deadline-driven individual with a “can do” attitude
  • Ability to support internal resources that require Salesforce education and support
  • You’re a people person, despite living in code. We’re looking for empathetic teammates who lead with kindness and positivity.

  • SFDC Platform Developer II certification, Platform App Builder, Service, Sales, or other consultant certifications.
  • Experience running dev/ops and release management
  • Experience in a technology company or start-up environment a plus
  • Experience interfacing with business and technical teams
  • UX/UI design training
  • Experience with ETL tools (at least one of: Dell Boomi, Azure, Informatica, Oracle Data Integrator, MS SSIS), data migration and data cleansing

  • Taking responsibility for client deliverables by leading engagements and teams to successful outcomes, focusing on supporting your team, client needs, and value creation;
  • Developing your technical and analytical expertise by delivering high-quality results on time and proactively identifying and resolving project issues;
  • Working with KPMG senior leaders to understand, improve, and integrate service offerings across operations;
  • Reviewing and approving detailed quality and testing strategies for targeted application teams;

  • Participating in quality review meetings;

  • Follow up on test results with the application teams involved;

Job Description

Ce que vous ferez :

Vous ferez le lien entre les besoins d’affaires et les capacités de Salesforce afin de proposer des solutions évolutives qui améliorent l’efficacité des ventes, l’expérience client et l’efficience opérationnelle. Vous dirigerez la définition des exigences, la conception des solutions et la livraison des améliorations dans le cadre d’initiatives liées au CRM, à l’automatisation et à l’activation de l’IA.

Plus Précisément, Vous

Analyse d’affaires et collecte des exigences – 40 %

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Ventes, Marketing, Service et Opérations pour identifier les besoins d’affaires et les traduire en exigences claires et exploitables.
  • Animer des ateliers pour définir les processus, les irritants et les opportunités d’amélioration.
  • Documenter les exigences d’affaires, les user stories et les critères d’acceptation.

Conception et mise en œuvre de solutions – 30 %

  • Travailler avec les administrateurs et développeurs Salesforce pour concevoir des solutions évolutives tirant parti des capacités de la plateforme.
  • Assurer l’alignement entre les objectifs d’affaires et la conception du système.
  • Soutenir les décisions de configuration liées aux flux de travail, à l’automatisation et aux intégrations intersystèmes , incluant la définition des flux de données et des interactions entre Salesforce et les plateformes connectées.
  • Définir et documenter les exigences d’intégration entre Salesforce et les systèmes en amont/aval.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe TI sur des modèles d’intégration évolutifs (API, middleware).

Optimisation et transformation Salesforce – 20 %

  • Diriger des initiatives visant à améliorer la visibilité du pipeline, la gestion des leads et les flux de travail des équipes de vente.
  • Soutenir les efforts de modernisation du CRM, incluant la consolidation des instances Salesforce et la rationalisation des intégrations, modèles de données et flux intersystèmes .
  • Contribuer au déploiement de capacités d’IA (ex. : nurturing automatisé, déviation des cas, prochaine meilleure action).

Rapports et optimisation – 10 %

  • Définir les besoins en matière de rapports et s’assurer que les tableaux de bord reflètent les KPI et les résultats d’affaires.

Technical Leadership & Advisory

Security, Data & Integration

Delivery & Operations

  • Advanced ServiceNow knowledge and experience delivering solutions in large, complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience in administration, configuration, development, integration, security, and release practices.
  • Practical knowledge of CMDB, CSDM, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, scripting, APIs, access controls, deployment, and automated testing.
  • Ability to evaluate complex issues from multiple perspectives and communicate recommendations clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ITOM, SPM, CSM, SecOps, IRM, HRSD, HAM, SAM, Now Assist, or AI Control Tower.

  • Experience in multi-instance, multi-vendor, or regulated enterprise environments.

Additional Requirements

  • Technical credibility and sound judgment.
  • Clear, concise, and professional communication.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Strong collaboration, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • A practical balance of innovation, governance, reliability, and speed.

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

Summary

Platform Administration
