apply.title: Senior Salesforce Developer / Admin
apply.description:
Req ID: 137318

Remote Position: Hybrid

Region: Americas

Country: Canada

State/Province: Ontario

City: Toronto

Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Salesforce Developer with strong Marketing Cloud expertise to join our Salesforce Center of Excellence. This is a hands-on solutioning and development role — the successful candidate will personally analyze requirements, design solutions, and build and implement them through configuration and code. Following the partner-led implementation of our Marketing Cloud platform, this role takes technical ownership of the delivered solution — maintaining and operating what has been built, reviewing the implementation against Salesforce best practices, ensuring long-term supportability, and solutioning and implementing ongoing enhancements directly. Marketing Cloud experience (Marketing Cloud Next, Data Cloud–native) is a must, and experience with CRM Analytics (CRMA) and Manufacturing Cloud Next is strongly preferred.

Detailed Description

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Personally solution and implement Salesforce changes end to end — analyze requirements, design the solution, and build it hands-on through configuration and code (Apex, Lightning Web Components, flows).
  • Serve as the technical lead and senior subject-matter authority for the Marketing Cloud platform, owning technical standards, design decisions, and the enhancement roadmap.
  • Take technical ownership of the partner-delivered Marketing Cloud solution — maintaining, operating, and continuously improving it once initial deployment by the external SI is complete.
  • Review the delivered implementation against Salesforce best practices, identify gaps or technical debt, and lead remediation to ensure the system is sound, scalable, and supportable.
  • Work hands-on in Marketing Cloud Next — building and maintaining segmentation, journeys, content, and activation natively on Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • Translate business requirements from stakeholders and the Business Transformation leader into technical designs, enhancements, and new capabilities focused on marketing engagement and customer data.
  • Operate and govern sending infrastructure: branded subdomains, domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), deliverability, and consent/preference management.
  • Maintain and enhance customer data flows and integrations between Marketing Cloud Next, Data Cloud, and source systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365).
  • Own and run a modern Salesforce DevOps practice using Gearset — version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, environment strategy, and metadata backup/restore.
  • Develop and maintain Apex, Lightning Web Components, flows, custom objects, fields, and validation rules according to evolving requirements, applying sound architectural and coding standards.
  • Define and enforce development standards, code-review practices, and organization-wide protocols for proper use of Salesforce across teams and partners.
  • Maintain system security including sharing rules, role hierarchies, and field-level security, and ensure all changes follow Celestica internal processes.
  • Evaluate and operationalize emerging Salesforce capabilities (including Agentforce / AI-assisted marketing), and lead seasonal release readiness across Marketing Cloud and connected clouds.
  • Where an external SI is engaged for new workstreams, provide technical oversight, quality-assure delivery, review SOWs, and hold partners to delivery and documentation standards.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

  • Proven experience as a Salesforce technical lead or senior developer — owning technical design, setting standards, and providing direction to teams and external partners.
  • Hands-on experience delivering and operating Salesforce Marketing Cloud is required, with Marketing Cloud Next strongly preferred (Data Cloud–native segmentation, journeys, and activation).
  • Practical experience with email/landing-page delivery, branded subdomain setup, domain authentication, deliverability, and consent/preference management.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer 1 (PD1) and Platform Developer 2 (PD2) certifications are preferred.
  • A Marketing Cloud certification (Administrator, Email Specialist, or Consultant) is required
  • Data Cloud certification is a strong plus.
  • Strong command of Salesforce architecture, security model, and development tools (Apex, Aura Components, SOQL, Lightning Web Components).
  • Proficiency in declarative automation tools (Flow Builder, Lightning App Builder, etc.).
  • Experience with DevOps processes (e.g., Agile) and tools such as Gearset, Azure DevOps, Copado, etc.
  • Experience with CRM Analytics (CRMA) and Manufacturing Cloud is strongly preferred.

Physical Demands

  • Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
  • Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Salary

The stated range includes Base Salary and target Short-Term Incentive (STI) compensation only. A comprehensive benefits package is offered in addition to this range.

The range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including but not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

Salary: Base Salary + Incentive = 109,000.00 - 173,000.00 CAD

Typical Experience

  • 8+ years of Salesforce experience with a proven track record in platform solution design, development, and administration, including senior/lead responsibility.
  • Hands-on Marketing Cloud delivery experience, ideally including Marketing Cloud Next / Data Cloud.
  • Experience leading or coordinating external SIs and implementation partners.
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Gearset, Azure DevOps, Copado, etc.).

Typical Education

  • Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Notes

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

Celestica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.

Company Overview

Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages.

Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC):

ATS: This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions.

CCS: This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth.

Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.

We use artificial intelligence tools to assist in screening and assessing applications for this role. All hiring decisions involve human review.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.

Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

apply.title: Senior Manager, Salesforce Engineering
apply.description:
Requisition ID: 275778

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Salesforce Engineering to lead the strategy, delivery, and evolution of our Salesforce platform across multiple business lines. You’ll own the engineering roadmap, govern platform standards, and lead multiple squads to deliver secure, scalable, and high quality solutions in a regulated environment.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

  • Own the Salesforce engineering strategy and multi year roadmap; align with enterprise architecture, business priorities, and modernization plans.
  • Govern development standards (coding, security, accessibility, reuse), lifecycle practices, and platform operating model across squads.
  • Drive platform scalability, performance, observability, and resilience; ensure alignment with risk, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Manage platform portfolio, capacity planning, and release calendars across multiple Salesforce clouds.
  • Ensure timely, high quality delivery of program milestones while adhering to SDLC, change management, and regulatory controls.
  • Orchestrate cross team dependencies (product, architecture, data, integration, QA, DevOps), remove blockers, and manage risks with clear mitigation plans.
  • Lead technical discussions; influence solution design, integration strategy, and make pragmatic build vs buy recommendations.
  • Oversee code quality through standards enforcement, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders (Directors/VPs) across multiple business lines; prepare executive updates and clear decision packs.
  • Manage vendor/partner relationships, SOWs, and delivery performance for supported solutions and accelerators.
  • Lead and grow high performing Salesforce squads (potentially 2–3 pods, ~8–15 FTE/contractors); build career paths and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement; coach and mentor engineers, leads, and admins.
  • Define and track engineering KPIs (velocity, change failure rate, defect escape, MTTR, release stability, test coverage, platform health).
  • Drive proof of concepts/pilots and evaluate emerging Salesforce capabilities (e.g., Einstein AI, Data Cloud, OmniStudio, Flow Orchestration).
  • Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, retire technical debt, and scale re usable components, APIs, and patterns.
  • Stay current with industry best practices; where relevant, monitor adjacent trends (e.g., distributed ledgers) for future applicability.
  • Embed the Bank’s risk appetite and controls in day to day engineering decisions.
  • Ensure secure configurations, data governance, auditability, and compliance with change, access, and separation of duties policies.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

  • 8+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years hands on on the Salesforce platform (Sales, Service, Experience, or Financial Services Cloud).
  • 5+ years leading engineering teams/squads (manager/lead role), including coaching, performance, and hiring; experience leading multiple pods is an asset.
  • Proven delivery of complex Salesforce programs across design, build, test, and implementation in a regulated environment.
  • Strong grasp of Apex, LWC, Visualforce, SOQL; familiarity with integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, event driven, middleware).
  • Experience with API driven, microservice oriented architectures and integrating Salesforce with enterprise platforms.
  • Demonstrated excellence in SDLC governance, change management, version control (Git), CI/CD automation, code quality, and automated testing.
  • Cross functional leadership with product, architecture, risk, compliance, security, and operations.
  • Ability to set engineering KPIs, interpret metrics, and drive continuous improvement.
  • At least one current Salesforce certification (to be verified) from:
  • o Salesforce Developer I or II
  • o Salesforce Platform App Builder
  • o Salesforce Administrator
  • o Salesforce Architect (Application/System/Overall)
  • o Sales Cloud Consultant (or Service Cloud Consultant)
  • Experience with nCino and/or implementation in financial services.
  • Exposure to multiple Salesforce clouds (e.g., Experience, Marketing, Financial Services Cloud).
  • Knowledge of Einstein AI, Data Cloud, OmniStudio, Flow Orchestration.
  • Background managing vendor solutions and optimizing cost/performance.
  • Experience managing an engineering operating budget.
  • SAFe/Agile leadership certification (e.g., SA, SASM, PAL).

What's in it for you?

  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
  • Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
  • Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
  • Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
  • Dynamic Ecosystem - Free tea & coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.
  • Community Engagement - No matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

apply.title: Salesforce Developer
apply.description:
Aperçu

Who You Are At Panasonic Canada

Panasonic Canada Inc. is currently looking to hire for the position of Salesforce Developer.

Designs, develops, and supports Salesforce solutions that enhance business processes, system performance, and the overall user experience. Collaborates with business stakeholders, administrators, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce configurations and custom solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, integrations, and other platform capabilities. Supports enterprise integrations, testing, deployments, release management, and change control activities to ensure system reliability and the successful delivery of enhancements.

Focuses on platform optimization through performance monitoring, data quality management, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance. Serves as a technical resource for complex Salesforce issues, providing support and guidance to users and administrators. Assists in the creation of technical documentation, knowledge articles, and training materials, while ensuring all solutions comply with Salesforce security standards, governance policies, and development best practices. Continuously identifies opportunities to improve platform functionality, efficiency, scalability, and innovation.

This is a contract role for 12 months.

This position is hybrid. Any office-based work will be performed from our Mississauga office at Ambler Drive and occasional attendance is required at our Niagara-on-the-Lake office.

Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Canada at the time of application. Please note, Panasonic Canada Inc. does not offer sponsorship to individuals for the purpose of obtaining temporary work permit/visa or permanent residency.

Responsabilités

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborates with business stakeholders, Salesforce Administrators, and technical teams to gather requirements and design scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Develops and configures Salesforce functionality using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, approval processes, custom objects, and validation rules.
  • Supports and enhances Experience Cloud solutions to improve user experience and business processes.
  • Applies declarative and programmatic development approaches in accordance with Salesforce best practices and standards.
  • Develops and supports integrations between Salesforce and internal/external systems to ensure reliable data exchange and business continuity.
  • Executes and supports unit, system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT), including the creation and maintenance of Apex test classes.
  • Supports release management activities, including packaging, deployment automation, change promotion, production releases, and post-deployment validation.
  • Maintains platform security and compliance through role hierarchies, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, field-level security, object-level security, and secure coding practices.
  • Monitors platform performance, data integrity, automation effectiveness, integrations, and governor limits; supports data imports, exports, migrations, deduplication, and quality initiatives.
  • Serves as an escalation point for complex Salesforce issues, provides technical guidance and documentation, supports user adoption and training, evaluates new platform capabilities, and provides backup support to the Salesforce Administrator.

Qualifications

MUST-HAVES:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of Salesforce solution delivery experience supporting medium-to-large, complex projects, including 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I certification required; Platform Developer II certification is considered an asset.
  • Additional required Salesforce certifications include Salesforce Certified Administrator and Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder.
  • Strong functional and technical expertise in Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Salesforce CPQ, with proficiency in Salesforce configuration and platform capabilities.
  • Advanced experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, SOQL/SOSL, triggers, custom objects, validation rules, and platform configuration.
  • Experience evaluating business requirements, troubleshooting complex issues, and designing scalable, secure, maintainable Salesforce solutions using both declarative and custom development approaches.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, end users, administrators, project managers, and technical teams; proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Visio required. Experience with Marketing Cloud, MuleSoft and other iPaaS integrations, and Amazon Connect or other Salesforce-integrated telephony solutions is considered an asset.

What You’ll Earn

The hourly wage range for this position is $50.00 - $58.00 CAD.

Actual compensation offered to the selected incumbent will vary depending on the individual’s knowledge, skills and experience related to the role.

HYBRID WORK MODEL

Panasonic Canada Inc. supports a hybrid work model. We understand that flexibility is essential for employees to do their best work while also balancing personal and life needs. Employees can expect to be in the office for a variable number of days per week based on the needs of the business unit, while having the ability to also work remote.

Panasonic Canada Inc. offers a Flexible Work Options policy which includes the ability to work remote, mobile, and create a compressed work schedule.

Who We Are

Meet Panasonic! Panasonic Canada Inc., a subsidiary of Panasonic Corporation of North America, is a leading provider of Consumer Lifestyle technologies, as well as innovative Smart Mobility, Sustainable Energy, Immersive Experiences, and Integrated Supply Chain solutions for its business and government clients. Panasonic is creating technologies that move us.

At Panasonic Canada, we do more than just offer great products and solutions. We pride ourselves in promoting gender and culture equality, as well as encouraging personal growth and success to elevate our 350+ employees to their full potential. Their passion has been one of the driving forces behind our success for more than 100 years.

How To Apply

Please include a PDF copy of your current resume.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use automated or artificial intelligence-based tools to assist with sourcing and identifying potential candidates. These tools are used to support, not replace, human decision making.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION AT PANASONIC CANADA, INC.

In order to drive our business to continued heights, our business practices and our contribution to society must be rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion. We foster an environment in which everyone is able to share their voice and talents, in a safe space, where they have the opportunity and resources to fully realize their potential. We are therefore committed to developing and realizing programs, tools and processes that ensure a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment for our employees.

AODA POLICY

Panasonic Canada Inc. has an accommodation process in place and provides accommodations for job applicants with disabilities as appropriate. Assessment and selection materials and procedures can be made available in accessible formats and methods as appropriate. If you require a specific accommodation because of disability or medical need, please let us know when selected to take part in our recruitment process so that reasonable arrangements can be made for the appropriate accommodations to be in place as you move through our process.

Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

We thank you for your interest in working for Panasonic Canada Inc.

apply.title: Salesforce Solution Architect
apply.description:
About The Role

As a Salesforce Solution Architect, you will make an impact by defining and delivering end-to-end Salesforce solutions that align with business strategy and enterprise-wide technology standards. You will be a valued member of our Salesforce practice and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, development teams, and program leadership to ensure the successful delivery of complex, scalable Salesforce implementations with a strong focus on Financial Services Cloud (FSC) and industry clouds.

Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead end-to-end Salesforce architecture across the Salesforce Platform, Service Cloud, Financial Services Cloud (FSC), and industry clouds — including mapping out-of-the-box solutions to business requirements within Salesforce FSC Claims.
  • Design and deliver scalable, best-practice solutions leveraging Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Integration APIs, Platform Events, and Salesforce-native capabilities.
  • Architect enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, MuleSoft, middleware, and event-driven patterns, ensuring seamless connectivity across the technology landscape.
  • Establish governance frameworks, including data architecture, security models, DevOps strategies, and deployment pipelines, to underpin reliable and compliant solution delivery.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development and delivery teams, while conducting architecture reviews, technical assessments, and solution design workshops with both internal and client stakeholders.

Work Model

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Toronto, ON. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • Proven experience as a Salesforce Solution Architect or Senior Technical Lead, with a strong track record of delivering end-to-end Salesforce implementations at enterprise scale.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Service Cloud, and Salesforce Platform — including FSC Claims, data models, and industry-specific configuration.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and build integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, MuleSoft, middleware technologies, and event-driven architecture patterns.
  • Strong command of Salesforce development technologies, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Platform Events, with the ability to evaluate build-vs-configure trade-offs.
  • Experience establishing data architecture, security models, DevOps practices, and deployment strategies for complex Salesforce programs, including governance and compliance considerations.

These Will Help You Stand Out

  • Active Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect, System Architect, or CTA (Certified Technical Architect).
  • Experience working in or architecting solutions for the Financial Services or Insurance industry, particularly in claims or policy management domains.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) and the ability to translate architectural decisions into executive-level communication.
  • Proven ability to lead solution design workshops and technical assessments with both business and IT stakeholders in large-scale transformation programs.
  • Experience in a consulting or professional services environment, working across multiple client engagements simultaneously.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Salary And Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $138K - $160K depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

apply.title: Senior Salesforce Developer
apply.description:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

Our Salesforce org is the system of record for how Docebo sells, renews and serves customers. It carries CPQ, document generation, e-signature, provisioning and billing integrations, and a growing set of AI-driven workflows. The team that runs it is small, senior, and split between Canada and Italy. We've spent this year putting real structure behind it: a formal development lifecycle, a definition of ready for every ticket, a security standard for integrations, and a hardening program that is cleaning up years of accumulated access.

We're adding a senior developer to carry that forward. You'll build on the platform every week, but you'll also be one of the people the rest of the team turns to when a design needs a second opinion, a connected app needs scrutiny, or a request needs someone to say "not like that, and here's why."

⚡ The Day-to-Day

  • Design and build. Deliver production-quality solutions in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow and platform configuration, from a clear problem statement through solution design, build, test and release. You'll work the full lifecycle, not just the ticket in front of you.
  • Integration security and governance. Review every new or changed integration against our integration security standard: connected app scopes, OAuth and token lifecycle, dedicated Okta-provisioned integration users, least-privilege permission sets. You'll push back on anything that asks for more access than it needs and document the decision.
  • Code and design review. Act as a reviewer for the team's pull requests and solution designs. Hold the line on maintainability, test coverage, deployment readiness and SOX-relevant change controls, and give feedback people can act on.
  • Platform health. Own a share of the technical-debt and hardening backlog: retiring unused automation, consolidating permission models, cleaning up legacy packages and integration users, and reducing the org's risk surface one deliberate change at a time.
  • Access and provisioning backstop. Be a point person for user activation, license allocation and permission assignment, and help move that work from manual cloning toward documented roles and automation.
  • Delivery partnership. Work directly with Revenue Operations, Finance, Marketing and Customer Success on scoping, and with the team's administrators and QA partner on testing and release. Take part in the daily check-in and the biweekly backlog and capacity review.
  • AI in the day-to-day. Use AI tooling to move faster on triage, documentation and build, and apply the judgment to validate what it produces before it ships. We care about both halves.

🌟 Your Superpowers

  • Deep hands-on Salesforce development. Several years shipping Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow and integrations (REST, platform events, middleware) in a production org with real users and real release discipline.
  • A security mindset. You understand connected apps, OAuth scopes, permission sets, profiles and integration users well enough to spot a risky configuration and explain the fix. You treat "valid until revoked" as a problem, not a default.
  • Review experience. You've reviewed other engineers' code and designs and know how to be direct and useful at the same time.
  • Comfort in a governed environment. SOX controls, structured deployment windows, mandatory UAT, a source-control-backed deployment pipeline (we use Gearset and GitLab).
  • Clear communication in English, written and spoken, with technical and non-technical stakeholders. You can explain a trade-off to a VP and a defect to a developer.
  • Independence and judgment. You scope your own work, ask for clarity early, and don't wait to be told that a request is under-specified.
  • Working hours that overlap the team. Our daily check-in runs at 09:30 Eastern / 15:30 Central European; you'll need to be reliably available for it from either location.

🎯 Bonus Points

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II, Application Architect or Integration Architect certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud, Conga or similar document generation, DocuSign, or a billing migration (we're moving billing to NetSuite).
  • Experience with Slack, Okta, Fivetran or Datadog as they relate to a Salesforce org.
  • Exposure to Data Cloud or Agentforce.
  • Italian language skills, or prior experience on a team split across North American and European time zones.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

  • Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.
  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You 😍

  • Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.
  • Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.
  • Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!
  • Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!
  • Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law.

As a federal contractor, Docebo is committed to the principles of affirmative action and equal employment opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Docebo does not discriminate because of protected veteran status or on the basis of disability, and Docebo takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

  • Have many careers in one Firm.
  • Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
  • Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

What will your typical day look like?

As a Senior Manager in our ServiceNow managed services business, you will lead the delivery of ongoing application management services for one or more of our clients. You will be accountable for building trusted client relationships, providing leadership to our delivery teams, and making sure we consistently deliver on our commitments.

You will work closely with client executives and operational leaders to understand their priorities, assess how their ServiceNow environment is performing, and identify opportunities to improve service quality, platform adoption and business outcomes. You will lead regular service reviews, communicate progress, manage issues and risks, and provide practical recommendations that help clients get more value from their investment in ServiceNow. Finding ways to innovate and bring additional value to your clients will be a key factor to your success.

You will manage Deloitte’s people, processes, and commercial performance of your engagements. This includes building effective teams, developing and coaching our personnel, ensuring high quality delivery practices, managing financial performance, and ensuring that contractual commitments are understood and met. When challenges arise, you will bring the right people together, help the team work through the problem and maintain clear, open communication with the client.

You will also play a meaningful role in growing our ServiceNow business. You will identify opportunities with existing and prospective clients, shape managed services solutions, lead proposals and presentations, and work with your colleagues to bring the best of Deloitte to the market.

Beyond individual client engagements, you will contribute to the development of our practice. This may include evolving our delivery methods and service offerings, developing reusable assets, supporting recruitment, building alliances and internal relationships, contributing to market perspectives, and strengthening our ServiceNow community across Canada and globally.

No two days will be exactly the same. You can expect a role that is highly collaborative, client-facing and commercially focused, with the opportunity to lead important services, develop talented teams and help shape a growing part of our business. Your role will include both managing service delivery, and pursuing sales opportunities.

About The Team

This is an opportunity to join Deloitte’s ServiceNow managed services practice. We help clients run, maintain and continually improve their ServiceNow platforms after implementation, combining deep platform knowledge with strong service management, industry and business experience.

Our work goes beyond keeping the platform operational. We work alongside our clients to improve how services are delivered, respond to changing business needs, introduce new capabilities and create sustained value from ServiceNow. Our teams bring together functional, technical, industry and service delivery skills to support complex organizations and their users.

You will be part of a collaborative Canadian practice connected to Deloitte’s broader national and global capabilities. You will work with leaders and specialists across service lines, industries and geographies to develop solutions that are practical, scalable and tailored to each client.

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

You are someone who has these skills, experience & qualifications:

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, managing, selling, architecting and delivering ServiceNow services.
  • Experience leading ServiceNow managed services, application support. Experience across both ServiceNow implementation and ongoing support environments is a plus.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, including resources working across multiple locations and delivery centers, with an ability to grow a high-performance team through coaching and development.
  • Strong client relationship skills and experience working directly with senior business and technology clients. Ability to develop long-term trusted advisor relationships.
  • Demonstrated success in business development and sales, including identifying opportunities, shaping solutions, developing proposals and statements of work, participating in RFP responses, and presenting managed services offerings to clients.
  • Experience managing the commercial aspects of managed services engagements, including contracts, service levels, financial performance, and resource planning.
  • Travel within Canada will be required from time to time.

It would be great for you to have some of these nice to haves as well:

  • ServiceNow certifications are desirable, as well as ITIL certifications, but not required for this position.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence, particularly in ServiceNow, is a strong asset but is not required for this position.
  • Bilingualism in English and French is considered a strong asset but is not required for this position.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $97,000 - $234,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. It takes a society to take on cancer – and the Canadian Cancer Society is leading the way

MAKING AN IMPACT

We are seeking a hands-on Salesforce Platform and AI Engineer to design, build, and scale secure, data-driven solutions that advance CCS’s mission. This role combines Salesforce development, data modeling, integration, automation, and applied AI to deliver intelligent workflows, applications, and enterprise capabilities using technologies such as Agentforce, Einstein, large language models, and other Salesforce AI tools.

What You’ll Be Doing

Technical Leadership for AI-Driven Solutions

  • Manage and build AI-driven Salesforce solutions, including Agentforce, Einstein, LLM-enabled workflows, automation, and predictive or recommendation features.
  • Develop AI-enabled capabilities using Apex, Flow, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, custom objects, data models, permission sets, and integration services.
  • Oversee architecture and engineering decisions to ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned to enterprise standards, responsible AI, and least-privilege access.
  • Translate business opportunities into technical designs, prototypes, and production-ready Salesforce, API, data, automation, and AI solutions.
  • Guide teams through design, Apex and Flow development, code review, testing, release, deployment, and support of AI-enabled solutions.
  • Evaluate and operationalize emerging AI technologies, Salesforce AI capabilities, APIs, and integrations that improve productivity, scalability, and business value.

Integration, Data Architecture & Platform Engineering

  • Partner with data engineering to support Salesforce data pipelines and ensure APIs, data models, permissions, integrations, and platform services securely consume enterprise data for AI-enabled workflows.
  • Define data models, custom objects, metadata, automation, and integration patterns for AI workflows, real-time data access, model connectivity, and scalable Salesforce delivery.
  • Ensure data and integration designs support secure, governed, reliable AI use, including access controls, data quality, privacy, and least-privilege permissions.
  • Recommend Salesforce capabilities, API patterns, data services, and architecture approaches that improve AI performance, maintainability, scalability, and business value.

Platform Engineering and DevOps

  • Support Salesforce change management, including release planning, environment strategy, deployment readiness, impact assessment, rollback planning, and environment coordination.
  • Improve Salesforce DevOps practices, CI/CD, source control, automated testing, code quality checks, metadata deployments, and release governance.
  • Set development standards for Apex, Flow, LWC, APIs, integrations, configuration, and AI-enabled platform capabilities.
  • Use AI-assisted automation to improve update analysis, testing, documentation, release notes, regression review, and operational support.

Other

  • Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Salesforce development experience in complex enterprise environments, including technical leadership across solution design, development, integrations, and releases.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong Salesforce development expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Flow, asynchronous processing, and declarative automation.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce architecture, data modeling, security, APIs, integration patterns, and platform services.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise applications and services using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and secure integration practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, source control, automated testing, release management, and environment governance.
  • Knowledge of AI-enabled solutions, including generative AI, AI agents, prompt design, and AI-assisted workflows, with an understanding of responsible AI and data privacy standards.
  • Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder, Data Cloud, or similar AI technologies.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and work in partnership with business, analytics, data engineering, security, and technology teams.
  • Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform Developer I/II, Platform App Builder, Architect certifications) are considered an asset.
  • Experience in nonprofit, fundraising, healthcare, or other mission-driven organizations is an asset.
  • Bilingualism (French/English) is highly preferred, with French being an asset due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions.
  • Others may apply.

Our inspiring culture is rooted in our core values and commitment to meaningful change:

COURAGEOUS UNITED CARING RIGOROUS

apply.title: Senior Associate SIEM Implementation
apply.description:
At PwC, our people in cybersecurity focus on protecting organisations from cyber threats through advanced technologies and strategies. They work to identify vulnerabilities, develop secure systems, and provide proactive solutions to safeguard sensitive data. As a cybersecurity generalist at PwC, you will focus on providing comprehensive security solutions and experience across various domains, maintaining the protection of client systems and data. You will apply a broad understanding of cybersecurity principles and practices to address diverse security challenges effectively.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Associate SIEM Implementation, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:

  • Lead technical deliverables for SIEM implementation and operations including Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Palo Alto XSIAM, and Devo.
  • Perform Proof of Concept (PoC) and Proof of Value (PoV) engagements to evaluate SIEM capabilities and demonstrate value to stakeholders.
  • Conduct SIEM assessments to identify gaps, recommend improvements, and align with security best practices.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines for log ingestion, normalization, and enrichment across cloud and on-prem environments.
  • Integrate log sources using connectors, custom scripts, and parsers to ensure complete visibility and compatibility with SIEM platforms.
  • Build use cases aligned with NIST and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks to enable detection at various stages of a cyber-attack.
  • Implement detection rules using SPL/KQL with complex correlation across different data sources.
  • Develop dashboards, alerts, and workbooks for security monitoring and reporting.
  • Implement SOAR workflows using Logic Apps, Phantom, Demisto, and XSOAR platforms.
  • Perform health checks, tuning, and optimization of SIEM platforms to ensure high performance and accuracy.
  • Create and maintain documentation including SOPs, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and onboarding guides.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including SOC, threat hunters, infrastructure, and cloud teams to support delivery and ensure quality standards.
  • Lead technical deliverables for SIEM implementation and security operations engagements, including log source onboarding, parser development, SIEM content deployment through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, detection use case implementation, and operational readiness activities.
  • Develop and support custom integrations to SIEM platforms, especially Microsoft Sentinel and Google SecOps, including scripts, APIs, parsers, data transformation logic, and data pipeline management activities such as DataBahn.
  • Apply AI capabilities in a security-focused manner to improve detection engineering, content optimization, operational efficiency, and analytical outcomes while maintaining strong security and governance awareness.

What You'll Bring

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Palo Alto XSIAM, Devo, and Splunk.
  • Strong understanding of SIEM architecture, implementation, integration, log management, and threat detection methodologies.
  • Experience in developing and tuning security use cases and alerts.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, and Bash for automation and data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms including Azure, GCP, and AWS.
  • Knowledge of data pipeline tools including Cribl for log routing, enrichment, and deduplication.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and integration of third-party security tools.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms and playbook development for incident response automation.
  • Understanding of security concepts such as cyber-attacks, threat vectors, risk management, and incident management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and client engagement skills.
  • Experience deploying SIEM content through CI/CD practices using GitHub, including version control, peer review, change tracking, and structured promotion of content across environments.
  • Experience managing security data pipelines and ingestion workflows, including data transformation, normalization, troubleshooting, and platforms or capabilities such as DataBahn.
  • Strong understanding of AI concepts and tools, with the ability to apply them in security-oriented use cases such as detection improvement, threat analysis, automation support, and security operations optimization.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook, with the ability to create polished client-facing documents, trackers, presentations, and meeting outputs.
  • PwC Canada is committed to cultivating an inclusive, hybrid work environment. Exact expectations for your team can be discussed with your interviewer.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
  • Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate, SC-200, AZ-500, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CISM, GIAC.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in SIEM implementation and security operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple client engagements.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and adapting to evolving cybersecurity technologies.
  • Experience in a consulting, client delivery, or professional services environment is preferred.

This newly created role reflects our commitment to growth and delivering distinctive value for our clients and stakeholders.

The salary range for this position is $84,700 - $134,700. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. Our Purpose

R8dius is an Indigenous majority-owned professional services, technology implementation and managed services business. We are united by the goal of forging a new path for all of us to walk and prosper together.

It’s a rare thing when you get to help build the future. But that’s every day at R8dius. We’re working to turn R8dius into a meeting place, enabled by our shared purpose, where we can learn and grow together.

Our purpose is to “Widen the Circle”, or in other words, to expand the horizons of opportunity and prosperity so that Indigenous Peoples can be leaders in the professional services space. By living our Purpose, together we will make an impact that matters.

  • Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching
  • Be encouraged to deepen your technical skills…whatever those may be.
  • Partner with diverse clients to solve their most complex problems
  • Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
  • Work in an agile work environment where work is what you do not where you do it

What will your typical day look like?

You will support the delivery of Application Security engagements across leading enterprise platforms, including Workday, Oracle, SAP, SuccessFactors, and Salesforce. Working alongside experienced practitioners, you will help clients strengthen their security posture by assessing application security risks, evaluating configurations and access controls, and supporting the delivery of practical, risk-based recommendations.

You will contribute to high-quality client service through collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to delivering exceptional results. In addition to client engagements, you will support practice development initiatives, thought leadership activities, and the growth of R8dius’ Application Security capabilities.

You will have the following responsibilities:

  • Support the delivery of application security assessments, reviews, and advisory engagements across cloud-based enterprise applications, including Workday, Oracle, SAP, SuccessFactors, and Salesforce.
  • Assess application security risks, access management processes, segregation of duties (SoD) conflicts, and configuration-related security concerns, and contribute to remediation recommendations.
  • Collaborate with clients and project teams to design and enhance application security, governance, and access control frameworks.
  • Analyze information, document findings, and develop clear, concise reports and presentations for both technical and business audiences.
  • Support security role design, user access management, governance, and compliance initiatives across enterprise applications.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and colleagues through proactive communication, collaboration, and professionalism.
  • Continuously expand your knowledge of application security, identity and access management, emerging technologies, and industry-leading practices to support client needs and enhance project delivery.

About The Team

R8dius’ Cyber Application Security team helps organizations protect their most critical business applications and data. We work with clients across a variety of industries to identify security risks, strengthen governance, and enhance security capabilities across leading enterprise platforms, including Workday, Oracle, SAP, SuccessFactors, and Salesforce.

Our team combines expertise in Application Security, GRC Access Controls, Business Process Controls, and Cloud Security to help clients address complex security and compliance challenges while enabling secure digital transformation.

As part of this team, you will collaborate with experienced practitioners across Canada, contribute to impactful client engagements, and support the development of innovative security solutions and thought leadership. You'll have the opportunity to grow your technical and consulting skills while helping organizations build secure and resilient business operations.

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

As an Analyst,

You are curious, motivated, and passionate about cybersecurity, with a desire to build your career in application security and enterprise technology. You enjoy solving complex problems, collaborating with others, and continuously learning in a fast-paced consulting environment.

You bring:

  • Self-identifies as First Nations (Status or Non-Status), Inuit, or Métis in Canada.
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, Business Technology Management, or a related field.
  • Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity and application security principles, including identity and access management, role-based security, access controls, and risk management concepts.
  • Familiarity with enterprise applications such as Oracle, SAP, Workday, SuccessFactors, Salesforce, or similar platforms is an asset.
  • An understanding of governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) concepts, including Segregation of Duties (SoD), user access management, and security governance, or a strong willingness to learn.

apply.title: Solutions Architect - 6 month contract
apply.description:
Role Summary

The Solution Architect leads the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise business systems that support Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Manufacturing, and Project Management functions across Modern Niagara. This role translates business requirements into scalable technology solutions, establishes architectural standards, and ensures business applications, integrations, automation solutions, and data platforms align with organizational objectives and long-term technology strategy. In addition to owning the architecture and roadmap for Epicor ERP, this role is responsible for designing and supporting Power Platform solutions, developing automation through Python scripting, and enabling enterprise application solutions and integrations across Azure and SharePoint technologies.

This role supports both Modern Niagara and Airwise. The successful candidate may be based anywhere within the GTA but must be available to attend the Vaughan and Hamilton offices as business needs require.

Why This Role Matters to Modern Niagara

Epicor ERP is a critical platform supporting finance, supply chain, manufacturing, field operations, and project delivery. This role ensures the platform remains scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business needs while reducing reliance on external consultants and enabling long-term operational efficiency through strong architecture, governance, automation, and integration practices. The role also supports Modern Niagara’s broader digital transformation by introducing scalable business applications and automation solutions that streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and improve productivity across the organization.

Key Impact / Purpose

  • Own the end-to-end architecture, governance, and roadmap for the Epicor ERP ecosystem.
  • Drive business value through scalable ERP configurations, integrations, customizations, Power Platform applications, automation solutions, and data solutions.
  • Support operational excellence by ensuring reliable, secure, and maintainable ERP processes and technologies.
  • Design and deliver Power Platform solutions and automation initiatives that improve business efficiency and reduce manual processes.
  • Support enterprise applications and integrations across Azure and SharePoint environments.
  • Bridge business stakeholders, implementation partners, and technical teams to deliver effective solutions.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture for Epicor ERP, including configuration, customization, security, environment management, and extension strategy.
  • Lead or support Epicor implementations, upgrades, and migrations from discovery and requirements gathering through go-live and post-implementation support.
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications and provide recommendations on configuration, customization, and third-party solutions.
  • Design and oversee integrations between Epicor and enterprise systems, including Azure services, middleware platforms, Power Platform, analytics environments, and other business applications.
  • Develop and maintain Epicor customizations using BPM workflows, Epicor Functions, Kinetic UI Customization, Application Studio, BAQs, reporting tools, and APIs.
  • Define and manage Epicor data architecture, including master data management, reporting strategies, data migration, and downstream data consumption.
  • Partner with Data, Analytics, Integration, and Infrastructure teams to ensure reliable and governed data flows.
  • Establish architectural standards, governance practices, security frameworks, change management processes, and environment strategies.
  • Act as the escalation point for complex Epicor technical issues and work directly with Epicor Support, implementation partners, and vendors.
  • Mentor analysts and developers on Epicor best practices, development standards, and solution design.
  • Evaluate the impact of system upgrades, new modules, third-party applications, and enhancement opportunities.
  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, technical standards, diagrams, runbooks, and decision records.
  • Design, develop, and maintain Power Apps and Power Automate solutions that support business process improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Develop and support Python-based scripts, automation solutions, integrations, and data workflows.
  • Support Azure-based services, cloud integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
  • Support and enhance SharePoint-based solutions, workflows, and collaboration capabilities.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and reduced manual effort.

Must Haves:

  • Hands-on experience with Epicor ERP.
  • Experience leading or supporting at least one full-cycle Epicor implementation, upgrade, or migration.
  • Strong knowledge of Epicor modules, including Financials, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Order Management, Inventory, Purchasing, Production Management, and Project Billing.
  • Experience with Epicor customization tools, including BPM, Method Directives, Data Directives, Epicor Functions, Kinetic UI Customization, Application Studio, BAQs, and reporting tools.
  • Understanding of Epicor data architecture, including tables, relationships, custom fields, and reporting structures.
  • Experience managing Epicor environments, upgrades, and deployment strategies.
  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to perform data analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting development.
  • Experience with C#/.NET development and API-based integrations.
  • Experience designing and supporting integrations with enterprise systems and middleware platforms.
  • Knowledge of REST APIs, SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, and modern integration patterns.
  • Experience designing or developing solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Experience with Python scripting, automation, or workflow development.
  • Experience supporting Azure services, cloud-based technologies, or enterprise integrations.
  • Strong business analysis, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Excellent documentation and technical writing skills.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working within the construction industry is considered a strong asset.
  • Epicor certifications.
  • Experience with Azure services, including Azure SQL, Logic Apps, Data Factory, and Entra ID.
  • Experience supporting or configuring SharePoint solutions and environments.
  • Experience with Epicor Data Fabric, Data Lake, Power BI, or modern analytics platforms.
  • Experience with EDI integrations.
  • Experience with asset management or maintenance management systems.
  • Experience with QuickBooks migrations or integrations.
  • Experience working within manufacturing, distribution, or other project-based organizations.
  • Previous experience as a Solution Architect, ERP Manager, Principal Consultant, or ERP Technical Lead.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

This is a new position. Expected annual compensation; $115,000 - $140,000.

Modern Niagara offers a competitive total compensation package including:

  • Performance based bonus opportunities.
  • Defined Contribution Pension Plan with a generous employer contribution
  • Flexible Health and Dental benefits with tiered options to meet the needs of you and your family
  • An annual health spending account to support your overall wellness
  • 24/7 confidential support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program with access to comprehensive resources and professional services
  • A competitive vacation package with additional vacation granted throughout your tenure with the organization.
  • Employer Paid Parental Leave Top Up
  • Annual Community Day dedicated to volunteering and giving back to the communities where we live and work
  • Corporate Discounts through various vendors across Canada for programs such as fitness, mobile phones, travel, home and auto insurance and many others

Here at Modern Niagara, because we know our people are the best in the industry, we pride ourselves on providing a total compensation package that rewards employees for their hard work and supports employees and their families in their overall wellbeing.

Who We Are

Modern Niagara helps building owners, managers, and general contractors meet the mechanical, and electrical needs of their buildings across Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, Toronto, Southwestern Ontario, and Ottawa. We are committed to having a positive and meaningful impact on Canada’s infrastructure — and on the communities where we live, learn, work, and heal. We build for life.

We are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization where everyone has access to opportunity, feels a sense of belonging, and can thrive.
