It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

  • Have many careers in one Firm.
  • Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
  • Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

The Lead Infrastructure Architect works with Service Owners, Technical Architects, and Member Firm counterparts to help shape the future-state roadmaps for end user technology (EUT — including collaboration technology and the M365 stack), networking, and hosting (cloud and private cloud), then brings those roadmaps together into one cohesive infrastructure landscape. The person contributes real input into how each domain roadmap takes shape: questioning assumptions, testing options, and connecting decisions across domains. Security runs through nearly every infrastructure decision, so the role works closely with the lead architects in Cyber as ongoing peers, keeping infrastructure and security direction aligned as both evolve. Final ownership and sign-off for each domain roadmap stays with the Service Owners and Technical Architects who run it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Roadmap Development & Landscape Synthesis
  • Work directly with EUT, Networking, and Hosting Service Owners and Technical Architects in Global Technology and Infrastructure (GTI) during roadmap planning, contributing options and challenging assumptions as each domain roadmap takes shape.
  • Work closely with the lead architects for Cyber throughout roadmap planning so infrastructure and security direction develop in alignment with each other, rather than one reviewing the other's work afterward.
  • Bring the individual domain roadmaps together into one coherent, forward-looking infrastructure landscape spanning all three domains, with security posture visible as part of that landscape.
  • Identify overlaps, conflicts, and gaps across domain roadmaps and work with the relevant owners to resolve them.
  • Maintain a running future-state narrative (3–5 year horizon) for the combined landscape, refreshed as domain roadmaps evolve.
  • Give Enterprise Architecture and GTI leadership one coherent picture of where infrastructure is heading, built from direct involvement in each part of it.
  • Cross-Domain Coordination & Relationship Building
  • Build trusted peer relationships with Service Owners and Technical Architects across GTI, and with the lead architects for Cyber, using those relationships to stay aligned as plans evolve on both sides.
  • Convene conversations across EUT, Networking, Hosting, and Cyber where a decision in one area affects another — for example, hosting placement affecting network capacity and data protection requirements, or EUT device and collaboration technology refresh cycles affecting endpoint security posture.
  • Engage Member Firm architecture and infrastructure counterparts regularly to understand and help shape local plans before they surface in the global landscape.
  • Earn early, two-way visibility into roadmap discussions as a mark of success — staying aligned with Cyber's direction as closely as with the infrastructure domains, not catching up after decisions are made.

What will your typical day look like?

  • AI & Emerging Technology Landscape
  • Track how AI is showing up across each infrastructure domain: compute/GPU demand in hosting, AI-enabled copilots and collaboration tools in EUT, bandwidth and latency implications for networking.
  • Work with domain owners and the lead architects for Cyber as peers to build AI implications into roadmaps early, since new AI tooling and usage patterns tend to raise security and data-handling questions alongside the infrastructure ones.
  • Flag emerging AI-driven demand that could strain existing plans — capacity, cost, vendor exposure, security posture — so domain owners and Cyber can plan for it in advance.
  • Maintain broad awareness of emerging infrastructure technology and market shifts, and bring relevant signals into roadmap conversations with the domains and Cyber counterparts they affect.
  • Vendor & Technology Landscape
  • Maintain a collated view of the vendor and technology landscape in use across EUT, Networking, and Hosting.
  • Spot redundancy, inconsistency, and consolidation opportunities across domains and Member Firms.
  • Share this landscape view with Service Owners, Procurement, and the lead architects for Cyber so vendor decisions made at the domain level account for both the global picture and security exposure. Vendor relationships and contracts stay with Service Owners and Procurement.
  • Risk, Resilience & Security
  • Work with domain owners and the lead architects for Cyber as peers to build resilience, continuity, and security considerations into roadmaps from the start, rather than treating them as a separate review step.
  • Bring risk, resilience, and regulatory/data-residency considerations together into one visible picture across domains and Member Firms, surfacing gaps.
  • Stay aligned with Cyber's lead architects on an ongoing basis, not just at point-in-time reviews, so security implications of the combined landscape stay visible as plans evolve.
  • Governance & Communication
  • Present the combined infrastructure landscape to Enterprise Architecture and GTI governance forums, supporting the decisions made by roadmap and investment owners, with the Cyber perspective reflected alongside the infrastructure domains.
  • Translate the combined technical landscape into terms meaningful to business stakeholders and IT leadership.

About The Team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Key Relationships

  • Chief Enterprise Architect (direct manager)
  • Service Owners and Technical Architects across GTI: End User Technology (including collaboration technology), Networking, Hosting/Cloud
  • Lead architects for Cyber — a close, continuous peer relationship across all infrastructure decisions
  • Enterprise Architecture peers
  • Member Firm architecture and infrastructure leads
  • Procurement (vendor and technology landscape visibility)
  • Business stakeholders and IT leadership, as required

Required

Experience & Competencies

  • Proven ability to contribute to and help shape technical roadmaps owned by other teams, and bring them together into one coherent picture
  • Strong relationship-building and facilitation skills; experience working as a peer alongside other domain and product architects, including security/Cyber
  • Working experience across at least two of: end user technology (including collaboration technology), networking, cloud/hosting infrastructure — enough depth to contribute credibly to specialist discussions in all three
  • Comfort working alongside Cyber/security architects as ongoing peers in infrastructure planning, not as a separate compliance step
  • Awareness of how AI and emerging technology are shaping infrastructure demand and security exposure (compute, endpoints, collaboration tools, network)
  • Experience navigating a federated or matrixed global organization, reconciling local and global perspectives
  • Excellent communication skills — able to contribute effectively in cross-domain discussions and produce a clear combined narrative
  • Comfort operating without direct authority or final decision rights

Preferred

  • Experience in professional services or another large, multi-entity global organization
  • Prior experience contributing to roadmaps owned by other teams and combining them into a broader view
  • Prior experience working as a peer alongside Cyber/security architects on infrastructure design or planning
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, where the right answer depends on reconciling several valid perspectives

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

What Success Looks Like

  • The infrastructure landscape, current and future state, is coherent and current, built with real input from the person into each part of it
  • Service Owners, Technical Architects, and Cyber's lead architects treat the person as a peer they involve early, not a downstream reviewer
  • Security implications are visible and addressed as part of each domain roadmap, developed in step with it, not identified late
  • AI and emerging technology implications are built into domain roadmaps before they cause capacity, cost, or security problems
  • Member Firms are engaged early enough that local plans help shape the global landscape
  • Leadership has one reliable source of truth for where infrastructure is heading

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $104,000 - $215,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.

We encourage you to connect with us at accessiblecareers@deloitte.ca if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations) or indigenouscareers@deloitte.ca for any questions relating to careers for Indigenous peoples at Deloitte (First Nations, Inuit, Métis).

When you apply, we will review your application using Deloitte's Global Talent Standards to ensure a consistent recruitment experience. Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

Deloitte Canada has 20 offices with representation across most of the country. We acknowledge that Deloitte offices stand on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. apply.title: Architecte principale ou principal de solutions techniques, IA/Données
apply.description:
Pourquoi Vous Aimerez Softchoice

À Softchoice, une entreprise de World Wide Technology (WWT), nous travaillons ensemble pour créer un monde nouveau. En tant que fournisseur offrant des solutions informatiques aux entreprises et PME américaines, ainsi qu’à toutes celles du marché canadien, nous les aidons à transformer leurs ambitions en résultats concrets. Pour ce faire, nous proposons des solutions d’infonuagique, d’IA, de logiciels et d’espace de travail numérique sûres qui favorisent l’agilité, l’innovation et la croissance.

Forts d’une équipe très motivée et performante, nous avons obtenu la certification Great Place to Work® tant au Canada qu’aux États-Unis et figurons parmi les Meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada depuis plus de 20 ans. Nous sommes fiers d’appuyer la réussite de notre personnel par le perfectionnement et l’avancement professionnels, et nous nous efforçons de faire ce qui est le mieux pour nos employées et employés et nos collectivités.

Au sein de WWT, nous offrons à nos clients l’accès à un réseau mondial, à des innovations de pointe, à des partenariats de premier plan et à l’expertise approfondie d’un chef de file en matière d’IA et de transformation numérique. Nos clients ont notamment accès à l’Advanced Technology Center (centre de technologie avancée) de WWT, un écosystème collaboratif doté de matériel et de logiciels de pointe qui leur permet, ainsi qu’à nos partenaires, de conceptualiser, de tester et de valider des solutions innovantes avant de les déployer à grande échelle.

Faites Votre Marque

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une architecte principale ou d’un architecte principal, Solutions techniques, spécialisé(e) en intelligence artificielle (IA), capable de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre des solutions concrètes, indépendamment des plateformes utilisées, dans le cadre de nos mandats stratégiques en IA. Cette personne se trouve au croisement de la stratégie client, de l’ingénierie appliquée de l’IA et des pratiques modernes de livraison logicielle. Elle transforme des enjeux d’affaires ambigus en prototypes fonctionnels, en architectures de référence évolutives et en solutions prêtes pour la production, déployées sur des plateformes d’IA infonuagiques publiques à très grande échelle ainsi que dans des environnements d’IA souverains (sur site ou privés).

La personne idéale sera aussi à l’aise pour présenter au tableau blanc une architecture agentique à une directrice ou un directeur des TI, rédiger le code d’une validation de principe qui démontre que la solution fonctionne et accompagner l’équipe d’ingénierie du client dans la mise en production sécurisée de la solution. Elle maîtrise les écosystèmes des différents fournisseurs tout en demeurant neutre à leur égard, recommandant l’outil le plus approprié en fonction de la charge de travail, des données, du profil de risque et du budget.

Vos Responsabilités

Conception de solutions et architecture

  • Concevoir des solutions d’IA souveraines ou déployées sur site au moyen de plateformes telles que NVIDIA AI Enterprise (NIM, NeMo, Blueprints), Dell AI Factory, HPE Private Cloud AI, Red Hat OpenShift AI, Run:ai, ainsi que de solutions libres de déploiement de modèles (vLLM, TGI, Ollama), pour des clients ayant des exigences en matière de résidence des données, de conformité réglementaire, de protection de la propriété intellectuelle ou de fonctionnement en environnement isolé du réseau (air-gapped).
  • Concevoir des solutions d’IA de bout en bout couvrant à la fois l’IA générative (RAG, CAG, GraphRAG, ajustement fin des modèles, distillation de modèles) et l’IA agentique (agents utilisant des outils, orchestration multiagent, intégrations basées sur le protocole MCP).
  • Comprendre les architectures hybrides reposant sur toutes les principales plateformes d’IA à très grande échelle : AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Q), Microsoft Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI) et Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Gemini).
  • Développer des architectures de référence réutilisables, des cadres décisionnels et des analyses comparatives (coût, latence, précision, gouvernance, souveraineté) pouvant être appliqués à l’ensemble de la pratique.


Relations clients et accompagnement

  • Agir à titre de référence technique principale auprès des clients, depuis les séances d’information destinées à la haute direction jusqu’aux ateliers approfondis de conception technique.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes des ventes et de la livraison ainsi qu’avec les responsables de pratique afin de définir la portée des énoncés de travail, estimer les efforts requis et réduire les risques liés à la livraison.
  • Assurer le mentorat des architectes, des ingénieures et ingénieurs et des conseillères et conseillers de l’ensemble de la pratique en IA, et rehausser le niveau d’expertise technique grâce à des revues de code, à des activités de formation interne et à des ressources réutilisables.
  • Rester à l’affût des avancées technologiques : évaluer les nouveaux modèles, cadres logiciels et protocoles (p. ex. MCP, A2A, ACP, nouveaux cadres de développement d’agents et nouvelles plateformes d’IA souveraine), puis présenter à la pratique des points de vue bien étayés.


Vos Compétences

  • Au moins huit ans d’expérience progressive en ingénierie logicielle, en architecture de solutions ou en architecture d’entreprise, ou en IA ou en apprentissage automatique appliqués, dont au moins deux ans dans un rôle pratique lié à l’IA générative ou à l’IA agentique.
  • Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit (obligatoire), avec la capacité d’animer des ateliers clients, de faire des présentations à la direction et de rédiger de la documentation technique dans les deux langues.
  • Expérience de la conception de solutions d’IA souveraines ou déployées sur site, notamment le déploiement privé de modèles (NVIDIA NIM/NeMo, vLLM, TGI, Ollama), les plateformes d’IA d’entreprise (NVIDIA AI Enterprise, Red Hat OpenShift AI, Dell AI Factory, HPE Private Cloud AI, Run:ai) et les bases de données vectorielles ou de graphes déployées sur site.
  • Solide compréhension de l’infrastructure sous-jacente à l’IA sur site, notamment : architecture GPU et planification de la capacité, optimisation de l’inférence (quantification, traitement par lots et gestion du cache KV), réseaux et stockage haute performance, ainsi que l’ordonnancement des GPU sous Kubernetes.
  • Solide compréhension des exigences et des contrôles liés à la souveraineté des données, notamment la résidence des données, les réglementations en matière de protection de la vie privée (p. ex. LPRPDE, Loi 25 du Québec, RGPD) ainsi que les déploiements isolés du réseau ( air-gapped ) ou déconnectés; capacité d’expliquer les compromis entre les architectures d’IA souveraines, hybrides et infonuagiques publiques.
  • Connaissance approfondie d’au moins une des trois principales plateformes d’IA à très grande échelle (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et connaissance pratique des deux autres.
  • Expérience concrète de la conception et du déploiement en production de systèmes RAG ou agentiques, notamment une connaissance pratique des stratégies de segmentation des données (chunking), de la sélection des modèles d’incorporation vectorielle (embeddings), de l’évaluation de la recherche d’information et des patrons d’orchestration.
  • Connaissance pratique du Model Context Protocol (MCP) et des patrons modernes d’intégration entre agents et outils; capacité de concevoir des serveurs et des clients MCP et de déterminer dans quels cas le protocole MCP constitue la bonne abstraction par rapport aux solutions de rechange.
  • Solide compréhension du CAG (Cache-Augmented Generation), des variantes du RAG (naïf, hybride, GraphRAG, RAG agentique) et des compromis associés à chacune de ces approches.
  • Expérience d’intégration avec des systèmes d’entreprise : API REST/GraphQL, flux d’événements (Kafka, EventBridge), gestion des identités (OIDC, SAML, OAuth2) et plateformes de données d’entreprise (Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, BigQuery).
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite, avec la capacité de passer aisément d’une présentation stratégique destinée aux cadres dirigeants à une discussion technique approfondie au tableau blanc.


Formation

Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie, en mathématiques ou dans un domaine technique connexe, ou expérience équivalente démontrée. Un diplôme d’études supérieures constitue un atout, mais n’est pas obligatoire.

Lieu de travail et déplacements

Poste compatible avec le télétravail, comportant des déplacements périodiques chez les clients et lors d’événements internes (estimés entre 0 % et 15 % du temps).

Rémunération

Le salaire de base annuel pour ce poste au Canada est estimé, de manière raisonnable, entre 123,760 $ et 154,700 $, plus 30% sous forme de prime cible.

Le salaire réel dépendra de divers facteurs, notamment le lieu de travail, l’expérience, les compétences, la formation et les certifications pertinentes. La fourchette salariale pour ce poste peut varier selon la région.

Softchoice propose à tout son personnel à temps plein un programme d’avantages sociaux complet et concurrentiel comprenant:

  • Santé et bien-être : soins médicaux et dentaires, programme d’aide aux employés et à leur famille
  • Avantages économiques : REER/RPDB (régimes d’épargne-retraite) avec cotisation de contrepartie de l’entreprise, assurance vie et assurance invalidité
  • Congés payés : congés annuels et congés de maladie, jours fériés, congé parental, journées de bénévolat, congé de deuil
  • Autres avantages : programme d’offres promotionnelles


La maîtrise de l’anglais est exigée pour ce poste, car la candidate ou le candidat devra collaborer quotidiennement avec des collègues unilingues anglophones et des clients hors Québec.

Vous ne savez pas si vous avez le profil recherché? Posez tout de même votre candidature :

Nous savons que tout le monde ne possède pas toutes les compétences et l’expérience demandées.

À Softchoice, nous offrons des occasions d’emploi à un groupe diversifié qui comprend des personnes ayant des expériences et des parcours professionnels variés. Que vous n’ayez jamais travaillé dans une entreprise du secteur technologique, que vous repreniez le travail après une pause professionnelle, ou que vous souhaitiez changer de secteur d’activité faire progresser votre carrière, nous serons heureuses et heureux de faire votre connaissance et nous vous encourageons à poser votre candidature.

Pourquoi Vous Aimerez Travailler à Softchoice

  • Le personnel : Vous vous épanouirez dans notre environnement collaboratif, entouré de collègues incroyables qui favorisent le soutien et l’innovation, et qui sont les moteurs de notre succès collectif.
  • Une culture axée sur le rendement élevé : À Softchoice, nous sommes déterminés à atteindre nos objectifs et nous visons la réussite de nos clients et de nos collègues.
  • La souplesse : Planifiez vos journées de travail selon vos besoins.
  • Un milieu de travail primé : Softchoice est reconnue comme Meilleur lieu de travail depuis 20 années consécutives.
  • Une culture inclusive : Nous nous engageons à créer une culture d’entreprise où chacune et chacun peut être authentique.
  • Des avantages sociaux concurrentiels : Bénéficiez d’avantages concurrentiels dès le premier jour.


Inclusion Et Équité En Matière D’emploi

Softchoice est un employeur soucieux de l’équité en matière d’emploi qui prône la diversité, l’inclusion et le sentiment d’appartenance. Tout candidat ou toute candidate à un emploi à Softchoice est considéré.e sans égard à une quelconque catégorie, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, la race, la couleur, la religion, l’origine nationale, l’âge, le sexe, l’état civil, l’ascendance, le handicap, l’état d’ancien combattant, l’identité sexuelle ou l’orientation sexuelle.

Vous avez besoin de mesures d’accessibilité? Nous pouvons vous aider :

Softchoice est fière d’offrir des mesures d’accessibilité pour l’ensemble des procédures de recrutement et d’embauche. Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’accessibilité pour présenter votre candidature ou passer un entretien pour un poste, veuillez vous adresser directement à asktalentacquisition@softchoice.com. Nous nous engageons à travailler avec vous pour répondre au mieux à vos besoins.

Nous vous promettons une expérience humaine et inspirante :

Softchoice s’engage à assurer la sécurité de ses candidates, candidats et employé.e.s. Dans cet esprit, nous allons préconiser les entretiens d’embauche virtuels pour toutes et tous. Nous comprenons très bien que vous puissiez avoir des distractions pendant l’entretien (enfants ou animaux de compagnie) et nous vivrons la même chose!

Toute embauche est conditionnelle à la vérification satisfaisante de vos références professionnelles, de votre parcours scolaire et d’un éventuel casier judiciaire.

Les candidates et candidats retenu.e.s seront intégré.e.s en télétravail. N’ayez crainte! Le processus est simple et rapide. Vous pourrez vous joindre à votre nouvelle équipe en un rien de temps.

apply.title: Solutions Architect, Integrations
apply.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

As our first dedicated Solutions Architect for Integrations, you'll sit at the intersection of Sales and our post-sales Integrations team, ensuring every customer commitment is technically sound before a contract is signed. You'll be the person who turns vague integration requirements into clear, scoped blueprints that the implementation team can execute on day one.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales cycles to uncover technical and operational pain points related to asset management, and maintenance support.
  • Lead technical discovery conversations with prospects to understand their ERP, CMMS, EAM, and other enterprise systems that need to connect to MaintainX.
  • Produce clear integration scope documents, data-flow diagrams, and effort estimates that serve as the authoritative handoff artifact to the post-sales team.
  • Build and maintain a library of repeatable integration patterns, pre-built assets, and reference architectures to accelerate future deals.
  • Represent integration feasibility and complexity in deal review and pricing conversations, flagging risk proactively to Sales leadership.
  • Collaborate closely with the post-sales Integrations team to refine scoping templates based on what succeeds (and fails) in delivery, and communicate the upcoming pipeline.
  • Deliver live demos and proof-of-concept integrations to prospects when required.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Product to advocate for prospect needs, accelerate deal velocity, and refine value messaging.

About You

  • 4+ years of experience in a client-facing Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Consulting, or similar role.
  • Deep familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and modern integration patterns.
  • Extensive hands-on knowledge of APIs, data flows, and systems architecture working across engineering teams and business stakeholders.
  • Experience with iPaaS platforms (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Zapier, or similar).
  • Familiarity with SaaS delivery models, including onboarding, post-sale deployment, and customer success workflows.
  • Experience with enterprise systems like ERP or EAM systems (SAP, Oracle, IBM Maximo, Infor, etc.).
  • Proven ability to scope technical work and translate it into effort estimates.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

apply.title: Premier(ère) Conseiller(ère) , Ingénieur, mise en œuvre SIEM (Bilingue FR/ANG )
apply.description:
Chez PwC, nos professionnels de la cybersécurité se consacrent à la protection des organisations contre les cybermenaces grâce à des technologies et des stratégies avancées. Ils s’attachent à identifier les vulnérabilités, à concevoir des systèmes sécurisés et à proposer des solutions proactives afin de protéger les données sensibles. En tant que généraliste en cybersécurité chez PwC, vous vous concentrerez sur la prestation de solutions de sécurité complètes et sur l’acquisition d’une expérience couvrant divers domaines de la cybersécurité, afin de garantir la protection des systèmes et des données des clients. Vous appliquerez une compréhension globale des principes et des pratiques de cybersécurité pour relever efficacement une grande variété de défis en matière de sécurité.

L’opportunité :

En tant que Premier(ère) Conseiller(ère) , Ingénieur, mise en œuvre SIEM (Bilingue FR/ANG ) libérez votre potentiel et saisissez la chance de produire des résultats significatifs qui propulseront votre carrière. Vous exercerez notamment les fonctions suivantes :

  • Prendre en charge les livrables techniques dans le cadre de mandats de mise en œuvre et d’exploitation de solutions SIEM, notamment Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Palo Alto XSIAM et Devo.
  • Réaliser des mandats de preuve de concept et de preuve de valeur afin d’évaluer les capacités des solutions SIEM et d’en démontrer la valeur auprès des parties prenantes.
  • Effectuer des évaluations des environnements SIEM afin de cerner les lacunes, formuler des recommandations d’amélioration et assurer l’alignement avec les pratiques exemplaires en matière de sécurité.
  • Développer et maintenir des pipelines de données pour l’ingestion, la normalisation et l’enrichissement des journaux dans des environnements infonuagiques et locaux.
  • Intégrer les sources de journaux au moyen de connecteurs, de scripts personnalisés et d’analyseurs, afin d’assurer une visibilité complète et la compatibilité avec les plateformes SIEM.
  • Élaborer des cas d’utilisation conformes aux cadres NIST et MITRE ATT&CK afin de permettre la détection à différentes étapes d’une cyberattaque.
  • Mettre en œuvre des règles de détection à l’aide de SPL/KQL, avec corrélation complexe entre différentes sources de données.
  • Concevoir des tableaux de bord, des alertes et des manuels pour la surveillance et la production de rapports de sécurité.
  • Mettre en œuvre des flux de travaux SOAR à l’aide de plateformes telles que Logic Apps, Phantom, Demisto et XSOAR.
  • Effectuer des vérifications de l’intégrité, l’ajustement et l’optimisation des plateformes SIEM afin d’assurer des performances et une précision élevées.
  • Produire et maintenir la documentation, y compris les SOPS (énoncés sur les services autorisés), les manuels d’utilisation, les schémas d’architecture et les guides d’intégration.
  • Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires, notamment le SOC, les équipes d’analystes de menaces informatiques, d’infrastructure et d’infonuagique, afin de soutenir la livraison et d’assurer le respect des normes de qualité.
  • Prendre en charge les livrables techniques dans le cadre de mandats de mise en œuvre de SIEM et de sécurité, incluant l’intégration des sources de journaux, le développement d’analyseurs, le déploiement de contenu SIEM via des canaux d’intégration et de déploiement continus (CI/CD) utilisant GitHub, la mise en œuvre de cas d’usage de détection et les activités de préparation opérationnelle.
  • Développer et soutenir des intégrations personnalisées avec les plateformes SIEM, en particulier Microsoft Sentinel et Google SecOps, incluant scripts, API, analyseurs, logique de transformation des données et gestion des pipelines de données, comme DataBahn.
  • Exploiter les capacités d’intelligence artificielle dans une optique de sécurité afin d’améliorer l’ingénierie de détection, l’optimisation du contenu, l’efficacité opérationnelle et les résultats analytiques, tout en maintenant un niveau élevé de vigilance en matière de sécurité et de gouvernance.

Ce que vous apporterez à ce poste :

Vos compétences, vos connaissances et votre expérience sont ce qui vous distingue. Voici ce que nous recherchons :

  • Expérience pratique avec Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Palo Alto XSIAM, Devo et Splunk.
  • Solide compréhension de l’architecture des solutions SIEM, de leur mise en œuvre, de leur intégration, de la gestion des journaux et des méthodes de détection des menaces.
  • Expérience dans le développement et l’optimisation de cas d’usage et d’alertes de sécurité.
  • Maîtrise de langages de script comme Python, PowerShell et Bash pour l’automatisation et le traitement des données.
  • Expérience avec les plateformes infonuagiques telles qu’ Azure, GCP ou AWS.
  • Connaissance des outils de pipeline de données, notamment Cribl, pour l’acheminement, l’enrichissement et la déduplication des journaux.
  • Connaissance des API REST, le JSON et de l’intégration d’outils de sécurité tiers.
  • Expérience des plateformes SOAR et du développement de manuels pour l’automatisation de la réponse aux incidents.
  • Compréhension des concepts de sécurité, tels que les cyberattaques, les vecteurs de menaces, et la gestion des risques et des incidents.
  • Fortes habiletés en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, et souci du détail.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en documentation et en exécution de missions.
  • Expérience du déploiement de contenu SIEM au moyen de pratiques CI/CD à l’aide de GitHub, y compris le contrôle des versions, la revue par les pairs, le suivi des changements et la promotion structurée du contenu entre les environnements.
  • Expérience de la gestion des pipelines de données de sécurité et des flux d’ingestion, incluant la transformation des données, la normalisation, le dépannage ainsi que l’utilisation de plateformes ou de capacités telles que DataBahn.
  • Solide compréhension des concepts et outils d’intelligence artificielle, avec la capacité de les appliquer à des cas d’usage axés sur la sécurité, notamment l’amélioration de la détection, l’analyse des menaces, le soutien à l’automatisation et l’optimisation des opérations de sécurité.
  • Maîtrise des outils de la suite Microsoft Office, notamment Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams et Outlook, avec la capacité de produire des livrables de qualité destinés aux clients (documents, suivis, présentations et comptes rendus de réunion).

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat en sciences informatiques, en cybersécurité ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Certifications privilégiées : Microsoft certifié : Analyste des opérations de sécurité associé, SC-200, AZ-500, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CISM, GIAC.
  • Un minimum de 3 ans d’expérience en déploiement de solutions SIEM et d’opérations de sécurité.
  • Capacité démontrée à travailler en collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et à gérer plusieurs missions clients simultanément.
  • Engagement envers l’apprentissage continu et capacité à s’adapter à l’évolution des technologies de cybersécurité.
  • Expérience en cabinet de services-conseils, en prestation de services auprès de clients ou dans un environnement de services professionnels, un atout.

Ce poste nouvellement créé reflète notre engagement envers la croissance ainsi que notre volonté d’offrir une valeur distinctive à nos clients et à nos parties prenantes.

apply.title: Controls Transformation Program Consultant
apply.description:

The successful candidate will conduct controls and risk assessments, identify automation opportunities, support proof-of-concept evaluations, and develop recommendations for process and policy improvements. This role requires someone who can work independently and translate complex analysis into concise, executive-ready presentations and recommendations.

Duties

  • Conduct assessments of current controls and risk management processes.
  • Perform risk assessments and support technology intake activities.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities for controls and process automation.
  • Partner with consulting firms, vendors, and technology teams to evaluate Proofs of Concept (POCs) and proposed automation solutions.
  • Analyze enterprise-wide transformation initiatives and identify gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support controls rationalization, process standardization, and process improvement.

apply.title: Senior Manager, Clinic IT Services
apply.description:
Job Title: Senior Manager, Clinic IT Services

Team: Technology Services (Service Desk / Clinic Support)

Reports To: VP, Technology Services

Location: Head Office (Hybrid, remote flexibility); travel to clinics/regions as required

Employment Type: Permanent Full-Time

About 123Dentist

123Dentist is the largest majority Canadian-owned dental support organization, supporting a growing network of 400+ dental practices across the country. As we continue to expand – both organically and through acquisition – our Technology Services team is central to delivering the reliable, consistent, and well-supported technology experience our clinics depend on to care for patients every day.

About The Role

The Senior Manager, Clinic IT Services leads the Support function within Technology Services and is accountable for the quality, reliability, and continuous improvement of IT support for 123Dentist’s clinics across Canada. This is a leadership role charged with establishing the systems, processes, reporting, automation, and service-improvement disciplines needed to drive a step-change in clinic IT support.

Beyond running day-to-day support, this is a transformation mandate: standardizing tools and processes across a large, distributed clinic network, and leading the shift from an MSP-led model toward greater corporate ownership of operations and support. As a member of the Technology & Operations leadership team, you’ll also help shape the future direction of IT, working closely with clinic and regional operations leaders and every layer of the Corporate IT team.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the clinic IT support function end-to-end – clinic support, Tier 1 triage/dispatch, and Tier 2 helpdesk – accountable for service quality, responsiveness, and SLA performance across the national clinic network
  • Line-manage, coach, and develop direct reports, building a high-performing, service-oriented organization with clear career pathways
  • Establish robust escalation paths, major-incident management, and stakeholder communication for clinic-impacting issues
  • Establish and mature the systems, processes, and ITSM tooling that underpin clinic support, including queues, workflows, knowledge base, self-service, and automation
  • Design and deliver meaningful reporting and metrics (ticket volume, response and resolution times, SLA attainment, CSAT) to drive data-led decisions and improvement
  • Lead problem management and continuous service improvement to remove recurring issues and raise first-contact resolution
  • Drive a controlled transition toward corporate ownership of clinic IT operations, insourcing capabilities where it improves quality, control, or cost, and manage MSP performance against SLAs and KPIs
  • Standardize tools, processes, and configurations across clinics to reduce variation and enable the organization to scale
  • Contribute to and deliver the clinic IT support roadmap aligned to 123Dentist’s growth, and build strong relationships with Clinic Managers, Regional Managers, and VPs of Operations
  • Manage the function’s budget and resources, and support the standardized onboarding of newly acquired practices into the clinic support model

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years in IT service delivery, service desk, or IT support, including several years leading teams and managing other managers
  • Proven track record establishing or transforming an IT support function – systems, processes, reporting, automation, and measurable service improvement
  • Experience in a large, multi-site, distributed environment (healthcare, DSO, retail, or franchise) is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience managing MSPs / vendors and transitioning services between outsourced and in-house models
  • Senior people leadership and executive-level stakeholder management, from clinic staff to VPs of Operations
  • Deep ITSM / service-management expertise (ITIL-aligned), including platform administration (e.g., FreshService), and strong command of support metrics and reporting
  • Solid working understanding of the Microsoft-centric endpoint, identity, and productivity environment (Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune)
  • ITIL Foundation or higher, and a project or change-management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or Prosci) is an asset
  • Strong ownership mindset, data-driven decision-making, and a collaborative, service-first leadership style

Why Join 123Dentist?

  • Lead a high-impact transformation mandate shaping IT support for clinics across Canada
  • Sit on the Technology & Operations leadership team, helping shape the future direction of IT
  • Build and grow a high-performing, multi-tier support organization
  • Be part of a fast-growing, collaborative national organization

apply.title: Incident Management, Lead
apply.description:
Who We Are:

Every transaction matters. Every Canadian matters. At Interac, we protect both — driving trust, security, and inclusion, so our digital economy thrives.

Founded in 1984, Interac connects Canadians through secure digital payments, advanced identity verification and industry-leading fraud protection. Connecting banks, businesses, and individuals, Interac enables millions to send, receive, and manage money safely and effortlessly every day — across both digital and physical environments.

As the backbone of Canada’s financial ecosystem, Interac facilitates over 20 million transactions daily, supported by trusted partnerships with government and financial institutions. Consistently ranked as Canada’s most reputable financial technology brand, Interac is deeply embedded in the daily lives of Canadians.

Who You Will Work With:

The vacant Incident Management, Lead role will report to the Leader, Process & Operational Excellence. This Major Incident Commander (Lead, Incident Management) is responsible for leading, coordinating, and continuously improving the Incident Management process, particularly the rapid resolution of major incidents across all Interac Products and Platforms, as well as for guiding the Incident Management team to deliver high quality incident management with continuous improvement, effective internal and external incident communications (verbal and written), insightful and efficient reporting, and other related accountabilities.

What You Will Do:

  • Major Incident Response: Engage quickly in all major incidents to ensure the necessary resources (including incident managers, technology SMEs, communication teams) are engaged and the necessary communications channels (Incident Notifications, Technical Resolution Bridge, Customer Updates Bridge) are active and staffed with knowledgeable resources. Oversee all incident-related operations, including emergency response and recovery activities.
  • Major Incident Command: Act as Incident Resolution lead, providing direction to technical resolver teams to ensure swiftest resolution of service while ensuring all steps taken align with compliance standards and best practices to accomplish quickest possible resolution while minimizing risk. Review and approve necessary emergency changes within approved process.
  • Standard Communications: Drive resolver teams to ensure that standard communications such as Internal and External Major Incident Notifications (MINT) are on time and high quality.
  • VIP Communications: Lead customer updates bridge, sharing information from another Incident Commander who is leading the technical resolution bridge. Frame updates to be both executive-friendly and sufficiently technical to meet Participant needs. Collaborate with Corporate Communications, Product, and other teams to ensure external communications can be effective and accurate.
  • Continuous improvement: Lead and collaborate with peers and other stakeholders to continuously improve the Incident process, communications, reporting, and compliance efficiently. Measure process effectiveness through relevant metrics.
  • Mentoring: Provide guidance and mentorship to other team members, modeling skills such as communication, nuanced decision making, and insightful reporting.
  • Documentation: Develop the framework for Incident Management documentation making it easy for stakeholders to find current information, ensure regular updates, ticket notes, timeline and other incident documentation. Ensure the team maintains and regularly updates Incident Management documentation and keeps it aligned with customer-facing and internal documentation across ITSM teams.
  • Post Incident Review and Improvement: Conduct post-incident reviews and implement improvements for future incidents. Collaborate closely with the Problem team, operations partners, and technology, product, and risk teams.

What You Bring:

  • Proven success as a senior incident management lead, recognized as an expert in this discipline. Success in other ITIL/ITSM functions as well is desirable.
  • Strong lateral leadership and decision-making, ability to gain the confidence of stakeholders at all levels.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, particularly bridging between technical and business stakeholders, and the ability to quickly distill complex situations into simpler terms.
  • Proven success developing, changing, or transforming Incident Management processes
  • Recognized expert ability to think critically and solve problems under pressure.
  • Fluency in concepts spanning ITIL, ITSM, Financial Services, Payments, and emergency management protocols.
  • Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability to changing situations and priorities.
  • Sufficient technical knowledge and technology learning capability to understand the high level structure of the platforms, data, and applications that comprise Interac products.
  • Skilled at working with internal and external organizations.
  • Used to working in support of a 7/24 complex environment.

apply.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack

Electrify your career and help build a brighter tomorrow.

Every generation has a challenge that defines them. At OPG, we are calling on all innovators, disruptors, thought leaders and change-makers. Join us as we work to electrify life in one generation and build a sustainable future powered by our electricity, our ideas, and our people. Join OPG and make history.

Whether you work in the skilled trades or are a business professional, a career at OPG is an opportunity to electrify your life on -- and off -- the job.

Ontario Power Generation (OPG) is looking for a dynamic, strategic and results-driven professional to join our team in the role of Software Engineer, Full Stack.

Job Overview

Ontario Power Generation (OPG) is seeking a high-performing, product-minded Software Engineer, Full Stack to help design and deliver modern, scalable software solutions that power critical business capabilities. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong hands-on technical depth with sound judgment, a bias for action, and a commitment to engineering excellence.

Reporting to the Manager, IT Product Delivery, you will play a key role in building and evolving enterprise applications across the full stack, with a primary focus on frontend development using React and TypeScript and backend services built with .NET 10 and C#. You will partner closely with product, design, architecture, QA, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

The successful candidate is a strong collaborator who can independently drive delivery, contribute to architecture and design decisions, raise the quality bar through code reviews and best practices, and continuously improve team velocity, system performance, and developer experience. Experience with Azure and cloud-native patterns is considered a strong asset.

Key Accountabilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality full-stack software solutions using React, TypeScript, .NET 10, and C#.
  • Own delivery of features end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through testing, release, and post-production support.
  • Contribute to architecture and system design decisions with a focus on scalability, resiliency, security, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Build intuitive, responsive, and accessible user interfaces while ensuring clean integration with backend APIs and services.
  • Develop and enhance backend services, business logic, and integrations to support reliable, secure, and efficient application workflows.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement durable fixes that improve system stability and operational excellence.
  • Elevate engineering standards through thoughtful code reviews, technical documentation, mentoring, and active knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage technical trade-offs, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver measurable business value.

Qualifications

  • Four-year university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 4+ years of professional software development experience, excluding co-op or internship experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience building modern web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Strong backend development experience with C# and .NET, ideally including experience with modern .NET platforms such as .NET 10.
  • Demonstrated understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including domain-driven design, object-oriented design, design patterns, clean code principles, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, working with databases, and integrating distributed systems or third-party services.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced setting.
  • Experience with Azure services, cloud-native development, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, or DevOps practices is an asset.

The successful candidate will exhibit uncompromising integrity and commitment to upholding corporate values, and the OPG Code of Business Conduct.

OPG is committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and accessible environment. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please contact AODA@opg.com.

What makes a career at OPG different?

With operations across Ontario, OPG is one of the most diverse power producers in North America. As the largest generator in Ontario, we meet approximately 50% of the province’s electricity needs, largely from low-carbon sources like nuclear and hydro.

As we work to achieve our vision of Electrifying life in one generation, OPG and our family of companies are also helping advance the development of new low-carbon technologies such as Small Modular Reactors (SMRs), refurbishment projects, and electrification initiatives to help power the growing demands of a growing economy. Join OPG and make history.

The Darlington New Nuclear Project is leading the way in the advancement of Small Modular Reactor (SMR) technology in Canada – the future of nuclear power generation! Using new and innovative technologies such as small modular reactors, hydrogen and battery storage, while expanding our hydroelectric and nuclear portfolios, we are changing the electricity landscape in Ontario.

Important Information

The base salary range considers many factors including, but not limited to experience, education, and training, including any collective agreement requirements for union represented positions. It is not typical for the salary to be offered near the top of the range, and salary is dependent on numerous factors. For management roles, the base salary range does not represent the total compensation package. The total compensation package for regular full-time management roles includes pay-for-performance programs for annual and medium time periods. Maintaining a high-performance culture and excellence is a core expectation of every member of our leadership team and is rewarded through the established compensation framework.

OPG is committed to employment equity. As such, we encourage applicants from equity-seeking communities (Indigenous Peoples, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, and women). We strongly believe that alleviating the under-representation of equity-seeking individuals will create a stronger OPG team and allow us to better serve the needs of our diverse communities.

In order to fulfill the above-mentioned purpose, priority in hiring may be given to qualified persons who self-identify as a member of equity-seeking groups as identified in the application process. This initiative constitutes a special program under the Human Rights Code/Canadian Human Rights Act.

All job postings at OPG are to fill existing vacancies within our organization.

OPG may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as part of the applicant screening process. However, applications will also be reviewed by a member of our Recruitment team to ensure a fair and thorough assessment.

Please submit your application online at https://jobs.opg.com/. OPG thanks all those who apply; however, only candidates considered for an interview will be contacted.

apply.title: GTM Engineer
apply.description:
At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work — capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.

Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact — every shift, every site, every region.

We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done.

We’ve built a GTM stack most companies our size would envy. Now we need the GTM engineer who’ll make it sing. You’ll be our first, and the one who sets what good looks like.

Role overview

As our GTM Engineer, you'll make AI central to how Poka goes to market. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, Pre-Sales and Customer Success, you'll find where AI can remove manual work, connect our tools and help our people sell to and serve customers better.

You'll own the full loop: spotting the opportunity, testing it fast, building what works and embedding it into how our teams operate every day. That means automating and integrating our GTM stack — Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong (including Gong Engage), Clay, 6sense, Conversica, Claude Enterprise and more — and building AI agents and workflows our teams actually use, not just admire. You'll also build the reporting that shows where our processes leak time and pipeline, so every iteration is grounded in data.

This is a hands-on builder role with high visibility across our marketing and commercial leadership — and a real chance to get full value from the tools we already have while shaping what we add next.

What you'll be doing

  • Embed with our Marketing, Business Development, Account Executive, Account Management, Pre-Sales and Customer Success teams to understand how they work and where AI can make the biggest difference
  • Design, build and deploy AI agents and automated workflows across the GTM lifecycle: account research, signal monitoring, prospecting, lead follow-up, call preparation, deal intelligence, forecasting support, proposals, and renewal and expansion plays
  • Integrate and automate our GTM stack so data flows cleanly between systems and our teams spend less time on admin
  • Build the reports and dashboards that surface process gaps and inefficiencies, informing process changes and highlighting where teams need enablement
  • Run a steady cadence of experiments: test quickly, measure what works, kill what doesn't and scale the winners
  • Evaluate new GTM AI tools and vendors, run proofs of concept, and make clear build, buy or skip recommendations
  • Drive adoption of our existing GTM AI and tooling, closing the gap between what we've bought and what we use
  • Partner with leaders across RevOps, Marketing, Sales and Pre-Sales to prioritise a roadmap of AI use cases and turn their ideas into working systems
  • Measure and report impact to leadership: hours saved, pipeline influenced, conversion and adoption
  • Document what you build and hand over what's ready to scale to Sales Enablement and RevOps, so it's rolled out and used well
  • Keep governance, data quality and security front of mind, including GDPR and data privacy requirements across our European business

What you bring

  • 3+ years in GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales or Marketing Operations, Growth Engineering or a similar technical role in B2B SaaS
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI agents in production, not just experimenting with prompts
  • Strong Salesforce knowledge, including data models, APIs, automation and reporting
  • Working experience with GTM tools such as HubSpot, Clay, Gong or 6sense, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, n8n or Workato
  • Comfort with APIs, webhooks and scripting in Python, JavaScript or SQL
  • An experimentation mindset: you launch fast, measure honestly and iterate
  • The ability to turn a messy business process into a simple, working system with minimal guidance
  • Strong communication skills and confidence partnering with non-technical stakeholders, from SDRs to senior leaders
  • Excellent written and spoken English; French or another language is an asset
  • Bonus: experience selling into or working in manufacturing or the wider industrial technology space

We know great builders come from varied paths. If you don't tick every box but you've shipped AI that people use, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Poka

AI is reshaping how B2B companies go to market, and we want Poka to lead, not follow. You'll have the backing to build, a modern GTM stack to work with, and leaders who want AI embedded in how we work. You'll get the reach of IFS behind you and the pace and ownership of a growth-stage company, with a real chance to define this function from day one.

What we offer:

  • Scale-up energy with huge backing and a global yet close-knit team.
  • Generous vacation policy, additional paid days, and charity day.
  • Hybrid work policy - Employees who live within a 40 km radius of our Québec City office or a 15 km radius of our Montréal office are required to work in-office two days per week.
  • 100% remote work if you do not live within the radiuses mentioned above.
  • A truly flexible schedule that allows you to adapt your work hours.
  • Group insurance from day one (dental, medication, disability, travel, etc.) with employer contributions, including access to telemedicine and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • A retirement savings plan with employer contributions.
  • A MacBook Pro and a $500 home office allowance upon hiring.
  • A generous annual learning and development budget to support your growth, plus the tools and opportunities you need to keep progressing in your career.
  • A rewarding employee referral program for successful hires.
  • Tasty snacks available at all times in our offices (fresh fruits, snacks, pastries, coffee, tea, etc.)
  • Certain benefits are exclusively accessible to employees in Canada.

Want to learn more about our culture? Click HERE.

Please note: An understanding of English is essential at Poka, as it is the language used during company-wide meetings and many internal communications, ensuring effective collaboration and decision-making. In addition, as Poka operates in an international environment, English is the primary language for communicating with our clients and partners, enabling us to better serve them and represent Poka in a professional manner.

apply.title: Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations (Data360, Revenue, Tableau, or Marketing Clouds)
apply.description:
Description

The Experience

The Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations is an individual contributor who leads complex customer migration engagements from kickoff through successful go-live. You serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact for your migration pod — building trust with customers, coordinating with our Global Delivery Center (GDC) engineering partners, and ensuring every engagement drives real, measurable value as customers move to modern cloud architectures.

This role sits at the intersection of customer relationship management and hands-on technical execution. You'll act as a trusted advisor who bridges a customer's legacy environment with their future-state platform — accelerating timelines through automated playbooks and AI-assisted tooling, while serving as a direct feedback channel to Product and Engineering on what's working (and what isn't) in the field.

Note: By applying to this Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations role your resume will be reviewed by recruiters and hiring managers across the organization. Multiple roles are available supporting various product areas, including Data360, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, and Marketing Cloud. Our goal is for you to apply once and be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with your background.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.
  • Partner with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration goals with customers' broader business strategy, renewal, and expansion objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, translating complex migration challenges into clear, actionable decisions.
  • Develop and execute focused delivery plans that prioritize high-impact milestones and hold pod-level timelines to account.
  • Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.
  • Drive adoption of AI agents and automation toolkits to accelerate discovery, data mapping, and code conversion — reducing manual effort and compressing delivery timelines.
  • Collaborate closely with GDC partners, delegating repeatable technical tasks while maintaining full accountability for output quality.
  • Work in close alignment with Outbound Product Managers to stay current on product roadmaps and translate field insights into product improvements.
  • Identify underutilized platform capabilities and incorporate them into migration roadmaps to increase customer throughput and adoption.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
  • Apply AI literacy and prompt engineering skills to guide AI agents in data retrieval, migration health reporting, and task automation.
  • Act as the technical point of contact during major migration incidents — coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer's operations during cutover phases.
  • Monitor technical trends proactively and provide tailored release recommendations to optimize migrated environments for performance and stability.

You're Our Person If...

  • 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a strong focus on large-scale platform migrations.
  • Deep, hands-on domain expertise in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and navigate complex stakeholder conversations.
  • Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business-friendly language and guide customers through data transformations.
  • Proven experience working with global or offshore delivery models (such as GDC) to accelerate project delivery.
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service Cloud) or specialized clouds (Marketing, Data, Revenue, or Tableau).
  • Familiarity with AI agents or automation tools applied to data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
  • Understanding of how target cloud platforms integrate with telephony systems, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.
  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Even Better If...

  • Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist).
  • Prior experience as an individual contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation engagements.
  • Salesforce AI Associate or Agentblazer certifications.
  • Customer Engagement & Value Delivery
  • Strategic Partnerships & Tooling
  • Technical Expertise & Incident Response

What's in It for You

You'll join a team that is shaping how Salesforce customers adopt the next generation of cloud technology — with access to cutting-edge AI tools, a collaborative global delivery model, and a direct line to the Product teams building the platforms you work with. This role offers real influence: your field experience will directly inform how migration tooling evolves, and your work will be visible across the business.

apply.title: Acquisition (Sales) Operations Manager
apply.description:
This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis.

About Float

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth.

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025, 2024 and 2023, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

Our Product

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.

AI Use in Our Hiring Process

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

About The Role

Float is building out its next stage of growth operations. As Acquisition Operations Manager, you’ll own the systems, programs, and operating rhythms that take a prospect from first touch to active, spending customer.

You’ll build, not inherit. You’ll partner with Sales, BDR, Marketing Ops, Finance, Product, and Customer Success leadership to turn strategy into repeatable programs that improve pipeline quality, conversion, and activation.

What You'll Do

  • Design and optimize the end-to-end sales-acquired customer journey. This starts with ISR/BDR prospecting (inbound and outbound), AE sales funnel management and deal execution, and activation through first card usage (months 0–4).
  • Own and optimize the Acquisition operating system: outbound cadences, deal-execution playbooks, funnel performance insights and oversight, and the activation ramp that converts a signed contract into usage (maximizing spend penetration).
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize the acquisition tech stack (sales engagement, Salesforce pipeline configuration), driving adoption across BDR and AE teams.
  • Own pipeline health: coverage ratios, stage conversion, win/loss analysis
  • Build and own forecasting and quota-setting for sales-acquired TPV, and partner with Marketing Ops on the self-serve-to-sales handoff.
  • Build scalable territory and account-assignment programs for BDR/AE capacity.
  • Partner with BDR/AE leadership on reporting cadences, monetization levers (e.g. contract terms), operating rhythms, and performance metrics.
  • Own streamlining handoffs from Marketing > BDR, BDR > AE, and AE to Customer Activation teams
  • Translate fragmented pipeline and activation data into recommendations for Sales and GTM leadership.
  • Identify and automate manual BDR/AE work so reps spend more time selling.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in Sales Ops, Revenue Ops, or similar with end-to-end ownership of a sales-acquired pipeline.
  • Experience in a consumption/usage-based business where activation, not just bookings, drives revenue is an asset
  • Proven track record building outbound and sales programs with measured impact on business outcomes (pipeline volume/quality, deal size, win rates, productivity)
  • Hands-on Salesforce and sales-engagement tooling experience.
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable turning fragmented data into a forecast leadership can trust.

This May Not Be the Role for You If

  • You prefer inheriting a mature process over building it.
  • Your background is BDR/AE execution rather than owning the systems behind it.
  • You'd rather report on pipeline metrics than build what generates them.

Our Hiring Philosophy

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.

Why You Should Join

  • Be part of an award winning company: we're one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies 2026 according to Report on Business, and Deloitte’s Technology Fast50 2026
  • Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role
  • Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team
  • Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits
  • Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration
  • Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
  • Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office
  • Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters

In Short

At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.

We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Compensation Range: CA$120K - CA$150K

The Product Manager – Canada translates business needs into product opportunities and ensures solutions address Canadian market requirements while aligning with CDW’s broader strategic direction. These platforms include Marketing Automation, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ), Professional Services Automation (PSA), and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM). The role partners closely with business and technology teams to establish priorities, navigate dependencies, plan capacity, and drive measurable business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Business Partnership & Process Leadership

Product Strategy & Ownership

  • Lead the prioritization of product investments, enhancements, and initiatives based on business value, user needs, strategic objectives, and technology capacity.
  • Translate business objectives, user feedback, and operational requirements into product capabilities, features, and enhancement opportunities.
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product adoption, business value, operational efficiency, and user satisfaction.

Canada Business Representation

  • Serve as the voice of the Canadian business within the broader product organization and cross-functional value streams, providing context on market-specific requirements, business priorities, and customer needs to influence product decisions, roadmaps, enterprise planning, and investment decisions.
  • Participate in value stream forums and planning activities with stakeholders across U.S. Commercial, U.S. Government, and Canada organizations to align product strategies, identify dependencies, and promote shared business outcomes.

Delivery, Alignment & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, product owners, architects, and technology teams across value streams to evaluate impacts to the Canadian business and advocate for solutions that support regional goals while aligning with enterprise standards.
  • Collaborate with technology teams to establish priorities, plan capacity, and support successful delivery of product initiatives and business outcomes.
  • Partner with business, technology, legal, and compliance stakeholders to ensure product capabilities address Canadian regulatory, localization, data, and operational requirements.
  • Drive product adoption by partnering with stakeholders to communicate value, support change management activities, and gather feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Communicate enterprise product roadmaps, strategic initiatives, and delivery plans to stakeholders across all levels of the CDW Canada organization, ensuring visibility, alignment, and understanding of upcoming capabilities and investments.

What We Expect Of You

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • 5+ years of product management or technology experience, preferably managing multiple products, platforms, or interconnected systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities, and make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information.
  • Ability to balance competing priorities, dependencies, and stakeholder needs across multiple systems while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate detailed information and data into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and executive-level narratives.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills across cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Track record of identifying process and product improvement opportunities and translating them into practical, value-focused recommendations.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery approaches, including SAFe, Scrum, and Kanban.

Preferred Experience
