consider.description:
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

  • Travel to Office expectations**

For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.

For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

Position Summary

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Architect, reporting to the Sr Manager- AI & Platform Architecture, to design, deliver, and continuously improve our Product-to-Cash landscape on Salesforce. This is a coaching and mentoring–focused role: you will guide engineers and solution designers, raise architectural standards, and bring deep hands-on expertise in Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), the billing system, and the broader quote-to-cash lifecycle.

Working in close partnership with other Architects, you will help solve complex business and technical challenges and ensure solutions are designed to best serve the evolving needs of the company. The ideal candidate pairs strong Salesforce architecture experience with an AI-first mindset, applying Agentforce and Claude-based solutions to solve problems, and the ability to identify and resolve process and technology gaps across the Product-to-Cash value chain, ensuring solutions align to their core business domains and to the enterprise taxonomy framework that underpins domain roadmaps and technology transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the architectural coach and mentor for engineers and solution designers across the Product-to-Cash domain, building team capability in Revenue Cloud Advanced and billing
  • Partner closely with the Principal Salesforce Architect to align on architectural direction, solve complex business and technical challenges together, and ensure solutions are designed to best serve the evolving needs of the company
  • Produce High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), and conceptual diagrams that clearly communicate architecture to technical and business audiences
  • Manage architecture and system roadmaps, ensuring alignment with platform standards and the long-term direction of the Product-to-Cash landscape
  • Define, maintain, and enforce platform standards across the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Build Proof of Concepts (POCs) to prove out the architecture and validate design decisions before delivery
  • Actively participate in requirement gathering, clarifying scope and resolving ambiguity early in the lifecycle
  • Work with the integration team to design and govern integrations, ensuring seamless communication and data flow across systems
  • Provide hands-on Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA)/CPQ coaching, including configuration patterns, design trade-offs, and implementation best practices
  • Own the end-to-end architecture of the Product-to-Cash lifecycle: quoting, contracting, ordering, fulfilment, billing, invoicing, revenue, customer success, and customer support
  • Architect and govern the billing system and billing platform, ensuring accurate invoicing, billing schedules, payment handling, dunning, and revenue recognition flows
  • Identify and resolve process gaps and technology gaps across Product-to-Cash, defining remediation approaches and driving them to resolution
  • Apply an AI-first mindset to problem solving, leveraging Agentforce and Claude-based solutions where they add value
  • Work with the development team to hand over designs cleanly, ensuring they have the context and clarity needed to build
  • During project execution, work with SMEs and Product Owners to address any requirement gaps and shape the right solution
  • Extend and mature the Product-to-Cash solution as business needs evolve, ensuring the architecture scales with new products, pricing models, and billing scenarios
  • Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform and Revenue Cloud
  • Apply architectural and engineering concepts to meet operational requirements such as scalability, maintainability, security, reliability, extensibility, availability, and manageability
  • Conduct research and develop Proof of Concepts on emerging Salesforce and billing capabilities, recommending solutions that are functionally robust and cost-effective
  • Promote the adoption of design patterns and standard processes for solution design and development
  • Partner with data and integration architects to ensure data integrity, security, compliance, and seamless data flow between billing, ERP, and other systems
  • Work closely with solution architects to ensure individual solutions align with the overall enterprise architecture
  • Contribute to a learning community within the enterprise architecture discipline, fostering continuous improvement

Required Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • 10+ years of Salesforce experience across implementation, configuration, and solution design
  • 3–5 years of Salesforce architecture experience (minimum required)
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA)/ CPQ, with the ability to coach and mentor others on the platform
  • Proven experience producing HLD, LLD, and conceptual diagrams, and managing architecture and system roadmaps
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering end-to-end Product-to-Cash solutions: quoting, contracting, ordering, fulfilment, billing, revenue, customer success, and customer support
  • Strong experience with billing systems and billing platforms, including invoicing, billing schedules, payments, dunning, and revenue recognition
  • Experience working with integration teams to design and govern cross-system integrations
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve process gaps and technology gaps across the Product-to-Cash value chain
  • An AI-first mindset, with exposure to Agent force and Claude-based solutions for solving business and technical problems
  • Experience working with Salesforce Connected Apps (applications from the Salesforce AppExchange)
  • Proven experience designing and delivering complex B2B SaaS Salesforce solutions
  • Familiarity with managed packages such as Gong, DocuSign CLM, Kantata, Gainsight, Showpad, Qualtrics, or similar enterprise apps is a plus
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture capabilities and ecosystem, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Revenue Cloud
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect preferred
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, C4, ArchiMate, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Understanding of security architecture principles and practices

consider.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Salesforce Solution Lead

About The Role

The Salesforce Solution Lead sets the direction for complex enterprise Salesforce solutions and transforms strategy into measurable business outcomes. This role connects business priorities, technology roadmaps, operational needs, and investment decisions while guiding cross-functional teams through delivery and continuous improvement. As a trusted partner to senior business and technology leaders, you will create clarity across competing priorities, strengthen governance, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, cost-effective, and aligned to enterprise goals.

What You'll Do

  • Own delivery and execution management for enterprise Salesforce solution portfolios, translating strategy and roadmaps into clear outcomes, milestones, governance, and performance measures.
  • Build trusted stakeholder relationships and communicate decisions, trade-offs, progress, and business value to senior business and technology leaders.
  • Lead planning, prioritization, and dependency management across initiatives, balancing customer value, risk, cost, capacity, technical sustainability, and strategic goals.
  • Drive risk, issue, and problem management across business, technology, vendors, and operations; establish mitigation plans and lead resolution of complex blockers.
  • Orchestrate multidisciplinary teams, Solution Managers, strategic partners, and vendors to deliver and operate enterprise Salesforce solutions consistently.
  • Shape demand, business cases, investment recommendations, budgets, cost optimization opportunities, and value-realization measures.
  • Align solution delivery with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, regulatory, compliance, service management, and Salesforce platform standards.
  • Champion adoption, organizational change, continuous improvement, and responsible innovation based on performance data, customer outcomes, and market trends.


Basic Requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience in enterprise solution management, Salesforce delivery, technology delivery, portfolio/program management, or a related field; equivalent education and experience considered, with less experience acceptable when supported by a relevant master's or doctoral degree.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale Salesforce solution strategy, roadmap development, delivery, operations, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience managing complex portfolios, cross-functional dependencies, risks, issues, executive stakeholders, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience developing business cases, prioritizing investments, managing budgets, and evaluating cost, value, and return on investment.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, technology governance, cybersecurity, compliance, service management, and Salesforce platform capabilities.
  • Clear examples of leading multidisciplinary teams, vendors, or strategic partners through complex delivery and change.


Preferred Skills/Experience

  • Experience coaching Solution Managers or other delivery leaders and establishing consistent standards, operating models, or governance practices.
  • Advanced communication, facilitation, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills with executive and technical audiences.
  • Experience with Agile, product, program, portfolio, IT service management, or value-stream practices.
  • Experience using metrics such as adoption, service performance, customer outcomes, investment value, operational effectiveness, and platform health to guide decisions.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, connect strategy to execution, and influence across a matrixed enterprise environment.
  • Experience evaluating emerging Salesforce capabilities and related technologies, translating opportunities into practical, governed solution improvements.

consider.title: ServiceNow Platform Specialist

GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.


If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!


Job Overview

Alimentiv is seeking a ServiceNow Platform Specialist to support the administration, configuration, development, and continuous improvement of our ServiceNow platform. This role will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing existing IT Service Management (ITSM) capabilities while supporting future platform expansion, workflow automation, reporting, and integrations.


Working closely with the ServiceNow Platform Owner, business stakeholders, project teams, and external partners, the successful candidate will help deliver scalable, secure, and efficient platform solutions that support business needs and improve service delivery across the organization.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and maintain the ServiceNow platform, including user and group management, system configuration, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting.




  • Manage platform upgrades, patches, and configuration changes to ensure system stability, security, and reliability.




  • Configure and develop ServiceNow modules, workflows, forms, and automations using JavaScript and ServiceNow APIs.




  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with platform standards and organizational needs.




  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and integrations to improve visibility into service delivery and platform performance.




  • Support the onboarding of new services and business functions onto the ServiceNow platform, including requirements gathering and workflow configuration.




  • Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to enhance platform functionality, service management processes, and operational efficiency.




  • Manage platform security, role-based access controls, data permissions, and governance practices to support compliance and data integrity.




  • Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems to ensure accurate and reliable data exchange.




  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, vendors, and implementation partners to support platform enhancements, technical solutions, and future expansion initiatives.





Skills & Qualifications


  • 4–6 years of related professional experience, including 3–5 years of hands-on ServiceNow administration and configuration experience.




  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is required.




  • Post-secondary certificate or diploma in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.




  • Strong knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles, processes, and best practices.




  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow platform configuration, customization, workflow automation, reporting, security, and integrations.




  • Working knowledge of JavaScript and ServiceNow APIs for developing and configuring platform solutions.




  • Experience supporting platform administration, access management, troubleshooting, and system maintenance.




  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.




  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and external vendors.




  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and contribute to cross-functional projects and continuous improvement initiatives.





What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:



  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees

  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)

  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)

  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!

  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September

  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!

  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment

  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!




Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.



Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support

  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading

  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions

  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting

  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio




How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.


Equal Opportunity and AccessibilityAlimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.



Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.


Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

While collaborating with customers, partners, and the wider ServiceNow sales team, the right candidate will create and communicate high-level architectures and strategies that are both written and verbal, to audiences up to and including the CIO/CTO level. The Enterprise Architect will elegantly articulate the advantage of ServiceNow being built on a single cloud platform consisting of a single user interface, one code base and one data model.   • Work with architecture development methods, modelling approaches and architecture patterns for integration
  • Interact at multiple levels within a customer account (Enterprise Architects, Domain Architects, Directors, VPs, and CXOs) and maintain these relationships throughout their customer journey.
  • Provide thought leadership and collaborate with internal ServiceNow business units
  • Identify, lead and contribute to the creation of best practices, white papers, workshops, etc

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Passion and energy for building business relationships and is accustomed to driving the simplification of complex concepts into compelling customer proposals
  • Drive for results using out-of-the-box innovative thinking together with excellent problem-solving skills
  • An intrinsic ability to understand and prioritize work and is willing to make big bets when the time is right, to invest time and energy in the right areas.
  • Willingness to jump-in and roll-up their sleeves alongside customers, colleagues and partners to get things done faster and better.
  • 15 or more years of proven success in influencing senior technology leaders to drive change in a pre-sales, customer, or delivery focused role.
  • Successfully lead diverse teams to reach challenging goals and can leverage organizational networks to get things done.
  • A track record of success in using Human Centered Design techniques to explore the customers current reality and set a vision for the future.
  • Expertise designing, implementing and managing advanced architectures in an application domain and integrating multiple systems or platforms
  • A proven track record of success with Enterprise Architecture or Application Architecture; pre-sales in a software vendor, in a large Enterprise or professional services environment.
  • Familiarity with common Enterprise and Industry Architecture frameworks such as: TOGAF, Zachman, IT4IT, BIAN, TMForum, etc.
  • Excellent understanding of the architectural principles for cloud-based platforms that include SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and automation
  • Experience and understanding of multiple technical domains - application, data, DevOps, AI/ML, integration, big data, mobility, analytics, etc.
  • Intrinsically curious and passionate about researching current and emerging technologies and developing innovative solutions
  • Experience presenting architecture concepts, designs, and goals to technology leaders and partners

consider.title: Senior Applications Analyst
consider.description:
Job Description

McCarthy Tétrault is a leading Canadian law firm offering a full suite of legal and business solutions to clients in Canada and around the world. With offices in Toronto, Montréal, Québec City, Calgary and Vancouver, we provide challenging and rewarding career opportunities across the country. Recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for eleven consecutive years and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers for fourteen consecutive years, our culture is guided by The McCarthy Way—our shared approach to working with clients and with each other.

The McCarthy Way is built on four core elements: Excellence, through attracting and developing top talent committed to delivering on our Client Commitment; Collaboration, through seamless, integrated teamwork; Inclusion, through eliminating barriers to belonging and success; and Innovation, through delivering maximum value by embracing leading-edge technologies and approaches. Together, these principles shape how we work, lead, and grow—every day.

We are recruiting for a Senior Applications Analyst to join our team in our Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary or Montreal offices. The successful candidate must have a minimum of 7 years experience in progressive IT Experience. McCarthy Tétrault employees benefit from a hybrid work environment. This position is to fill an existing vacancy.

Salary Range (Toronto or Vancouver Only): $110,000 – $112,000 annually

The offered salary may vary based on the candidate’s job-specific knowledge, skills, and experience.

As a Senior Applications Analyst, duties and responsibilites include:

  • Application Portfolio: Lead the analysis, design, testing, and implementation of updates, enhancements, and new capabilities across the application portfolio, ensuring alignment with user requirements and business objectives. This includes overseeing the full application lifecycle from planning and development through deployment, support, and continuous improvement, while identifying opportunities to leverage automation and emerging technologies to enhance efficiency and business value.
  • Project Delivery: Participate and act as application lead for projects related to upgrades, integrations, and new deployments. Work with vendors and internal teams to plan and execute system changes with minimal disruption, supporting the delivery of modern cloud, automation, and productivity solutions as part of broader digital initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with IT groups and business stakeholders. Gather and document business requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and coordinate with cross-functional teams (e.g. developers, vendors, end-users) to implement application changes or new systems. Clearly communicate application capabilities and limitations to stakeholders to set appropriate expectations.
  • Operational Support: Monitor application performance and availability on a daily basis, troubleshoot issues promptly, and implement solutions to maximize system reliability and user satisfaction. Ensure that any incidents or problems are resolved and properly documented, with steps taken to prevent recurrence. Act with discretion to address major incidents during critical periods, including outside regular hours when necessary, to maintain application stability and support business continuity.
  • Documentation & Knowledge: Develop and maintain documentation for application configurations, processes, and procedures. Create knowledge articles and deliver knowledge transfer sessions to support effective use of applications, promote consistent practices, and enable adoption of new capabilities across the organization.
  • Compliance: Adhere to ITIL best practices, security policies, and governance standards across the application portfolio. Ensure systems meet corporate and regulatory requirements for data security, privacy, and responsible use of technology.
  • Mentorship & Leadership: Serve as a senior technical resource on the team by mentoring Application Analysts and IT Service Management team. Support the Manager, Applications in the administration and operation of the application portfolio life cycle. Provide guidance on team processes, enforce quality standards in deliverables, and champion continuous improvement and knowledge sharing —
  • Security Partnership: Act as a key liaison with the Security team to support security governance processes, including security assessments, risk remediation activities, and the integration of security considerations into application design and change activities. Provides subject matter expertise on application architecture, data flows, and integrations to help identify risks, assess impacts, and support informed security decisions.
  • Quality Assurance Partnership: Partner with Quality Assurance teams to support and strengthen testing and quality processes, including contributing to test strategies, validating complex changes, and addressing systemic quality issues. Assist with test device preparation, issue reproduction, defect resolution, and post-change validation. Where applicable, explore the use of AI-assisted testing and automation tools to improve coverage and efficiency.
  • AI Platforms, Tools, Development & Support: The Senior Applications Analyst will support the implementation, configuration, and integration of AI-enabled capabilities within the enterprise application portfolio, working within the architectural patterns and standards defined for the enterprise. This includes building and configuring AI features in business applications and workflows, helping evaluate AI platforms and tools, and contributing to the identification of practical use cases. The role will collaborate with business, application, data, security, and vendor teams to deliver AI solutions that are secure, supportable, and consistent with established enterprise architecture standards. Responsibilities include applying recommended AI development practices — including integration, data access, prompt design, testing, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance — and providing day-to-day support for AI-enabled solutions. The Senior Applications Analyst will also help uphold AI governance by ensuring solutions are implemented in accordance with organizational standards for privacy, security, ethical use, data protection, and regulatory compliance, and by adopting the reusable frameworks and best practices established for the organization.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve application performance, reliability, and user experience through trend analysis, user feedback, and operational insights. Proactively recommend enhancements and process improvements, leveraging modern tools and approaches where appropriate.
  • Applications Support: Following ITIL incident and problem management best practices as second/third level support in incident resolution related to applications, with a focus on escalated issues, root cause analysis, and major/high priority incidents.

As our ideal candidate, you will distinguish yourself by the following profile:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent practical experience in IT).
  • 7+ years of progressive IT experience, including 3+ years in a senior/lead application analyst role.
  • Broad technical knowledge across modern IT environments – including Azure & 3rd party cloud services (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), enterprise software (Microsoft 365 platform), networking and security principles – and full SDLC experience across on-premise and cloud platforms.
  • Proven ability to conceptualize, design, and implement application solutions and digital initiatives (e.g. cloud migrations, process automations, AI-powered tools), seeing projects through from idea to deployment.
  • Experience with ITIL framework for support and operations; Agile/DevOps methodology experience for solution delivery (ITIL or Agile/DevOps certifications are an asset).
  • Demonstrated business acumen and strong ability to manage relationships with both business stakeholders and external partners/vendors.
  • Experience in a cloud-first and AI-focused organization (or consulting/professional services background) is an asset. Familiarity with AI productivity and collaboration platforms such as Microsoft 365 Copilot or Claude for Work is a strong asset.
  • Knowledge of PowerShell, JavaScript / TypeScript, C# / .NET, Python and other programming languages.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and platforms (e.g. Claude, Microsoft Copilot, agentic frameworks) and practical experience applying them to automate processes or enhance application capabilities. Working knowledge of how artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and automation can be applied to improve applications and business processes.
  • Working experience supporting Windows operating systems and the Microsoft Office / M365 suite.
  • Working experience with Microsoft Intune and SCCM.
  • Working experience administering Microsoft Active Directory and Azure AD.
  • Working experience using Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate).
  • Working experience with modern enterprise database technologies.
  • Working experience with Microsoft SharePoint.
  • Working experience with PowerShell, JavaScript / TypeScript, C# / .NET, Python and other programming languages.
  • Working experience with the Application System Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Working experience applying Application Development standards.
  • Practical experience implementing, configuring, and supporting AI capabilities within enterprise applications, including hands-on familiarity with modern AI platforms and tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure AI services, OpenAI technologies, Anthropic Claude, or comparable large language model (LLM) ecosystems.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to lead meetings, actively contribute in discussions, and share ideas clearly and professionally.
  • Demonstrated ownership of tasks and projects, taking initiative to drive work to completion beyond the minimum requirements. Candidates should be proactive in identifying solutions or improvements.
  • Demonstrates strategic thinking and sound problem-solving skills when navigating complex or ambiguous situations, including those involving emerging technology and AI adoption.
  • Advocates for strategic initiatives — including AI and automation programs — and constructively influences stakeholders to drive alignment and action.
  • Working knowledge of common AI solution patterns (e.g., generative AI, natural language processing, intelligent automation) and the ability to translate functional requirements into working, secure, and responsible AI-enabled solutions within defined architectural patterns.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI integration approaches (APIs, plugins, copilots), follow data privacy and security practices, support model lifecycle and monitoring activities, and work in alignment with responsible AI principles.
  • Ability to handle multiple concurrent pieces of work, and appropriately applying judgment about the prioritization of effort.
  • Maintains composure and effectiveness under pressure, delivering results within tight timelines when required.
  • Applies strong organizational and time-management skills to plan, execute, and follow through on work independently and collaboratively.
  • Bilingualism an asset (French and English).

Successful candidates will have significant experience administering, integrating, automating, troubleshooting, and supporting enterprise applications within Microsoft-centric environments. Candidates should have demonstrated experience with technologies such as:

  • Microsoft 365 and Azure services
  • PowerShell scripting and automation
  • Active Directory and Entra ID
  • Intune and SCCM
  • Application integrations and APIs
  • Power Platform
  • Cloud and SaaS platforms
  • AI-enabled solutions and automation platforms

Candidates whose experience is primarily focused on business analysis, requirements gathering, process mapping, project coordination, or product ownership without substantial technical implementation and support experience may not be a match for this position.

As a member of the McCarthy team, you will have access to:

  • Outstanding benefits from day one, including insurance premiums paid by the Firm and wellness and technology reimbursements.
  • Competitive compensation, paid overtimeand generous time off, including a day off to volunteer and a day off for your birthday.
  • A commitment to professional development and growth opportunities for our people at all levels, supported by a culture that fully embraces and encourages two-way feedback.
  • Strong community involvement and a commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion.
  • A collaborative, cohesive culture that connects lawyers and business teams through collective purpose.

How to Apply:

We encourage external candidates to apply online and internal applicants must apply directly through our internal careers portal on Espresso. We look forward to receiving your application.

McCarthy Tétrault utilizes artificial intelligence (AI) technology as part of our application screening process to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our recruitment efforts by analyzing applications to identify candidates whose qualifications and experiences align with the requirements of the position.

We thank all applicants for their interest in McCarthy Tétrault; however, only chosen applicants will be contacted. Please notify us if you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in capability-based architecture, enterprise architecture frameworks, application and technology architecture, and AI-enabled solutions. The role requires prior Ontario Public Service (OPS) or Federal Government experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain enterprise architecture strategies aligned with organizational objectives and business capabilities.
  • Lead capability-based architecture initiatives, including business capability mapping, process modelling, and technology alignment.
  • Assess and optimize application portfolios to improve performance, eliminate redundancy, reduce technical debt, and control IT costs.
  • Define and implement application portfolio management frameworks, governance standards, architecture blueprints, and technology roadmaps.
  • Conduct business and technical value assessments of enterprise applications, platforms, infrastructure, and IT investments.
  • Evaluate portfolio risks, vendor viability, technology lifecycles, cloud dependencies, and emerging market trends.
  • Design scalable, modular, and composable enterprise architectures leveraging shared platforms and reusable services.
  • Develop architecture models, documentation, roadmaps, and governance deliverables using enterprise architecture tools.
  • Support digital transformation by aligning business strategy, operational processes, enterprise systems, and data requirements.
  • Identify technology risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies across enterprise applications and infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and government stakeholders to support architecture decisions.
  • Prepare executive presentations, briefing notes, architectural recommendations, and stakeholder reports.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Proven experience in capability-based enterprise architecture and business capability modelling.
  • Prior Ontario Public Service (OPS) or Federal Government experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Application Architecture, Technology Architecture, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).
  • Extensive experience developing and implementing Enterprise Architecture strategies and frameworks.
  • Experience in Application Portfolio Management (APM), IT Governance, and technology roadmapping.
  • Demonstrated ability to align enterprise architecture with organizational strategy and business outcomes.

Required Technical Skills

  • Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies, including TOGAF or equivalent.
  • Enterprise Architecture modelling, blueprinting, repository management, and governance tools.
  • Application Portfolio Management, application rationalization, lifecycle management, and technology risk analysis.
  • Business Capability Mapping, Business Process Modelling, and enterprise transformation planning.
  • IT value assessment, technical debt analysis, vendor evaluation, and portfolio optimization.
  • Application, Technology, Cloud, and AI Architecture.
  • Composable Architecture, Modular Architecture, Enterprise Platforms, and Shared Services.
  • Architecture governance, compliance, reporting, and technology roadmap development.
  • Knowledge of CASE tools, software development methodologies, project management tools, and business process re-engineering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience facilitating architecture workshops and stakeholder meetings.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, and briefing note preparation skills.
  • Experience in project management, change management, and strategic IT planning.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and negotiation skills.

consider.title: Pega Lead System Architect
consider.description:
Job Title: Pega Lead System Architect

Total Experience: 10+ Years

Relevant Experience: 10+ Years

Domain (Industry): Banking

Work Location: Toronto, Canada

Work Mode: Hybrid

Shift Details: 2 PM to 11 PM


Role Summary

The Pega Lead System Architect is responsible for the end-to-end architecture, technical design, development governance, and successful implementation of enterprise applications built on Pega Platform. The role provides hands-on technical leadership, translates business needs into scalable solution designs, guides engineering teams, and ensures that applications are secure, performant, maintainable, and aligned with Pega guardrails and delivery standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead scope definition, requirements analysis, solution architecture, functional and technical design, application build, testing, deployment, and production transition.
  • Architect complex Pega solutions for case management, workflow automation, business rules, integrations, data access, security, and user experience.
  • Own application architecture decisions, including enterprise class structure, ruleset strategy, reusable components, data model, deployment approach, and integration patterns.
  • Provide technical governance through design reviews, code reviews, guardrail compliance checks, architecture checkpoints, and quality gates.
  • Lead and mentor System Architects, Senior System Architects, developers, and technical leads; assign technical work and remove design impediments.
  • Collaborate with clients, product owners, business analysts, program management, infrastructure teams, security teams, and integration partners.
  • Ensure non-functional requirements are addressed, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, maintainability, and operational support.
  • Guide performance analysis and tuning using appropriate Pega diagnostic and monitoring capabilities, including Pega Diagnostic Cloud where applicable.
  • Oversee integrations between Pega applications and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP services, messaging, file interfaces, databases, and other approved patterns.
  • Support release planning, deployment validation, production readiness, post-release monitoring, root-cause analysis, and resolution of critical technical issues.
  • Maintain architecture artefacts, technical specifications, decision records, deployment guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.
  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery through reusable assets, automation, platform capabilities, and Pega best practices.


Expected Deliverables

  • Solution architecture and high-level/low-level technical design artefacts.
  • Architecture decision records, integration specifications, data and security designs.
  • Design and code review findings, guardrail remediation plans, and quality evidence.
  • Capacity, performance, deployment, cutover, and production-readiness recommendations.
  • Technical delivery plan, estimates, risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions.
  • Mentoring, technical enablement, and knowledge-transfer plans for the delivery team.


Success Measures

  • Solution meets agreed business and non-functional requirements.
  • Architecture decisions are documented, traceable, and aligned with platform standards.
  • Delivery teams follow approved design patterns and Pega guardrails.
  • Technical risks and defects are identified early and driven to closure.
  • Production releases are stable, supportable, and operationally ready.
  • Client stakeholders receive clear, timely technical guidance and status communication.


Interview Focus Areas

  • End-to-end Pega solution architecture and design trade-offs.
  • Enterprise class structure, ruleset strategy, reuse, and application layering.
  • Integration, security, data, performance, scalability, and deployment architecture.
  • Pega guardrails, design/code reviews, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
  • Leadership of multi-location engineering teams and stakeholder management.
  • Practical experience with current Pega Platform capabilities relevant to the assignment.


Mandatory Skills

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of overall experience in information technology with extensive experience delivering Pega applications.
  • Pega Certified Lead System Architect (PCLSA/CLSA) certification.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Pega Platform, including App Studio and Dev Studio, case management, data model, security, integrations, reporting, background processing, and deployment.
  • Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Desired Skills

  • Experience with recent Pega capabilities such as Constellation architecture, DX API, Pega Blueprint, Pega GenAI, Pega Cloud, and Pega Diagnostic Cloud.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, and enterprise security controls.
  • Experience with Pega Decisioning, Customer Decision Hub, industry frameworks, or specialized Pega products relevant to the engagement.
  • Prior consulting experience in a client-facing environment and the ability to support proposals, estimates, technical discovery, and solution demonstrations.
  • Experience conducting architecture audits, performance reviews, technical risk assessments, and modernization or upgrade programs.

consider.title: Senior IT Systems Eng
consider.description:
Job Title

Senior IT Systems Eng

Role Overview

We are hiring a Senior IT Systems Engineer to run and scale the systems that keep our team productive and secure across our Toronto and Redwood City offices and our remote staff. You will be the right hand to the Head of IT and the day-to-day operational partner to our security engineering team: security writes the policy; you review and challenge it, then own its execution. IT is the single point of access to every system, so you will hold privileged access and be trusted to use it with care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enterprise SaaS Upgrades: Lead the move of our applications to enterprise-grade tiers as we buy or upgrade them: SSO/SCIM, admin roles, audit logs, data controls, and clean cutover plans.
  • Jira & Atlassian Administration: Own Jira Service Management and the wider Atlassian suite as admin: workflows, request forms, automation rules, JQL, and scripting against the Jira REST API.
  • IT Automation: Automate anything repetitive, by any means that fits: scripts, Okta Workflows, Jira automation, Slack, and API integrations. Example: access requests that flow from a Jira ticket through manager and IT approval to the right Okta group, with no manual steps.
  • Identity & Access: Administer Okta as our central identity provider. Build and maintain SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM integrations, using group-based access only, never per-user grants, and clean joiner/mover/leaver lifecycles tied to our HR system.
  • AWS Access & Administration: Administer AWS IAM Identity Center, Organizations, accounts, and permission sets, with Okta-driven group access for engineering, DevOps, and MLOps teams.
  • Endpoint & MDM: Manage macOS, Linux, and Windows fleets across more than one MDM, including remote scripting and script deployment, zero-touch enrollment, patching, disk encryption, and clean offboarding.
  • Security Policy Execution: Review and challenge policies from our security team for practicality, then implement and operate them: MFA baselines, conditional access, and endpoint controls.
  • SOC 2 Maintenance: Keep our SOC 2 certification healthy through ongoing audits: access reviews, evidence, and control upkeep.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Run day-one IT onboarding for new hires (devices, MFA, accounts) and offboarding, in both offices and remotely.
  • Network & Zero Trust: Own ZTNA/VPN and first-line network troubleshooting, and work with our in-house network engineer, landlords, and ISPs on office networking.
  • IT Support & Escalation: Work the IT ticket queue, resolve complex technical, network, and hardware issues, and guide junior staff and vendors.
  • Hardware & Asset Management: Own the full lifecycle of computers and peripherals: purchasing, inventory, assignment, tracking, repair, and retirement, with an accurate, audit-ready asset inventory.
  • Workspace & Vendors: Keep conference rooms and A/V reliable, manage hardware vendors, and maintain our software inventory.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in corporate IT (systems engineering, systems administration, or IT infrastructure). Security-only or cloud-only backgrounds are not enough; we need hands-on identity and endpoint work.
  • Okta (or similar IdP) experience, and a clear grasp of authentication versus provisioning: SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM, and just-in-time provisioning, and when to use each.
  • Good hands-on AWS experience, especially IAM, IAM Identity Center, and permission sets.
  • Hands-on MDM experience on macOS and Windows (JumpCloud, Rippling MDM, or Intune), including remote scripting through MDM (shell and PowerShell). Linux fleet exposure is a plus.
  • Strong Jira and Atlassian administration, including the ability to code against Jira: automation rules, JQL, workflows, and the REST API (ScriptRunner or Forge a plus).
  • A track record of moving SaaS applications to enterprise tiers and building IT automations end to end.
  • Google Workspace administration.
  • Networking fundamentals for troubleshooting: DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN/ZTNA.
  • Scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and comfort with REST APIs.
  • Experience maintaining SOC 2 (or ISO 27001) controls through audits, and working knowledge of least privilege, MFA, EDR, and patching.
  • Strong ownership, solid technical writing (process flows, runbooks, guides), and the confidence to review and challenge security policies before executing them.
  • This role requires occasional availability outside business hours, including late nights and weekends, to carry out upgrades and maintenance on mission-critical systems with minimal downtime.

Nice to Have

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Okta Workflows or other low-code automation experience.
  • Deep AWS expertise: Organizations, multi-account architecture, and core services (EC2, S3, VPC).
  • GCP experience (IAM, organization and project structure), Microsoft Entra ID, and infrastructure-as-code basics.
  • Slack Enterprise administration.
  • Compliance automation tools (Vanta).
  • Meraki or similar cloud-managed networking.
  • Conference room A/V and collaboration platform interop (Google Meet, Teams).
  • Certifications such as Okta Certified Professional, Atlassian Certified, or CCNA.

What We Offer

  • Modern, AI-influenced tooling, nothing legacy. Our stack is cloud-native and security-first (Okta, Slack Enterprise, Atlassian, GitHub, Vanta, zero-trust access), with no on-prem Active Directory, no legacy domain controllers, and no inherited tech debt to untangle. AI is built into how we work, so you’ll use it to automate IT workflows and speed up your own scripting, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Work at an AI-native company. We build AI agents that design and verify semiconductors. You’ll support a team doing work at the edge of both AI and silicon.
  • Be the owner, not a ticket-taker. You report to the Head of IT and shape how identity, endpoint, and access work at a company still building its foundations. Your designs become the standard, not a patch on someone else’s.
  • Automation-first IT. We expect you to script, integrate, and eliminate manual steps (Okta Workflows, Jira automation, APIs), not click through admin consoles all day. Time to build is part of the job.
  • Learn from a deeply technical engineering org. You’ll work alongside engineers in agentic systems, cloud infrastructure, and EDA, and see how a modern AI company runs.

consider.description:
Job Description

 Location: Toronto, Winnipeg

Referral Level: Level 1

Mackenzie Investments

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $ 310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025 . It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

At Mackenzie Investments You Can Build Your Career with Confidence . We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for the fourth consecutive year and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues ! Our Values: Be better ; we strive for improvement in everything we do . Be accountable ; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly . Be a team ; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals .

Overall Job Purpose

The Director, Citizen Development & Employee Technology Experience Pod Owner is responsible for leading and advancing two connected enterprise capabilities: enabling employees to safely improve how work gets done through Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate and approved low-code/no-code capabilities; and reducing technology friction through stronger employee experiences, communications, onboarding, short-form learning, TechTalks and adoption programs.

This role shapes and delivers the pod strategy, roadmap, operating model, governance, prioritization and measurable outcomes. The Director balances speed, innovation and employee empowerment with security, privacy, risk, operational resilience and supportability, ensuring employee-led technology adoption remains practical, governed and sustainable.

Key Accountabilities

  • Lead the pod vision, strategy, roadmap and priorities for Citizen Development and Employee Technology Experience, ensuring alignment to enterprise objectives, portfolio priorities and measurable business outcomes.
  • Operate and launch and then continuously improve the Citizen Development operating model, including scope, intake, prioritization, decision rights, solution classification, lifecycle oversight, support model, escalation paths and value measurement.
  • Enable governed adoption of Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate and approved low-code/no-code capabilities, with clear boundaries between employee-led solutions and work requiring business-led or technology-led delivery.
  • Maintain practical guardrails for safe innovation, including solution registration, ownership, risk tiering, control gates, security review, privacy considerations and operational supportability.
  • Identify employee technology friction across corporate and advisor communities and sponsor practical improvements that improve productivity, adoption, service experience and confidence in technology.
  • Lead employee technology communications, TechTalks, digital learning content, short video learning, tech tips, onboarding support and awareness campaigns that make technology easier to understand and adopt.
  • Manage and refine the pod backlog, making informed trade-offs across value, risk, cost, capacity, quality, employee experience, technical sustainability and operational impact.
  • Coordinate agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint execution, reviews and retrospectives to maintain delivery discipline, transparency and momentum.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching and feedback to pod team members; partner with Product and Delivery Chapters on standards, capability development, staffing and best practices.
  • Build strong partnerships across business teams, Technology, Security, Risk, Privacy, Architecture, Service Management, enterprise platform teams and corporate support functions.
  • Communicate roadmaps, progress, risks, decisions, dependencies and performance clearly to stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Track measures for adoption, employee experience, productivity, business value, cost, operational health, risk and supportability, and use insights to improve priorities and outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Digital Transformation or a related field required; equivalent experience considered an asset
  • 5–8 years of progressive experience in enterprise technology, digital workplace, product, automation, artificial intelligence, employee experience, service management or technology delivery
  • Experience supporting strategies, operating models, roadmaps, governance frameworks and measurable outcomes for enterprise technology capabilities
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Power Automate and related enterprise technology environments
  • Strong understanding of governance, security, privacy, technology risk, operational resilience and support models in a regulated environment
  • Ability to translate emerging technology into practical employee and business value
  • Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder-management and decision-framing skills
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary work, manage priorities and coordinate delivery across organizational boundaries
  • Collaborative, pragmatic, change-oriented and outcome-focused leadership style
  • Passion for improving employee technology experience, reducing friction and enabling safe, governed innovation

What Success Looks Like

Success means employees can confidently adopt technology and safely improve how work gets done; technology friction is visible and addressed; Citizen Development operates within clear boundaries and guardrails; and leaders have reliable visibility into adoption, employee experience, business value, cost, operational health and risk.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $149,500 - $192,500 which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

Benefits

 Benefits :

IGM is a diverse workplace committed to doing business inclusively - this starts with having a representative workforce! consider.title: Senior Engineer, Cloud Operations
consider.description:
At Sleep Country Canada/Dormez-vous? (SCC/DV), we are inspired every day through our purpose to transform lives by awakening Canadians to the power of sleep and our vision to champion sleep as the key to healthier and happier lives, helping everyone achieve better tomorrows through better tonight’s.

Guided by our values – We CARE About People; We WIN Together; We DREAM Big and We DELIVER with Excellence – we are building on our 30-year foundation of taking care of each other and our customers’ sleep needs, with passion and commitment to be the best that we can be. We invest in our sleep ecosystem, innovative products, world-class customer experience, our communities and diverse best-in-class team to be Canada’s leading sleep partner.

We’re looking for someone to join our exceptional team as we continue to advance the future of sleep wellness.

Description D'emploi

Sleep Country Canada is looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer to plays a key role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and security of Sleep Country’s multi-cloud environment. This position combines hands-on engineering with strategic problem-solving to design, build, and optimize cloud-based systems, while driving continuous improvement and innovation across cloud operations.

In This Current Open Role You Will

  • Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure across multiple platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) to support business applications and services.
  • Implement configurations for compute, storage, networking, and cloud services following best practices for scalability and resilience, performing regular maintenance, patching, and environment updates to ensure systems remain current and performant.
  • Monitor cloud systems and services using enterprise monitoring and alerting tools to ensure uptime and performance, Investigating and troubleshooting incidents and problems, performing root-cause analysis and timely remediation of cloud infrastructure issues.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule for after-hours support, responding to critical incidents to restore services and minimize downtime in line with service level objectives.
  • Develop and manage automation scripts and CI/CD pipelines to streamline cloud deployments and operations, Utilizing infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to provision and configure cloud resources reliably and repeatedly.
  • Implement automated build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with DevOps and development teams, reducing manual effort and improving consistency across environments.
  • Analyze system performance metrics and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of cloud operations, optimize resource usage and application performance through tuning and capacity planning.
  • Evaluate and adopt new tools and practices (including emerging AIOps platforms, intelligent monitoring, and auto-remediation technologies) to enhance operational capabilities.
  • Contribute to improving operational playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge bases for the cloud operations function.
  • Implement and adhere to security and compliance controls within cloud environments, following corporate IT security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements (e.g., data protection, privacy) in all cloud configuration and deployment activities.
  • Work closely with Security and Compliance teams to remediate vulnerabilities, manage cloud access and encryption keys, and ensure that cloud infrastructure and processes pass audits and meet governance standards.
  • Maintain accurate documentation for configurations and changes as part of compliance and change management processes.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to document procedures and clearly convey technical information to teammates and stakeholders, effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams (Cloud Ops, DevOps, Developers, Security, Vendors) to implement solutions and resolve issues.

The Qualifications And Experience We Like To See

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems or a related field.
  • Approximately 5+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, with a focus on deploying and managing cloud-based environments.
  • Demonstrated success in supporting complex, distributed systems and services in a production (24/7) environment.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of public cloud platforms (such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform), including experience with compute, storage, networking, and managed services.
  • Proficiency in designing highly available, scalable cloud architectures and implementing cloud networking concepts (VPC/VNet configuration, security groups, load balancers, etc.). Strong understanding of virtualization and containerization technologies; experience with container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes) is an asset.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure automation and DevOps practices.
  • Proficiency in writing scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) to automate system tasks and deployments.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) to automate build, test, and deployment processes.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) for provisioning and managing cloud resources.
  • Proven ability in monitoring, incident management, and performance tuning for cloud-based systems. Experience using modern observability tools (such as Dynatrace, Datadog, CloudWatch, etc.) to collect metrics, logs, and traces, and to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the capacity to perform root cause analysis and implement effective fixes under pressure. Comfortable working in an on-call rotation, and capable of making sound decisions quickly during critical incidents to restore service.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to document procedures and clearly convey technical information to teammates and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and adaptability in keeping pace with evolving technologies and practices in cloud computing, including willingness and aptitude to learn and utilize new tools (including AI-driven operations tools, automated monitoring/alerting systems) to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Experience with BigCommerce, Shopify, or similar cloud-based eCommerce platforms.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and/or Oracle Fusion Cloud applications in an operational setting considered an asset.

Why members of our Corporate team love working at Sleep Country Canada/Dormez-vous?:

  • This is not a job but a CAREER with opportunities for growth and advancement
  • Diverse and inclusive work environment
  • We will invest in you and provide extensive training, mentoring and continuous development
  • Access to training and development platforms
  • Full medical, dental benefits and a Deferred Profit Sharing Program
  • Annual Wellness Credit of up to $250.00 for any products/services that improve your health and well-being, i.e., health assessments, nutrition counselling, hiking shoes, a yoga outfit or fitness equipment!
  • Associate Discount Program where you will be able to enjoy some of the world’s best sleep products
  • Maternity/Parental leave top up benefits
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program that covers professional AND personal development
  • Long service awards, celebrations and other social events
  • Associate Referral Program
  • Paid day off to volunteer at your local charity of choice

Additional Information

This is a current open position. The salary range for this position is $105,000 - $130,000 annually. Actual salary for the role may vary depending on work location of the successful candidate and other factors including but not limited to, skills, education, experience, working conditions and the local labor market.

Our recruitment process incorporates various screening technologies, which may include AI, to screen for employability or suitability. Human recruiters review all applications.

Inclusion & Belonging

We are committed to building a company culture of inclusion and diversity where differences are embraced and valued, this allows us to better understand and meet the needs of our customers and the communities we serve. We want to ensure every job applicant is treated fairly and with respect regarding race, national or ethnic origin, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, or disability. Upon request, accommodations are available during all stages of the recruitment process.

consider.title: Information Technology Manager
consider.description:
IT Manager

Role: Full-time, on-site (5 days/week)

Location: Etobicoke, Ontario (Toronto)

Comp: $100,000-$120,000 base + bonus + benefits


About Us

A profitable, privately owned, growing B2B company in the industrial space. Proudly Canadian and entrepreneurial, serving business customers across North America.


With under 100 employees and a small, hands-on IT function, we're scaling while keeping a practical, no-politics, get-it-done culture.


How We Work

Technology should make the business run better, not just keep the lights on.


This role reports to the Director of IT and mentors other IT team members. It's a player/coach role: you set the plan, advise the team and build the infra. Perfect for those who like to be close to the action, but also influence the big IT decisions. Occasional travel between our Ontario sites.


Here's how your time will generally split (actual time will vary weekly):

  • IT Leadership and Planning (about 25%): Building the annual IT roadmap and budget with senior leadership, deciding which projects get green-lit, leading upgrades end to end, and managing vendors and our MSP relationship. Coaching and prioritizing the team's work.
  • Business Applications & ERP (25%): Tier 2/3 support for our ERP and CRM, maintaining an internal quote-generation system that pulls from ERP data. Planning upgrades/testing. Key tech: Epicor Prophet 21, Salesforce, SQL, Fivetran / Azure Data Factory
  • Infrastructure and Networking (20%): Ensuring that switches, wireless, VPN, servers, and backups are healthy across our sites. Key tech: Ubiquiti UniFi, virtualization, backup platforms
  • Microsoft 365 and Cloud (15%): Running the tenant, access and compliance policies, user onboarding/offboarding and device management, plus SaaS licences and renewals. Key tech: Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Intune, Entra ID), Azure
  • Security and Voice (15%): Triaging security alerts, tuning policies against Secure Score, and running the phone system end to end. Key tech: Microsoft Defender, Teams Phone (Direct Routing, call queues, E911)


Note: We're planning to onboard an external MSP this year for first-response support and after-hours monitoring; you'll own that relationship and be the internal escalation point.


About You

You're an IT Manager who never stopped being a Systems Administrator. You've led a small team, but you're equally comfortable in an ERP workflow, a network dashboard, and a Microsoft 365 tenant, and you'd rather fix it than delegate it when that's faster.


You take ownership of outcomes, explain trade-offs to leadership in plain language, and make the call on where time and money go. You document what you build, and the business trusts your judgment on technology.


You Bring:

  • 1+ years managing an IT team, including hiring, coaching, and prioritizing a small team's work
  • Experience building and owning an annual IT plan and budget, and presenting it to senior management
  • Track record deciding which IT projects proceed, then leading them from planning through rollout
  • Experience managing vendors and an MSP relationship: escalations, SLAs, SaaS licences and renewals, and software purchase decisions
  • Strong experience administering Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Intune, Entra ID), including Conditional Access, DLP, and sensitivity labels
  • Hands-on ERP administration: users, roles, module setup, master data, upgrades, and UAT (Epicor Prophet 21 or similar tools like SAP, MS Dynamics, NetSuite)
  • Experience managing networks end to end (VLANs, switching, wireless, routing, VPN, DNS/DHCP), plus servers, virtualization, and tested backup and recovery
  • Security operations experience: triaging Defender alerts, tuning identity and endpoint policies against Secure Score, and supporting audits
  • Experience administering Microsoft Teams Phone (Direct Routing/SBC, call queues, auto attendants, E911)
  • Practical experience rolling out or governing AI tools (such as Microsoft Copilot) with the right data and access controls


Qualifications:

  • 8+ years in IT systems administration or infrastructure roles
  • 1+ years managing people
  • Post-secondary diploma or degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph)
  • Comfort writing SQL queries against business databases
  • Strong documentation habits: runbooks, integration maps, change logs, and diagrams


Bonus Points:

  • Experience using AI and automation to take repetitive IT work off the plate, such as user provisioning, ticket triage, and system monitoring and alerts
  • Salesforce administration experience
  • Experience with Ubiquiti UniFi networking
  • Azure governance and cost management, or pipeline tooling (Fivetran, Azure Data Factory)
  • Experience in distribution, manufacturing, or multi-site operations
  • Certifications such as MS-102, AZ-104, CCNA, or Security+


Perks:

  • This role includes Health and Dental benefits + an Annual Bonus Plan


Equal opportunity employer. This posting is for an existing vacancy. AI-assisted tools support our sourcing and application review; every hiring decision is made by a person. Interviewed candidates will hear back within 45 days.

consider.title: Spécialiste, prix et tarification
consider.description:
Nous recherchons un ou une spécialiste, prix et tarification qui allie de solides compétences analytiques à un bon jugement commercial. Vous jouerez un rôle important dans la croissance rentable de nos activités au Canada en examinant la tarification des projets, en analysant les conditions du marché et en prenant des décisions de tarification qui tiennent compte de la compétitivité, des besoins de la clientèle et de la rentabilité.

En étroite collaboration avec les équipes des ventes, des finances et du marketing, les équipes techniques et nos partenaires de distribution, vous fournirez des conseils en tarification pour aider les équipes à se démarquer de la concurrence et à prendre des décisions d’affaires éclairées.

Que ferez-vous ?

  • Examiner et approuver les demandes de tarification et les modifications de prix liées aux projets, en veillant à leur exactitude et au respect des lignes directrices en matière de tarification.
  • Prendre des décisions de tarification en temps opportun en tenant compte de la compétitivité, des marges et des besoins de la clientèle.
  • Suivre les conditions du marché, les activités de la concurrence et les tendances des gains et des pertes de contrats pour orienter les stratégies de tarification.
  • Repérer les occasions d’accroître la rentabilité et d’offrir davantage de valeur à la clientèle.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes des ventes et les équipes régionales pour définir les stratégies commerciales et formuler des recommandations de tarification.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe des finances pour améliorer l’exactitude des données sur les coûts et les marges.
  • Établir des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires de distribution et répondre à leurs questions sur la tarification des projets.
  • Offrir de la formation et des conseils sur les processus, les politiques et les outils de tarification.
  • Repérer les occasions de simplifier, d’améliorer et d’automatiser les processus de tarification.

Quelles qualifications vous permettront de réussir?

  • 3+ ans d’expérience en tarification, en préparation de soumissions, en opérations de vente ou en ventes internes, idéalement dans le secteur des produits électriques ou de la distribution.
  • Connaissance des produits, des systèmes et des applications électriques.
  • Compréhension de l’analyse des marges, des coûts et de la rentabilité.

  • Maîtrise avancée de Microsoft Excel et expérience avec des systèmes de gestion de la relation client, de préparation de soumissions ou de gestion intégrée des ressources de l’entreprise, comme Salesforce ou SAP.
