consider.title: Bilingual Contract Specialist (English/French)
consider.description:
Acute Care Technology

At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.

The Acute Care Technology division of ZOLL Medical Corporation develops and delivers innovative lifesaving products and software solutions to EMS, hospital, public safety, and military customers globally. Products include AEDs, trauma kits, ventilators, temperature management solutions, and more. Our dedicated employees take pride in their commitment to improving patient outcomes while delivering world-class customer service.

At ZOLL, you won't just have a job. You'll have a career—and a purpose.

Join our team. It's a great time to be a part of ZOLL!

Job Summary

The Bilingual Contract Specialist provides essential administrative and operational support across the tender and contract lifecycle for ZOLL Medical's Canadian commercial operations. This role supports the preparation, coordination, and tracking of bids, contracts, pricing updates, and customer agreements.

The Bilingual Contract Specialist is detail-oriented, organized, fluent in both English and French, and works cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Risk, Operations, and Customer Service teams.

Essential Functions

  • Support the preparation, coordination, and submission of RFP/RFQ responses and proposal documents for Canadian customers.
  • Assist the Commercial Contract Manager in maintaining bid and contract tracking tools, ensuring deadlines and documentation remain accurate.
  • Help draft, review, and process commercial contracts and customer agreements, ensuring compliance with internal policies.
  • Coordinate approval workflows, signatures, and document management within contract systems.
  • Support pricing activities in validating customer eligibility and implementing updates or amendments.
  • Help investigate and resolve pricing or contract discrepancies by gathering information and collaborating with Sales and Customer Service.
  • Maintain accurate records for GPO memberships, customer agreements, amendments, and product/pricing updates.
  • Work with internal teams (Sales, Legal, Operations, Risk) to gather information needed for contract and proposal activities.
  • Contribute to maintaining templates, libraries, and administrative tools used for bids and contracts.
  • Assist the Commercial Contract Manager with identifying process improvements that enhance accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.

Required/Preferred Education And Experience

  • Post-secondary education in Business, Administration, Paralegal, or a related field required
  • 2+ years of experience in contract administration, proposals, procurement, or related administrative work required

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Fluency in English and French (written and verbal) required
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accurate documentation
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with Salesforce, DocuSign, and Ariba or a similar contract management system is a plus
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams
  • Ability to interpret and organize contract or pricing information with guidance from the Commercial Contract Manager
  • Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Standing - Occasionally
  • Walking - Occasionally
  • Sitting - Constantly
  • Talking - Occasionally
  • Hearing - Occasionally
  • Repetitive Motions - Frequently

ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients' lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Join us in our efforts to improve outcomes for underserved patients suffering from critical cardiopulmonary conditions and help save more lives.

Français

Le spécialiste des contrats bilingue apportera un soutien administratif et opérationnel essentiel tout au long du cycle de vie des appels d’offres et des contrats pour les activités commerciales de ZOLL Medical au Canada. Ce poste consiste à soutenir la préparation, la coordination et le suivi des appels d’offres, des contrats, des mises à jour tarifaires et des accords clients.

Le candidat idéal est minutieux, organisé, maîtrise parfaitement l’anglais et le français, et est à l’aise pour travailler de manière transversale avec les équipes commerciales, juridiques, de gestion des risques, des opérations et du service client.

Responsabilités principales

  • Assister à la préparation, à la coordination et à la soumission des réponses aux appels d’offres et des documents de proposition destinés aux clients canadiens.
  • Aider le responsable des contrats commerciaux à gérer les outils de suivi des appels d’offres et des contrats, en veillant à ce que les échéances et la documentation restent exactes.
  • Aider à la rédaction, à la révision et au traitement des contrats commerciaux et des accords clients, en veillant au respect des politiques internes.
  • Coordonner les processus de validation, les signatures et la gestion des documents au sein des systèmes de gestion des contrats.
  • Soutenir les activités de tarification en validant l’éligibilité des clients et en mettant en œuvre les mises à jour ou les modifications.
  • Contribuer à l’analyse et à la résolution des divergences de tarification ou contractuelles en recueillant des informations et en collaborant avec les équipes des ventes et du service client.
  • Tenir à jour des registres précis concernant les adhésions aux GPO, les accords clients, les avenants et les mises à jour des produits et des tarifs.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes internes (Ventes, Juridique, Opérations, Risques) afin de recueillir les informations nécessaires aux activités liées aux contrats et aux propositions.
  • Contribuer à la mise à jour des modèles, des bibliothèques et des outils administratifs utilisés pour les appels d’offres et les contrats.
  • Assister le responsable des contrats commerciaux dans l’identification d’améliorations de processus visant à renforcer la précision, l’efficacité et la conformité.

Qualifications

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais et du français (écrit et oral) requise.
  • Formation en commerce, administration, assistance juridique ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • 2+ ans d’expérience dans l’administration des contrats, les appels d’offres, les achats ou des tâches administratives connexes.
  • Grand souci du détail, capacité à gérer plusieurs échéances simultanées et à tenir à jour une documentation précise.
  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) ; une expérience avec Salesforce, DocuSign et Ariba ou un système de gestion des contrats similaire est un atout.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires.
  • Capacité à interpréter et à organiser les informations relatives aux contrats ou aux tarifs sous la supervision du responsable des contrats commerciaux.
  • Sens de l’organisation et capacité à travailler dans un environnement dynamique, soumis à des délais serrés.

The Annual Salary For This Position Is

$60,000.00 to $68,000.00

Factors which may affect starting salary include geography, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Details of ZOLL's comprehensive benefits plans can be found at www.zollbenefits.com.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until this position is filled. For fully remote positions, compensation will comply with all applicable federal, state, and local wage laws, including minimum wage requirements, based on the employee’s primary work location.

consider.title: Digital Analytics Implementation Tech Lead
consider.description:
The Digital Analytics Implementation Tech Lead provides technical leadership for Adobe Analytics implementation and digital data collection across BMO's digital experiences. The role is responsible for establishing implementation standards, guiding complex technical solutions, strengthening data quality and governance, and ensuring analytics implementations are scalable, reliable, and aligned with enterprise standards.

As a technical subject matter expert, the Tech Lead provides day-to-day technical oversight and guidance to Digital Analytics Implementation Primes, translates measurement requirements into technical solutions, strengthens testing and validation practices using tools such as ObservePoint and BrowserStack, and drives continuous improvement across implementation frameworks, tooling, documentation, and technical processes.

The role partners closely with business, technology, Product Ownership, and vendor teams to identify dependencies and technical risks, provide implementation recommendations, and enable trusted digital analytics data for business reporting, measurement, and decision-making.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Lead Adobe Analytics data collection implementations across digital properties, providing technical direction, solution design, and implementation expertise.
  • Translate measurement requirements into scalable technical solutions, including recommendations on feasibility, effort, dependencies, and risks.
  • Establish and maintain implementation, Adobe Launch, testing, QA, documentation, and data quality standards.
  • Provide technical oversight across analytics implementations, integrations, migrations, platform activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with Product Owners and delivery teams on technical planning, estimation, dependencies, risks, progress, and issue resolution.
  • Act as the team's technical SME, providing mentorship, coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical enablement.
  • Partner with Adobe, BrowserStack, ObservePoint, Technology teams, and other stakeholders on platform support, capabilities, roadmap changes, and implementation best practices.
  • Communicate technical status, risks, issues, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.


Qualifications

  • Significant experience implementing enterprise digital analytics solutions, with strong Adobe Analytics expertise.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Adobe Analytics data collection and tag-management practices.
  • Experience translating business measurement requirements into technical analytics designs and implementation specifications.
  • Experience with implementation testing, QA, troubleshooting, and data-quality validation.
  • Strong understanding of digital analytics data layers, tagging, implementation standards, and governance.
  • Experience leading technical solutions across complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to provide technical mentorship and guidance without formal people-management accountability.


Salary:

$70,000.00 - $150,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.bmo.com/global/en/Total-Rewards

About Us

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

To find out more visit us at https://jobs.bmo.com/ca/en

BMO is committed to an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace. By learning from each other’s differences, we gain strength through our people and our perspectives. consider.title: Fullstack Technical Lead – Commercial Lending & Asset Finance
consider.company: Astra-North Infoteck Inc.  ~ Conquering today’s challenges, achieving tomorrow’s vision!
consider.description:
Job Description: Fullstack Technical Lead – Commercial Lending & Asset Finance
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Fullstack Technical Lead to drive hands-on engineering, technical design, and day-to-day delivery of enterprise Commercial Lending and Asset Finance platforms.

The ideal candidate will balance hands-on coding with technical leadership, actively developing across the full software ecosystem, building modern integrations, and overseeing cloud-native deployments for complex commercial loan and equipment financing applications.

Key Responsibilities
  • Hands-On Development: Deliver high-quality code across backend (Java, Spring Boot, Python) and frontend (TypeScript, JavaScript) ecosystems to build resilient lending and asset-management features.
  • Platform Lifecycle: Develop and maintain integrations with financial frameworks like Supernova to streamline platform originations and automation.
  • Technical Leadership: Establish and enforce engineering best practices, including robust code reviews, automated testing, and reliable deployment workflows.
  • Design & Architecture: Translate business goals into concrete technical tasks, contribute directly to High-Level Designs (HLD), and own low-level implementation details.
  • Data & Cloud Delivery: Model transactional schemas for Oracle Database while deploying applications into AWS Cloud environments managed through Terraform and Kubernetes.
  • Team Mentorship: Provide daily guidance, mentorship, and support to engineers to elevate engineering standards and accelerate sprint delivery.
Qualifications
  • Domain Expertise: Proven engineering experience supporting banking lending platforms, equipment financing, asset lifecycle tracking, or commercial leasing applications.
  • Fullstack Engineering: Strong hands-on development skills across Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Python.
  • Cloud & Containers: Direct experience deploying and debugging applications in AWS using Kubernetes and Terraform infrastructure-as-code configurations.
  • Data Management: Proficiency in database design, querying, and performance tuning within Oracle Database environments.
  • Platform Experience: Familiarity or direct experience implementing or extending Supernova financial product components.
  • Technical Leadership: Proven track record of providing direct technical direction, mentorship, and code guidance to software development squads.

consider.title: Conseiller ou conseillère en gestion des vulnérabilités et ServiceNow SecOps-FR
consider.description:
À titre de conseiller(-ère) en gestion des vulnérabilités et ServiceNow SecOps, vous êtes responsable de la solution ServiceNow SecOps, l’outil central de la gestion des vulnérabilités du Mouvement Desjardins. Vous en orientez l’évolution en fonction des besoins de l’équipe et des priorités de l’organisation, tout en veillant à sa stabilité et à sa fiabilité au quotidien. Vous faites le lien entre les utilisateurs, les équipes techniques et le fournisseur pour que la plateforme continue de soutenir efficacement nos opérations. Vous contribuez aussi directement au traitement des vulnérabilités, ce qui vous donne une compréhension concrète de la réalité des utilisateurs de la solution. Vous jouez un rôle de conseil auprès des équipes TI et Affaires. Vous les aidez à comprendre les risques et à prendre les bonnes décisions pour protéger les systèmes du Mouvement Desjardins. Votre connaissance de la plateforme et du processus de gestion des vulnérabilités vous permet de proposer des améliorations concrètes, autant dans l’outil que dans nos façons de faire. La nature des dossiers demande une bonne maîtrise de la gestion des vulnérabilités et de ServiceNow, ainsi qu’une solide capacitée d’analyse de risque et de priorisation des besoins d’affaires. Vous proposez des solutions et des plans d’action qui vont dans le sens des orientations de l’organisation. Vous contribuez à la résolution de problèmes complexes, qui touchent souvent à la fois la technologie, les processus et les gens. Reconnu comme une référence dans votre domaine au sein de la Vice-Présidence, vous partagez votre expertise et soutenez le développement de vos collègues. Vous collaborez avec plusieurs parties prenantes aux intérêts parfois différents. De bonnes relations interpersonnelles sont donc une compétence essentielle. Plus spécifiquement, vous serez amené(e) à :

Gestion de produit ServiceNow SecOps

  • Agir à titre de product owner de la solution ServiceNow SecOps (VR/AVR/CVR/CC)
  • Déterminer et mettre à jour la feuille de route produit
  • Comprendre et faire prioriser les changements de la plateforme
  • Participer aux incidents et résoudre les enjeux de stabilité de la plateforme
  • Entretenir la relation avec le fournisseur
  • Assurer une documentation de la plateforme

Gestion des vulnérabilités

  • Analyser quotidiennement les vulnérabilités issues des sources de détections
  • Gérer les exceptions, faux positifs, etc.
  • Mettre en contexte d’entreprise les vulnérabilités afin d’assurer un traitement adéquat
  • Assigner les vulnérabilités aux parties concernées selon le processus en place, incluant une recommandation contextualisée
  • Agir en tant qu’expert de sécurité auprès des équipes de développement et d’administration des systèmes
  • Valider les plans d’action de correction, puis leur efficacité.
  • Analyse des risques associés aux vulnérabilités
  • Évaluer les risques en gestion des vulnérabilités afin de prendre des décisions éclairées, par exemple sur la rétrogression d’un risque
  • Déterminer la priorisation d’application des correctifs
  • Conseiller, accompagner et orienter les propriétaires TI et Affaires

Encadrement opérationnel

  • Agir à titre d’expert métier dans la Vice-Présidence
  • Assurer un mentorat pour les ressources de l’équipe.

Ce que nous offrons*

  • Salaire concurrentiel et boni annuel
  • 4 semaines de vacances flexibles dès la première année
  • Régime de retraite à prestations déterminées qui assure un revenu prévisible et stable durant toute la retraite
  • Régime d’assurance collective incluant des services de télémédecine
  • Remboursement des frais liés à la santé, au bien-être et à de l’équipement pour le télétravail
  • Les avantages sont applicables en fonction des critères d’admissibilité.

Ce que vous mettrez à profit

  • Baccalauréat dans une discipline appropriée
  • Un minimum de quatre ans d’expérience pertinente en TI, idéalement en sécurité TI
  • Veuillez noter que d’autres combinaisons de formation et d’expérience pertinentes pourraient être considérées
  • Expérience technique avec ServiceNow dont la gestion de la plateforme ServiceNow Vulnerability Response et Configuration Compliance (VR/AVR/CVR/CC)
  • Connaissance du français nécessaire
  • Connaissance de l’anglais de niveau intermédiaire en raison de la nature des tâches, des outils de travail ou d'interactions avec des partenaires ou membres et client(e)s anglophones
  • Expertise gestion des vulnérabilités

consider.title: Pega Lead System Architect
consider.description:
Pega Lead System Architect

Toronto, Canada – Hybrid

Role Summary

The Pega Lead System Architect is responsible for the end-to-end architecture, technical design, development governance, and successful implementation of enterprise applications built on Pega Platform. The role provides hands-on technical leadership, translates business needs into scalable solution designs, guides engineering teams, and ensures that applications are secure, performant, maintainable, and aligned with Pega guardrails and delivery standards.

Required Qualifications and Experience

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

· 10+ years of overall experience in information technology with extensive experience delivering Pega applications.

· Pega Certified Lead System Architect (PCLSA/CLSA) certification.

· Strong hands-on knowledge of Pega Platform, including App Studio and Dev Studio, case management, data model, security, integrations, reporting, background processing, and deployment.

Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead scope definition, requirements analysis, solution architecture, functional and technical design, application build, testing, deployment, and production transition.

· Architect complex Pega solutions for case management, workflow automation, business rules, integrations, data access, security, and user experience.

· Own application architecture decisions, including enterprise class structure, ruleset strategy, reusable components, data model, deployment approach, and integration patterns.

· Provide technical governance through design reviews, code reviews, guardrail compliance checks, architecture checkpoints, and quality gates.

· Lead and mentor System Architects, Senior System Architects, developers, and technical leads; assign technical work and remove design impediments.

· Collaborate with clients, product owners, business analysts, program management, infrastructure teams, security teams, and integration partners.

· Ensure non-functional requirements are addressed, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, maintainability, and operational support.

· Guide performance analysis and tuning using appropriate Pega diagnostic and monitoring capabilities, including Pega Diagnostic Cloud where applicable.

· Oversee integrations between Pega applications and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP services, messaging, file interfaces, databases, and other approved patterns.

· Support release planning, deployment validation, production readiness, post-release monitoring, root-cause analysis, and resolution of critical technical issues.

· Maintain architecture artefacts, technical specifications, decision records, deployment guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.

· Identify opportunities to improve delivery through reusable assets, automation, platform capabilities, and Pega best practices.

Expected Deliverables

· Solution architecture and high-level/low-level technical design artefacts.

· Architecture decision records, integration specifications, data and security designs.

· Design and code review findings, guardrail remediation plans, and quality evidence.

· Capacity, performance, deployment, cutover, and production-readiness recommendations.

· Technical delivery plan, estimates, risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions.

· Mentoring, technical enablement, and knowledge-transfer plans for the delivery team.

Success Measures

· Solution meets agreed business and non-functional requirements.

· Architecture decisions are documented, traceable, and aligned with platform standards.

· Delivery teams follow approved design patterns and Pega guardrails.

· Technical risks and defects are identified early and driven to closure.

· Production releases are stable, supportable, and operationally ready.

· Client stakeholders receive clear, timely technical guidance and status communication.

Interview Focus Areas

· End-to-end Pega solution architecture and design trade-offs.

· Enterprise class structure, ruleset strategy, reuse, and application layering.

· Integration, security, data, performance, scalability, and deployment architecture.

· Pega guardrails, design/code reviews, debugging, monitoring, and production support.

· Leadership of multi-location engineering teams and stakeholder management.

· Practical experience with current Pega Platform capabilities relevant to the assignment

Desired Skills:

· Experience with recent Pega capabilities such as Constellation architecture, DX API, Pega Blueprint, Pega GenAI, Pega Cloud, and Pega Diagnostic Cloud.

· Knowledge of cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, and enterprise security controls.

· Experience with Pega Decisioning, Customer Decision Hub, industry frameworks, or specialized Pega products relevant to the engagement.

· Prior consulting experience in a client-facing environment and the ability to support proposals, estimates, technical discovery, and solution demonstrations.

· Experience conducting architecture audits, performance reviews, technical risk assessments, and modernization or upgrade programs.

consider.description:
Why You’ll Love Softchoice

At Softchoice, a World Wide Technology (WWT) company, we work together to make a new world happen. As an IT solutions provider serving U.S. commercial and SMB organizations, as well as the entire Canadian market, we help organizations turn ambition into real‑world outcomes. We do this through the delivery of secure cloud, AI, software and digital workplace solutions that enable agility, innovation and growth.

With a highly engaged, high-performing team, we are certified as a Great Place to Work® in both Canada and the United States, and have been recognized as a Best Workplace in Canada for more than 20 years. As part of WWT, we connect customers to the global scale, advanced innovation, world-class partnerships, and deep expertise of a leader in AI and digital transformation. This includes access to WWT’s Advanced Technology Center (ATC), a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software that enables customers and partners to conceptualize, test, and validate innovative solutions before deploying them at scale.

The Impact You'll Have

We are seeking a Senior Technical Solutions Architect — AI to serve as a hands-on, platform-agnostic technical architect for our strategic AI engagements. This person sits at the intersection of customer strategy, applied AI engineering, and modern software delivery. They translate ambiguous business problems into working prototypes, scalable reference architectures, and production-grade solutions across public-cloud hyperscaler AI platforms and sovereign (on-premise / private) AI environments.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable whiteboarding an agentic architecture with a CIO, writing the proof-of-concept code that proves it works, and guiding a client engineering team through the secure path to production. They are vendor-fluent but vendor-neutral — recommending the right tool for the workload, the data, the risk profile, and the budget.

What You'll Do

Solutioning & Architecture

  • Architect sovereign / on-premise AI solutions using stacks such as NVIDIA AI Enterprise (NIM, NeMo, Blueprints), Dell AI Factory, HPE Private Cloud AI, Red Hat OpenShift AI, Run:ai, and open-source model serving (vLLM, TGI, Ollama) — for clients with data residency, regulatory, IP, or air-gapped requirements.
  • Design end-to-end AI solutions spanning Generative AI (RAG, CAG, GraphRAG, fine-tuning, model distillation) and agentic AI (tool-using agents, multi-agent orchestration, MCP-based integrations).
  • Understanding of hybrid architecture across all major hyperscaler AI stacks — AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Q), Microsoft Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI), and Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Gemini)
  • Develop reusable reference architectures, decision frameworks, and trade-off analyses (cost, latency, accuracy, governance, sovereignty) that scale across the practice.


Client Engagement & Enablement

  • Serve as the senior technical voice in client conversations — from executive briefings through deep technical design sessions.
  • Partner with sales, delivery, and practice leadership to scope statements of work, estimate effort, and de-risk delivery.
  • Mentor architects, engineers, and consultants across the broader AI practice; raise the technical bar through code reviews, internal enablement, and reusable assets.
  • Stay ahead of the field — evaluate emerging models, frameworks, and protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A, ACP, new agent frameworks, new sovereign AI stacks) and bring well-reasoned points of view back to the practice.


What You'll Bring To The Table

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solutions / Enterprise architecture, or applied AI/ML, with at least 2+ years in a hands-on Generative AI or agentic AI role.
  • Professional fluency in French and English, written and spoken (required) — able to lead client workshops, executive presentations, and technical documentation in both languages.
  • Experience designing sovereign / on-premise AI solutions, including private model serving (NVIDIA NIM / NeMo, vLLM, TGI, Ollama), enterprise AI platforms (NVIDIA AI Enterprise, Red Hat OpenShift AI, Dell AI Factory, HPE Private Cloud AI, Run:ai), and on-premise vector / graph stores.
  • Solid understanding of the infrastructure behind on-premise AI: GPU architecture and capacity planning, inference optimization (quantization, batching, KV-cache management), high-performance networking and storage, and Kubernetes-based GPU scheduling.
  • Strong understanding of data sovereignty requirements and controls — data residency, privacy regulation (e.g., PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25, GDPR), air-gapped and disconnected deployments — and the ability to articulate trade-offs between sovereign, hybrid, and public-cloud AI architectures.
  • Deep knowledge with at least one of the three major hyperscaler AI platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and a working understanding of the second and third.
  • Production experience designing and shipping RAG and/or agentic systems, including practical familiarity with chunking strategies, embedding model selection, retrieval evaluation, and orchestration patterns.
  • Working knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and modern agent-tool integration patterns; ability to design MCP servers and clients, and to reason about when MCP is the right abstraction versus alternatives.
  • Strong understanding of CAG (Cache-Augmented Generation), RAG variants (naive, hybrid, GraphRAG, agentic RAG), and the trade-offs between each.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems: REST/GraphQL APIs, event streams (Kafka, EventBridge), identity (OIDC, SAML, OAuth2), and enterprise data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, BigQuery).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to move fluidly between executive narrative and engineering whiteboard.


Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrable experience. Advanced degree is welcomed but not required.

Location & Travel

Remote-friendly with periodic travel to client sites and internal events (estimated 0–15%).

Compensation

A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $123,760 to $154,700 annually + 30% target incentives.

Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, education, and related certification. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ.

You are equally comfortable connecting organizational priorities with practical, hands-on execution. You embrace change, welcome new ideas, and are motivated by the challenge of building better ways of working.

Working closely with the leadership team, you will help strengthen the organization's operational foundation and support the continued growth and success of Hotels Canada.

  • Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of organizational policies, procedures, and internal controls.

  • Manage the operations and technology budget and support organizational budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting processes.

Technology & Digital Infrastructure

  • Champion technology adoption and identify opportunities to improve productivity through digital tools and automation.

Risk Management & Governance

  • Embraces innovation and is always looking for smarter ways of working.
  • Builds trust through accountability, follow-through, and sound judgment.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple functions and priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience overseeing technology platforms, CRM systems, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of operational controls, risk management, and organizational governance.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
  • A track record of improving systems, processes, and organizational effectiveness.

At Hotels Canada, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a national organization that is helping shape the future of Canada's hotel industry. As Manager, Operations & Technology, you will play an important role in strengthening the systems, processes, and people practices that enable our team to deliver results.


We are a small, collaborative team that values initiative, accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement. If you enjoy creating order from complexity, embracing new ideas, and contributing to a culture where everyone rolls up their sleeves to support shared success, we'd love to hear from you.


We offer:

  • A competitive salary of $70,000–$85,000, commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive health and benefits coverage
  • Transportation allowance
  • Hotel discount program
  • Hybrid work environment
  • Professional development opportunities
  • A supportive and collaborative team culture
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a national industry and the businesses that drive Canada's visitor economy

consider.title: Spécialiste, prix et tarification
consider.description:
Nous recherchons un ou une spécialiste, prix et tarification qui allie de solides compétences analytiques à un bon jugement commercial. Vous jouerez un rôle important dans la croissance rentable de nos activités au Canada en examinant la tarification des projets, en analysant les conditions du marché et en prenant des décisions de tarification qui tiennent compte de la compétitivité, des besoins de la clientèle et de la rentabilité.

En étroite collaboration avec les équipes des ventes, des finances et du marketing, les équipes techniques et nos partenaires de distribution, vous fournirez des conseils en tarification pour aider les équipes à se démarquer de la concurrence et à prendre des décisions d’affaires éclairées.

Que ferez-vous ?

  • Examiner et approuver les demandes de tarification et les modifications de prix liées aux projets, en veillant à leur exactitude et au respect des lignes directrices en matière de tarification.
  • Prendre des décisions de tarification en temps opportun en tenant compte de la compétitivité, des marges et des besoins de la clientèle.
  • Suivre les conditions du marché, les activités de la concurrence et les tendances des gains et des pertes de contrats pour orienter les stratégies de tarification.
  • Repérer les occasions d’accroître la rentabilité et d’offrir davantage de valeur à la clientèle.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes des ventes et les équipes régionales pour définir les stratégies commerciales et formuler des recommandations de tarification.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe des finances pour améliorer l’exactitude des données sur les coûts et les marges.
  • Établir des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires de distribution et répondre à leurs questions sur la tarification des projets.
  • Offrir de la formation et des conseils sur les processus, les politiques et les outils de tarification.
  • Repérer les occasions de simplifier, d’améliorer et d’automatiser les processus de tarification.

Quelles qualifications vous permettront de réussir?

  • Diplôme collégial ou universitaire en administration des affaires, en finance ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
  • 3+ ans d’expérience en tarification, en préparation de soumissions, en opérations de vente ou en ventes internes, idéalement dans le secteur des produits électriques ou de la distribution.
  • Connaissance des produits, des systèmes et des applications électriques.
  • Compréhension de l’analyse des marges, des coûts et de la rentabilité.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et bon jugement d’affaires.
  • Maîtrise avancée de Microsoft Excel et expérience avec des systèmes de gestion de la relation client, de préparation de soumissions ou de gestion intégrée des ressources de l’entreprise, comme Salesforce ou SAP.
  • Solides compétences en communication, en collaboration et en organisation.
  • Connaissance fonctionnelle de l'anglais et du français est requise. La personne doit être capable de travailler avec divers collaborateurs situés au Québec, dans les autres provinces canadiennes et internationalement.

consider.title: Senior Manager - IAM Governance - Initiatives, Risk Intelligence and Service Delivery
consider.description:
Requisition ID: 267998

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Global Identity & Access Management (GIAM), Governance Team is responsible for the governance of established security controls pertaining to Identity and Access Management. Our IAM Governance and Controls team works closely with IAM operations teams to ensure controls are in place and operating effectively to reduce risks to our Bank.

The Senior Manager of IAM Governance Initiatives, Risk Intelligence and Service is responsible for overseeing the team in their day-to-day activities. The Senior Manager will manage issue response and tracking of remediation activities inclusive of ad-hoc projects, defining monitoring and enhancing reporting of KRI and KPIs as well as shaping the future strategy of how IAM services are delivered and consumed across the enterprise.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

  • Define IAM reporting criteria and methodology in alignment with the IAM governance framework.
  • Define a structured approach to issue management with an IAM specific lens and secure stakeholder engagement to secure and produce a successful closure package
  • Develop and maintain governance of metric reports. Monitor and present metrics to Executives, major stakeholders (including audit) on a regular basis to address any control gaps.
  • Provide leadership, strategic thinking/insights and clear direction on how to achieve maturity of controls within GIAM – this includes leading new initiatives related to IAM Governance.
  • Provide expertise on all aspects of IAM Governance including Cloud, Privileged Access Management, Identity Lifecycle Management, Active Directory and more.
  • Provide input/feedback on continuous improvement initiatives to reduce risk in IAM Logical Access Control processes.
  • Create a positive work environment and empower the team to grow and excel.
  • Ensure that team/individual goals and performance objectives are measurable, obtainable and regularly re-enforced.
  • Support the business to understand their responsibilities with respect to logical access controls.
  • Build relationships and work with various teams to build our governance model and ensure our controls are working effectively and aligned with our policies and standards.

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have?

  • Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management principles, concepts, and best practices.
  • Minimum of 5 years of people leadership skills.
  • Minimum of 5 years of Security experience in Access Management or related field.
  • Good understanding of Active Directory security.
  • Good understanding of Cloud concepts and solutions (Google Cloud Platform, MS Azure).
  • Good understanding of Privileged Access Management.
  • Experience defining guidelines, processes and effective and efficient operational procedures.
  • Strong understanding and experience of reporting tools such as PowerBI.
  • Excellent organization skills and the ability to manage multiple intake channels efficiently.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • An Undergraduate degree in Computer Science.
  • Technical designation - considered an asset (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CISSP).
  • Fluency in Spanish - considered an asset.

What's in it for you?

  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
  • Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
  • Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
  • Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
  • Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, Humans of Digital and much more!

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

consider.title: Content Designer (CMS & Content Platform)
consider.description:
Content Designer (CMS & Content Platform), 12-Month Contract, Hybrid Toronto

I’m hiring a Content Designer for one of Canada’s Big 5 banks. The role sits on the team that owns the bank’s enterprise content management system, the platform behind its digital channels. This is a backfill for an internal promotion, so you’d be stepping into a proven role inside a content design practice that’s growing.

The job is equal parts content systems and enablement. You’d connect Experience Design, Digital Marketing, and Delivery, and help the people who build pages every day work faster with fewer defects.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with developers and designers to build new CMS modules and improve the Contentful platform

consider.title: IT Support Specialist

Are you passionate about creating hope for children, youth and families? At CASA Mental Health, every role contributes to our vision of a community where all children and youth are empowered to thrive.

Job Details
Wage range: $30.05 to $37.23 per hour
Vacation: 15 days
Shift structure: Monday to Friday, 7.25 hours per day
Primary location: Edmonton, CASA Centre
Union: In-scope
Classification: Coordinator
FTE: 1.0

About the Role
Reporting to the Manager, Information Technology, the IT Support Specialist provides technical assistance and end-user support across the organization including consultation, installation, troubleshooting, user assistance and training. This position serves as the primary contact for all inquiries and requests for technical support and customer service in the IT department.

The IT Support Specialist will:
  • Respond to incoming requests from users experiencing technical issues with workstation hardware, software and network connectivity through the ticketing system, by phone or in person.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve technical issues reported by end users.
  • Maintain accurate help desk records documenting technical issues, resolutions and recommendations.
  • Install, configure, maintain and monitor end-user workstation hardware and software.
  • Collaborate with other IT team members to develop and improve help desk workflows, processes and supporting documentation.
  • Administer end-user accounts, including account setup, updates and access management.
  • Ensure the timely distribution of required technology and equipment to new and existing staff.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of IT assets and their assigned users.
  • Develop and deliver effective end-user orientation and training on the organization's technology environment, systems and tools.
  • Provide IT orientation and technical guidance to new hires to support a smooth onboarding experience.
  • Participate in IT projects and perform additional tasks as assigned.
  • Assist with the configuration, maintenance and continuous improvement of the IT ticketing system and related processes.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver effective end-user orientation and technical training.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Basic networking knowledge, particularly in VPN and Wi-Fi troubleshooting.
  • Self-motivated, proactive and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Thorough understanding of Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Office applications, Windows 10/11, Apple device management (MDM) and remote desktop access.
  • Ability to support and troubleshoot audiovisual equipment, including web conferencing systems.
  • Sound knowledge of computer hardware, software, operating systems and network connectivity.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, practices and best practices for maintaining a secure IT environment.
Qualifications and Experience
  • Post Secondary Diploma in Information Technology, a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum three years of experience in a help-desk role supporting end-users across multiple locations.
  • Minimum three years of experience supporting Microsoft 365.
  • Demonstrated excellence in customer service and the ability to build positive relationships and rapport with staff.
  • CompTIA A+ certification is an asset.
Conditions of Employment
  • A satisfactory criminal records check. This would be the financial responsibility of the successful candidate.
Working Conditions
  • Valid driver’s license and access to a reliable vehicle.
  • Frequent lifting and transporting of moderately heavy objects such as computers and peripherals.
Your Well-Being Matters
At CASA, we know a career in mental health is more than just a job, it’s a calling. That’s why we take care of the people who make that care possible. We offer competitive benefits, opportunities for growth and the support you need to rest, recharge and continue making a difference.

What We Offer:
  • Employer-paid health and dental benefits, including $750 per paramedical practitioner and $2,000 annually in mental health services.
  • Flexible Spending Account that allows you choose between Health Spending, Personal Spending, your RRSP or CASA Pension Plan.
  • Defined contribution pension plan with generous employer match.
  • Five paid wellness days plus a holiday break in December to spend time with loved ones.
  • Paid time off for illness, bereavement, moving and education.
  • Up to 12 weeks parental leave top-up so you can spend precious time with your new addition.
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and a range of employee discounts.
  • Ongoing learning and growth opportunities including annual training events such as Indigenous Knowledges Day.
  • Recognition and community-building through employee appreciation events, team celebrations and opportunities to connect across CASA locations.
Apply today to start making a difference for Alberta’s children and families!

The Lead Infrastructure Architect plays a key role in shaping and maintaining FSRA’s hybrid cloud environment. The position focuses on developing and maintaining a reliable and well-governed infrastructure foundation that supports FSRA’s day-to-day operations and long-term digital transformation.

Description

The Experience

Salesforce is at the forefront of innovation, and as engineering paradigms shift toward AI-first delivery, we are seeking an experienced and dynamic AI Delivery Lead to act as the catalyst for our transformation. You will pioneer and orchestrate the AI Software Development Life Cycle (AI SDLC), integrating cutting-edge tools (LLMs, AI agents, AI-assisted development) into daily operations across multiple engineering teams. Beyond strategic oversight, this is a deeply hands-on technical coaching role: you will actively model best practices, elevate individual and team capabilities through real-code coaching, and guide developers in practical engineering scenarios. By combining deep technical expertise, modern delivery practices, and a commitment to code craftsmanship, you will shape the future of product delivery and cultivate a culture of engineering excellence at Salesforce.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Champion the AI SDLC: Influence the definition and drive the adoption of an AI-first strategy by defining and orchestrating a modern AI Software Development Life Cycle. Guide teams in seamlessly integrating Generative AI, agent-based frameworks, and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, OpenCode) into their daily workflows.
  • Hands-On Technical Coaching: Actively model and teach modern software craftsmanship. Facilitate real-code coaching, collaborative engineering sessions, and Test-Driven Development (TDD) to build mastery within engineering teams.
  • Proactive Stakeholder Engagement & Organizational Navigation: Initiate proactive outreach across complex, large-scale organizations to identify key stakeholders and establish self-introductions with senior leadership. Dynamically evaluate and adapt to evolving organizational landscapes, building trusted, influential relationships to seamlessly guide cross-functional teams.
  • Elevate Code Craft & Quality: Demonstrate expertise in design patterns, refactoring techniques, and clean code principles. Work directly with developers to elevate code maintainability and delivery speed using both foundational principles and modern AI tooling.
  • Optimize Delivery & Governance: Leverage data analytics to optimize workflows, continuously track delivery, and ensure AI initiatives yield real business value. Instill robust engineering practices and provide guardrails for safe, high-quality AI experimentation.
  • Drive Delivery Transformation: Serve as a proactive problem-solver and change agent. Identify and remove obstacles using AI tools to detect early delivery warning signs, guiding teams through complex technical transitions.
  • Influence and Communicate: Act as an exceptional communicator with excellent written and spoken skills. Highly comfortable speaking publicly with moderate size to 100+ person audiences. Adept at translating highly technical concepts into clear, inspiring messaging for both executive and engineering audiences.

You're Our Person If...

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 10+ years of technical product management, software development, or technical coaching experience, with a track record of delivering large-scale, high-impact digital products.
  • Demonstrated applied expertise in Test-Driven Development (TDD), collaborative coding practices, Refactoring, and Design Patterns.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI frameworks, the AI SDLC, and cloud AI platforms. Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agent-based architectures, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Proven experience creating instructional content, facilitating hands-on technical workshops, and leading real-time collaborative coding sessions at scale. Must possess excellent public speaking, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven success in driving the adoption of new developer tooling through advocacy and cultural change as a Technical Coach, Delivery Coach, or similar role, preferably within a large technology organization (software and hardware).

Even Better If...

  • Experience as a software developer, coupled with a proven track record of managing and leading teams of developers.
  • Certifications e.g.: PSM, CSPO, PMP, SAFe RTE

Join us to lead the charge in defining the next era of delivery and AI transformation at Salesforce!

  • Assist with the development, analysis, and preparation of reports to meet business, financial and regulatory needs and other relevant corporate requirements.
  • Develop, monitor and analyze commitments scorecards, performance reports and milestones within processes. Recommend improvements that will enhance the overall achievement of performance and ultimately improve customer satisfaction. 8.Monitor and assist quality assurance program related to processes and data. Be responsible for data integrity and validation associated with databases, including identification and resolution of issues. Provide and augment the data processes as required.
  • Participate in and provide assistance to governance activities to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements.
  • Assist in the review of processes and procedures to ensure that all planning, forecasting, budgeting and reporting requirements are met and modified as required to meet business and financial needs.

Education

  • Requires knowledge of project management and methodologies to develop business plans/processes, management reporting and regulatory submissions.
  • Requires a good knowledge of English in the preparation of analytical reports and to prepare presentations.

  • Requires experience in participating in cross-functional teams.
  • Requires experience with various software applications such as Microsoft (MS) Dynamics CRM, SAP, SharePoint MS-Office Suite and VBA.

skip.title: Canadian Public Sector Engagement Delivery Leader
skip.description:
Description

Job Description

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs. We rely on our team’s expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.

  • Please Note: Applicants must be Canadian Citizens**

Salesforce Professional Services is seeking innovative Engagement Delivery Leaders who share our vision of bringing the power of cloud computing to enterprises. Engagement Delivery Leads are driving successful customer outcomes with our implementations and lead and run complex, enterprise and strategic programs. This involves guiding our highly skilled and collaborative programs teams, both non-technical and technical consultants, and managing relationships, deliverables, and outcomes. Our Engagement Delivery Leads are also domain experts who actively participate in the program, managing customer relationships, delivery methodology, scoping, contracts review, knowledge transfer, and financials.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the overall Leader of the program team and exhibit excellent leadership skills in forming a team, ensuring strong communication channels, giving clarity, motivation and direction to the team throughout the engagement.
  • Be the primary customer interface and perform program management activities that ensures adherence to Salesforce methodology and project gates and governance.
  • Build and lead project plans; supervise and review project progress and timelines; adjust schedules and plans as needed; ensure on time and on budget delivery of projects and identify and resolve issues to ensure project success.
  • Supervise utilization of project resources in alignment with resource allocation and budget. This includes on time entry and approvals for project timesheets.
  • Able to lead multiple projects supporting a program or account, requiring complex cross-functional teamwork and management at the program level.
  • Facilitate requirements gathering and assist with crafting project deliverables, and Salesforce documentation as needed.
  • Being an extension to the account team to extend the Salesforce footprint.
  • Participate in end to end implementation planning including project management, risk & issue management, communication and business organisational change.
  • Facilitate User Acceptance Testing with business end users including coordination and user acceptance sign-off.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in project and program management, focused on delivering for external clients in a consulting environment.
  • 7+ years managing Salesforce engagements strongly preferred
  • 5+ years experience supporting the Public Sector vertical in Professional Services, preferred.
  • Ability to balance the business and technical requirements to produce a project plan and collaborate to acquire the information, such as estimates, as input to the project plan.
  • Demonstrated project management skills, with direct responsibility for running project teams, up to 75+ people, budget and schedule.
  • Demonstrated ability to have difficult conversations.
  • Proven history of delivering high quality results on schedule and within budget, managing a budget of at least $15Mil.
  • Outstanding and effective interpersonal skills; along with strong communication skills both verbal and written.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, high energy, team-oriented environment.
  • Available to travel regionally and occasionally internationally depending on customer needs.
  • Experience in managing large-scale transformation engagements with US Federal clients.
  • Ability to rapidly build senior-level credibility with the Customer in a true partnership relationship
  • Ability to lead large and/or enterprise-wide engagements, facilitate meetings, create action plans, mentor teams of junior team members and effectively manage client escalations.
  • Ability to lead high powered client workshops and effectively tailor messaging based on the audience and subject matter
  • Salesforce.com Certifications (Admin, Service, Experience, etc.) strongly preferred
  • Salesforce Agentblazer Innovator preferred
  • Build and Empower Teams: Leading, motivating, and holding accountable project and internal/external team members in a matrixed organization. Fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Influence and Communicate: Act as the primary communicator for the program, taking project level details and aggregating up to provide clear and concise updates to multiple levels of leadership, including executive sponsors.
  • Program Health Reporting: Defining and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure program success and health.
  • Value Realization Reporting: Support creation of the business case/ROI aligned with the required data driven metrics for objectively measuring outcome attainment
  • Location Preferences: Ottawa, Toronto or Vancouver

Security Clearance: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian Government Security Clearance. Candidates are not required to hold an active clearance at the time of application or interview; however, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain clearance as a condition of employment.

  • Reliability Clearance: Requires providing 5 years of verifiable work and residence history, generally from within Canada.
  • Secret Clearance: Requires providing 10 years of verifiable work and residence history, generally from within Canada

skip.title: Senior Technical Lead
skip.description:
Lead the Next Wave of Innovation at BMO

At BMO, we're leveraging emerging technologies, modern engineering practices, and AI-powered solutions to transform the future of banking. We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Technical Lead who combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities to drive the evolution of critical enterprise platforms that support our customers, employees, and business operations.

This is a unique opportunity to lead the design, delivery, stability, and continuous improvement of strategic platforms while working with cutting-edge technologies including Generative AI, OpenSearch, Dynatrace, Oracle/SQL, Mainframe ecosystems, cloud technologies, APIs, and enterprise-scale production environments.

As a technical leader, you'll influence platform strategy, guide engineering teams, solve complex business and technology challenges, and help shape the future of digital banking at one of North America's leading financial institutions.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Technical Lead, you will:

  • Lead the design, development, modernization, and optimization of business-critical platforms and applications.
  • Drive platform stability, scalability, performance, security, and operational excellence across the technology ecosystem.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and engineering leaders to define platform strategy, roadmaps, and execution plans.
  • Build and implement innovative solutions leveraging Generative AI capabilities to improve productivity, operational efficiency, monitoring, search, and customer experiences.
  • Utilize Dynatrace and observability best practices to proactively monitor system health, identify issues, improve performance, and enhance reliability.
  • Design and support enterprise search solutions utilizing OpenSearch and related search technologies.
  • Support and optimize applications leveraging Oracle/SQL databases, ensuring performance, integrity, and scalability.
  • Collaborate across modern and legacy technology environments, including Mainframe systems, batch processing frameworks, and distributed applications.
  • Provide leadership and expertise for production support activities, incident management, root-cause analysis, and problem resolution.
  • Drive automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, platform resilience, and service quality.
  • Lead the implementation and management of APIs and platform integrations while ensuring security, resilience, and scalability.
  • Analyze platform performance, adoption trends, and operational data to identify opportunities for optimization and continuous improvement.
  • Guide development teams through all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Mentor developers and promote engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build strong relationships with business and technology stakeholders to understand platform vision and align delivery with strategic objectives.
  • Prioritize, manage, and support a portfolio of customer-facing and internal platform initiatives.
  • Monitor platform health, adoption metrics, service performance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Document business rules, process flows, technical designs, architecture decisions, and functional specifications.
  • Analyze platform data to drive enhancements, performance improvements, and operational efficiencies.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that strengthen BMO's technology capabilities.
  • Ensure compliance with service level agreements, support standards, security policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage technical requirements including API integrations, platform services, and supporting infrastructure components.
  • Work independently while leading complex initiatives and navigating ambiguity.
  • Provide specialized consulting, technical leadership, analytical expertise, and production support guidance.
  • Apply BMO's Risk Management Framework and ensure all solutions align with security, governance, compliance, and operational standards.


Required Skills

Technical Skills & Experience

  • 5-7+ years of experience in software development, platform engineering, application support, or related technology roles.
  • Strong experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise-scale software solutions.
  • Experience working with Generative AI solutions, including AI-powered automation, developer productivity tools, and emerging AI technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, AI-assisted workflows, and enterprise AI adoption.
  • Experience with Dynatrace or similar observability and application performance monitoring platforms.
  • Experience implementing and supporting OpenSearch/Elasticsearch solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Oracle, SQL, and database design, optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Experience supporting and integrating Mainframe applications and infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of batch operations, scheduling frameworks, and enterprise processing environments.
  • Proven experience providing production support, incident management, problem management, root-cause analysis, and operational excellence.
  • Experience designing and supporting APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, application design, and distributed systems.
  • Experience working within Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD environments.
  • Knowledge of cloud computing platforms and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience implementing secure software development practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Strong understanding of monitoring, logging, observability, and operational support best practices.


Leadership & Professional Qualifications

Technical Competencies

  • System Design and Implementation
  • API Management and Integration
  • Product Design and Development
  • Test Driven Development (TDD)
  • DevOps Practices
  • Cloud Computing
  • Data Collection and Analysis
  • Cybersecurity and Privacy Principles
  • New Product Development
  • Continuous Improvement Management
  • Platform Engineering and Operations


Leadership Competencies

  • Building and Managing Relationships
  • Learning Agility
  • Creative Thinking
  • Emotional Agility
  • Strong Decision Making
  • Managing Ambiguity
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Influencing and Leadership Skills


Professional Skills

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Data-driven decision-making mindset.
  • Strong collaboration skills with a focus on cross-functional partnerships.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on technical execution.


Qualifications

  • Typically 5-7 years of relevant experience with a post-secondary degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Deep technical expertise developed through extensive hands-on engineering and business experience.
  • Experience working within large enterprise or highly regulated environments is considered an asset.
  • Financial services industry experience is preferred.


Work Arrangement

Hybrid Role: 2 days per week in office

Why Join BMO?

At BMO, you'll have the opportunity to lead transformational technology initiatives that directly impact millions of customers. You'll work alongside talented engineers, architects, and business leaders while leveraging emerging technologies such as Generative AI and modern platform engineering practices.

You'll be empowered to:

  • Lead enterprise-scale technology transformation initiatives.
  • Work with cutting-edge AI, observability, search, and cloud technologies.
  • Influence strategic platform roadmaps and innovation agendas.
  • Solve complex business and operational challenges.
  • Grow your career in a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking environment.


If you're passionate about technology leadership, platform engineering, operational excellence, and leveraging AI to drive the future of banking, we'd love to hear from you.

Salary:

$70,000.00 - $150,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

The above represents BMO Financial Group’s pay range and type.

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.bmo.com/global/en/Total-Rewards

About Us

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

To find out more visit us at https://jobs.bmo.com/ca/en

BMO is committed to an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace. By learning from each other’s differences, we gain strength through our people and our perspectives. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. To request accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Note to Recruiters: BMO does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to BMO, directly or indirectly, will be considered BMO property. BMO will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. A recruiting agency must first have a valid, written and fully executed agency agreement contract for service to submit resumes.

skip.title: Offensive and defensive security advisor
skip.description:
Required

As a Vulnerability Management and ServiceNow SecOps Advisor, you’ll be responsible for ServiceNow SecOps, Desjardins Group’s central vulnerability management solution. You’ll guide the solution’s development based on the team’s needs and organizational priorities while ensuring its day-to-day stability and reliability. You’ll connect users, technical teams and the service provider to ensure the platform continues to effectively support our operations. You’ll also contribute directly to addressing vulnerabilities, giving you solid understanding of the realities of the people who use the solution. You play an advisory role for the IT and Business teams, helping them understand risks and make the right decisions to protect Desjardins systems. Your knowledge of the platform and the vulnerability management process enables you to recommend practical improvements to both the tool and our ways of doing things. This role requires a clear understanding of vulnerability management and ServiceNow, as well as solid risk analysis and business priority assessment skills. You propose solutions and action plans that align with the organization’s priorities and help solve complex problems involving technology, processes and people. As a recognized subject matter expert within the division, you share your expertise and support the professional development of your colleagues. You collaborate with multiple stakeholders with different interests, making strong interpersonal skills essential. More specifically, you will be required to:

ServiceNow SecOps product management

  • Serve as product owner for the ServiceNow SecOps solution (VR/AVR/CVR/CC)
  • Develop and update the product roadmap
  • Understand and help prioritize platform changes
  • Participate in incident response and resolve platform stability issues
  • Manage the relationship with the supplier
  • Ensure platform documentation

Vulnerability management

  • Analyze vulnerabilities reported through detection sources each day
  • Manage exceptions, false positives and related issues
  • Assess vulnerabilities in the organization’s business context to ensure they are handled appropriately
  • Assign vulnerabilities to the appropriate stakeholders in accordance with the established process and provide recommendations tailored to the situation
  • Serve as a security expert for the system development and administration teams
  • Review remediation plans and assess their effectiveness
  • Analyze the risks associated with vulnerabilities
  • Assess vulnerability management risks to support informed decisions, such as whether to lower a risk rating
  • Determine the order in which patches should be applied
  • Advise, support and guide IT and business owners

Operational guidance

  • Serve as a subject matter expert within the division
  • Mentor team members

What we offer*

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • 4 weeks of flexible vacation starting in the first year
  • Defined benefit pension plan that provides predictable, stable income throughout retirement
  • Group insurance including telemedicine
  • Reimbursement of health and wellness expenses and telework equipment
  • Benefits apply based on eligibility criteria.

What You Bring To The Table

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field
  • A minimum of four years of relevant experience, ideally in IT security
  • Please note that other combinations of qualifications and relevant experience may be considered
  • Technical experience with ServiceNow, including the management of the ServiceNow Vulnerability Response and Configuration Compliance (VR/AVR/CVR/CC) platform
  • Knowledge of French is required
  • Intermediate knowledge of English due to the nature of the duties or work tools or because the position involves interactions with English-speaking partners, members and/or clients
  • Expertise in vulnerability management
  • Demonstrated knowledge of security administration for technology systems or application development

Action oriented, Business insight, Customer Focus, Differences, Interpersonal Savvy, Nimble learning

Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Accessibility

At Desjardins, we believe in equity, diversity and inclusion. We're committed to welcoming, respecting and valuing people for who they are as individuals, learning from their differences, embracing their uniqueness, and providing a positive workplace for all. At Desjardins, we have zero tolerance for discrimination of any kind. We believe our teams should reflect the diversity of the members, clients and communities we serve.

If there's something we can do to help make the recruitment process or the job you're applying for more accessible, let us know. We can provide accommodations at any stage in the recruitment process. Just ask!
